However, Delhi Times succeeded in clicking a picture of the couple and it went viral. The image was of Vicky & Katrina walking towards each other. Later in the day once the Vicky & Katrina released official wedding images. Social media was abuzz with Vicky-Kat’s wedding. Many bollywood personalities congratulated the couple on their wedding. Social media is obssessed over Vicky-Kat's wedding & the media is unable to get any information. The couple’s tierd wedding cake was made by an Italian chef and cost Rs 3-4 lakh. According to the various news reports, Vicky-Kat were going to the Maldives for their honeymoon but now that plan has been cancelled & they will stay in the same Rajasthan hotel till 12 Dec and then return to Mumbai. Now that they are married I am sure you are all wondering whether the couple will buy a new home or will they rent. Vicky Kaushal and Katrina Kaif will be moving in together at their residence in Juhu, Mumbai. Virat Kohli & Anushka Sharma stay in the same building. The apartment is being rented by the couple for a period of 5 years. The security deposit paid by the actor is Rs 1.75 crore and the rent for the initial 3 year is Rs 8 lakh per month. There is no information about the updated rent after 3 years.

Dr Abdul Ghani- this is his Sign name, is known by all as the “Green man of India”. This is because he launched a tree ambulance service. By ambulance it means that, trees that have fallen, chopped off, the soil is not good enough, etc are all helped by giving first aid. They are all taken care of. This is a unique idea. He aims to care for the trees and spread a positive feeling towards the environment. His aim is to create awareness regarding conservation of trees. The tree ambulance will help a tree in a bad conditionand help it to grow again. If the trees are cut in a spot, they will go and plant more trees there. They also have a "Seed Bank". If people want to plant trees and do not have seeds, they can buy it free of cost. So people can grow trees. They conduct a survey to see the distribution of trees in different areas. If there are many trees in a particular area and if there less in another spot, they plant more trees. This is to make sure, trees are equally distributed everywhere. If someone wants to cut a tree, they can inform the Tree Ambulance, who will replant it elsewhere instead of cutting it. Dr Abdul Ghani launched the Tree Ambulance in Chennai to help Chennai, Tamil Nadu as well as India. His aim is to drive the ambulance to Delhi in two months. He plans to expand this project by 2020. Recently, NASA completed a survey. They said that India and China working hard to plant more trees. This is very important and they must keep growing trees. Dr. Ghani also goes to schools and colleges to educate the students on protecting forests. India is losing many trees due to rapid industrial growth. This is why it is very important to grow more trees.

Vinesh Phogat is a well known wrestler. The WFI has temporarily suspended Vinesh Phogat on 10th August after her return from the Tokyo Olympics. The WFI cited indiscipline from Vinesh on three counts at the Tokyo Olympics. If the response is not satisfactory, the WFI is considering a long ban. 16th August is the deadline for this. WFI sources have explained the 3 counts of indicipline by Phogat at the Olympics. Let me tell you. Vinesh was in Hungary training with her coach Woller Akos. The duo then travelled to Tokyo from Hungary for the Olympics. While a contingent of wrestlers from India with their coach travelled to Tokyo. Phogat refused to stay in the same room with other Indian female wrestlers. Vinesh argued that she might contract coronavirus since these wrestlers travelled from India where there are many infections. She wanted a separate room that too on a different floor and tried to impose her seniority. This was her first count of indiscipline. The second charge is that Vinesh did not even train with the other Indian team members. A source said, Vinesh told India’s chief women’s coach, Kuldeep Malik, that she is going to train with her personal coach Woller Akos who is from Hungary. One day, Vinesh’s training and the other Indian women wrestlers training with Malik was scheduled at the same time. Phogat got her schedule changed. She tried to show that she was not with the Indian contingent. This was her 2nd count of indiscipline. The third charge on Vinesh is that she did not wear the singlet which had been sponsored by a company called Shiv Naresh. Instead of the Shiv Naresh singlet, Vinesh chose to wear the singlet of her personal sponsor, Nike, during her bouts. These were the three counts of indiscipline which were the reason for her temporary suspension. If her response to these is unsatisfactory, her ban will be extended. A WFI source said, "Due to her indiscipline she has been suspended. The ban would mean she can't compete in any national or other domestic events until she files a reply and WFI takes a final decision. If she does not respond then the ban will be lifelong. WFI was pulled up by IOA - India Olympic Association - as to why they can't control their athletes. Before the IOA could send the notice, WFI has asked Phogat to explain her indiscipline. Meanwhile, the WFI also issued notice to young 19 year old wrestler, Sonam Malik for misconduct. Let me tell you about it. You all may know that athletes passports of athletes participating in Olympics are collected for Visa processing. Even though Sunday was a holiday. WFI kept their office open so athletes could collect their passports. Sonam's passport was ready. Officials thought either her or her family member would collect it. But no one came. Shockingly she instead sent a SAI official to collect the passport. People were stunned by her behaviour for sending a SAI official. These kids think that they are going to the Olympics so they’ve become some kind of stars and the federation or SAI people are their servants to pick up their passport. Officials said they would not tolerate this. Sonam’s father, Rajender Malik in her daughter’s defence said, The thoughts about Sonam being a star and not picking up her passport are false. The passport was at the WFI office in Delhi. We could not travel to Delhi as there was a lockdown in our home town Haryana. Luckily PM Modi ji had said this in a video interaction before the Olympics that any athlete who is facing any kind of trouble should contact SAI. I had the contact number of one official so I contacted him and asked for his help. Thankfully, he got the passport collected from the WFI office and Sonam received it at the airport on the day of her departure.

Last year, the government announced that women would be employed as soldiers in the Military Police, in 2019. Till date, the army has accepted women, only as “Officers”. They were never allowed to join the fighting arms. There are more than 14 lakh personnel in the Armed Forces. the number of women is just 1500 in the Army, 1600 in the Air Force, and 500 in the Navy. In the Army, Navy and the Air Force there are a total of 65,000 women in the Officer rank. This is a very small number. This has led to the Army in recruiting more women in the forces. On 25th April, the Army began the process to employ women as Jawans, for the very first time. The Army aims to fill 20% of the Military Police with women staff. The Army has said that, they will recruit 800 women. Every year, they will recruit 50 women personnel. This will help in investigating cases of rape and molestation. They could also be used in crowd control, and frisking of women. The Modi government said that officers in the army would be allowed to opt for permanent posts such as engineers, intelligence etc. Women will be given permanent jobs. the army began online registration for recruitment of women, The last date of registration is the 8th of June.

Yesterday on 11th July 2022, Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveiled the National Emblem in Delhi. The news went viral on social media. The National Emblem has been placed over the new parliament building and was unveiled by PM Modi. The structure look beautiful. The emblem is heavy and weighs 9,500 kg. A supporting steel structure of 6,500 kg has been made to support its weight. The Prime Minister also attended a religious ceremony at the site The emblem is  6.5 metre-tall and 4.34 metres in width A statement from the PMO stated, “The installation of the bronze National Emblem has gone through eight different stages of preparation from clay modeling, computer graphic and finally to polishing.” The emblem was created by Sunil Deore from Aurangabad, Maharashtra and Laxman Vyas from Jaipur, Rajasthan. The fabrication was carried out in Aurangabad, Jaipur and Delhi and took nine months to complete. Since it was not possible to take the emblem on the roof, it was divided into 150 segments and assembled on the roof for 2 months from April 2022. PM Modi interacted with the workers building the new Parliament, who told him that the work would be completed by October 2022. PM Modi in a tweet said, “We are proud of the worker's efforts and they inspire us. We will always remember their contribution. Minister Hardeep Singh Puri, Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla and others too were present at the event. After the unveiling the opposition parties said that this was wrong and were unhappy with it. AIMIM Chief tweeted that PM Modi was wrong as the Constitution gives separate powers to parliament, government & judiciary. It is the new parliament building and the right to unveil the emblem should be with Om Birla, Speaker of the Lok Sabha. PM Modi had no right to unveil the emblem and impose his authority. German Chancellor, Olaf Scholz, who is like the Prime Minster of India, welcomed PM Modi on landing in Berlin. PM Modi held talks with Chancellor Olaf Scholz and both the leaders also met CEO’s of big companies of both the countries. PM Modi was welcomed by the Indians living in Germany at Hotel Adlon Kempinski in Berlin. People cheered, applauded and chanted " Vande Mataram" and "Bharat Mata ki Jai". PM Modi walked amongst the people. Met the children and their parents. While addressing the Indians in Germany he said, In the Russia- Ukraine war, there is no benefit in winning or losing. After completing the meeting on 2nd May in Germany, Today, 3rd May 2022, Modi travelled to Denmark’s capital Copenhagen, where he had a meeting with Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen about India-Denmark relationship. Modi also interacted with Indian citizens living there. He took part in the 2nd India-Nordic Summit along with Prime Ministers of Denmark and four other European countries like Norway, Sweden, Finland, and Iceland. The Summit is for better relations of these countries with India. After this PM Modi was to retrun to India but then decided to have a visit to France to personally congratulate French President Emmanuel Macron, for being re-elected for the second term and at the same time, hold talks ensuring  trade relationship between the two countries. Today, the Supreme Court's CJI Ranjan Gogoi, announced the final decision about the Ayodhya dispute today at 10.30am. Let me tell you about it in short. Lord Rama was born in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, As per the Ramayana, Hindus believe that a temple was built at the place where Ram was born. In 1528, Mughal emperor Babur came and demolished the temple. He then built the Babri Masjid in its place. For a long time, Hindus have claimed ownership over the land. There have been violent riots between Hindus and Muslims about this. Hindus and Muslims both filed cases claiming ownership over the land. Even though courts gave a decision, they were never happy with the decision. On December 6, 1992 the Babri Masjid was demolished by the Hindus. The Supreme Court then seized the land and no one was allowed inside. Cases were filed demanding ownership over the land. The main parties were fighting over the land were Ram Lalla, Sunni Waqf Board and the Nirmohi Akhara. They have been fighting over the land. Today the SC finally announced its decision about the ownership of the land. The Supreme Court's decision has to be accepted by all. The entire 2.77 acres of land of the Babri Masjid which was demolished, will be given to the Hindus. The SC also said that since the demolition of Babri Masjid was wrong. they will be give them five acres to build a Mosque. The Supreme Court has told the Central government to make a Trust and select trustees within three months. Once they select and form board of trustees, they will control the land and oversee the making of the Temple and Mosque.

Mehul Choksi was the mastermind of the Rs 13,000 crore Punjab National Bank (PNB) fraud case. He fled from India and has been staying in Antigua and Barbuda since January 2018. Choksi is a citizen of Antigua based on citizenship by investment program. According to the Antiguan laws, Choksi being a citizen of Antigua, can not be extradited to India for his crimes. This is as per Antigua's laws. This was one of the main reasons why Choksi fled to Antigua to avoid extradition. On 23rd May he disappeared from the country. The news went viral and sources said he had fled again. He was then arrested in Dominica a country close to Antigua and Barbuda. He was arrested for allegedly entering the island nation "illegally". Images went viral where he can be seen behind bars and has injury marks and bruises on his hand and wrist. Mehul Choksi's lawyer Vijay Aggarwal on 30th May said, “All these theories of Mehul Choksi running away from Antigua are nonsense. He elaborated by saying, “Firstly, he was happily living in Antigua without any problem. So why would he voluntarily leave, if he was happy? Secondly, his passport is still in Antigua. If Choksi really wanted to go to Dominica, why would he leave his passport in Antigua. When a person flees a country, passport is the most important document that is needed. Then why would Choksi flee without it? Choksi was "abducted" from Antigua and Barbuda, by men looking like Indian and Antiguan policemen. Choksi was beaten up, tortured and then forcibly taken to Dominica by boat, where he was arrested. The Antigua and Barbuda police chief, Atlee Rodney said, There is no proof that Choksi was abducted, tortured and forcibly taken to Dominica. The Antigua police were not at all involved in all this. Meanwhile, Antigua and Barbuda PM Gaston Browne has made some pretty sensational claims. He said, "Choksi made a mistake. Choksi travelled with his girlfriend to Dominica but he was caught. It's a good thing he was arrested. Now he can be deported back to India. Since he wasn't in Antigue anymore, he can be easily deported. The matter of kidnapping, torture and illegal entry of Mehul Choksi is pending before the Dominican High Court. Indian officials have landed in Dominica and documents about him duping PNB and being a fugitive are being presented to the Dominican court, to extradite him. Indian officials have also asked for him to be sent directly to India and not back to Antigua. The court has restrained Mehul Choksi's repatriation till the next hearing slated for 2 June. Gaston Browne has also communicated to the Dominican Government that Choksi should be sent to India and not returned to Antigua.

Since the announcement of lockdown, India had stopped all flights from 25th March 2020. It has been extended thrice and will last upto 31st May. It is unclear if the restrictions will lift. Civil Aviation Minister, Hardeep Singh Puri had informed on 20th May, that domestic flights will resume from 25th May 2020 onwards. It will resume only in big cities. Airport Authority of India (AAI) on 21st May issued new protocols for the flights. The AAI said in a statement, "Passenger baggage will be sanitised before entry into the airport. Only asymptomatic patients will be allowed to travel. Passengers showing symptoms will not be allowed. Here are some of the rules that have to be followed: 1. Passengers must reach the airport two hours before their flight. 2. Physical check-in will not be allowed anymore. Only web check-in will be allowed. 3. Passengers must compulsorily walk through a thermal screening before entering the airport. 4. Passengers must wear masks and gloves. 5. Before travelling, all the passengers must download the Aarogya Setu app on their mobiles. 6. If the Aarogya Setu does not show ‘green’, then the passenger will not be allowed to enter the airport. 7. Aarogya Setu app is not compulsory for children below 14 years of age. 8. Sanitization of baggage is a must before entering the terminal. 9. Only one check-in bag and one bag on board will be allowed per passenger. 10. Staff must wear face shields or must have glass barriers at the counter, while interacting with passengers. 11. Airports must continuously announce social distancing and other rules. 12. Passengers will not be allowed to board the flight in large crowds. They will board the flight in batches to maintain social distance. 13. Passengers must walk carefully and maintain social distance at the airport. Seats that are not to be used should be marked with proper markers or tapes. 14. All airport staff to wear PPEs. Passengers and staff must keep sanitisers. 15. Newspapers and magazines will not be provided in the terminal lounges. 16. Passengers are supposed to reach the airport 2 hours in advance. They will be allowed entry only if their flight is within the next 4 hours. 17. State governments have to provide public transport like bus, taxis, etc. for passengers and airline crew. 18. Trolleys will not be allowed in the arrival or departure sections, except for special cases. Like for people with disabilities, senior citizens, etc. 19. No refreshment would be served in the flights. The government has said that for a 40 minute flight a minimum fare limit of Rs 2,000 and maximum fare Rs 6,000 has been set. Many such limits have been set for the next 3 months. Many states have announced that when passengers land from other states, they will be screened first. The officials will then decide whether to put them in institutional quarantine or home quarantine (14 days). In some cases, states like Karnataka, after landing will be screened, made to stay in Institutional quarantine for 7 days and then in Home Quarantine for 14 days.

This is why the farmers want to wait till an official decision is made.

Now that the pandemic was on the decline, there seems to be a new outbreak. The first known case of Bird flu has been detected in humans. Bird flu did not affect humans. It was circulating since 2002 after first emerging in the North American region . It is known to mainly infect dogs, chicken, horses and seals. Now the first human infection has been reported in China. However, China's National Health Commission on 26 April 2022 said a four-year-old boy living in the Henan region of China tested positive for the Bird flu virus. He was hospitalized earlier this month with fever and some other symptoms like breathing problems. The boy's family raised chickens at home. These chickens infected him. The flu was not found to have "the ability to effectively infect humans". Tests of the boy's close human contacts found no symptoms or abnormalities. He lived in an area populated by wild ducks. Maybe this is how he got infected? Odisha government launched the Nirmal Scheme in 2018 to provide better healthcare facilities. The scheme was launched in Odisha's various hospitals. The scheme focuses on providing facilities like cleanliness, hiring people for the post of security gaurds, and providing cheap medicines in the hospital pharmacy shops. The scheme wants to empower the LGBTQIA+ community. LGBTQIA+ stands for Lesbians, Gays and 'T' stands for Transgender. A male wishing to transform his body to female or a female wishing to transform her body to male is called Transgender and this is the sign name. The authorities in Odisha's Malkangiri District Headquarters Hospital (DHH) have appointed five transgender individuals as security guards to work in the hospital. The hospital decided to employ them. The five transgender persons will work as security guards at the gynaecology and paediatrics wards of the hospital. They will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹7000 to ₹8000 with insurance and other facilities. The 5 transgender’s were trained by the Malkangiri District Police before they started the job with the DHH. One of the five transgender persons said they underwent training of 15 days at the hospital. Once they learnt everything, the five of them began working and are extremely happy about it. They stay at the hospital for 8-hours every day during which they take care of the patients and are very happy. The Odisha government had also announced a number of healthcare projects. Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik had announced many benefits for the Malkangiri hospitals. Doctors working in shifts will be given rooms to rest in, and families of the patients will be given accomadation. Once they find a place to stay others can use it. Many such benefits will be given.

India's problems of animal abuse has been increasing day by day. The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act is 60-years-old. If any person breaks the law, they shall be punishable with a fine of maximum one hundred rupees, or with imprisonment for maximum three months or both. This is as per the old law. Rajeev Chandrasekhar, Rajya Sabha Member, referred to a case in Kerala where an elephant ate a pineapple filled with firecrackers, which exploded in his mouth. The elephant died because of it. Chandrasekhar was devasted at people's cruelty towards the animal. Minister of Fisheries, Animal husbandry and Dairying Giriraj Singh in a response said "I agree the number of animal cruelty cases have been on the rise. The PCA law is extremely old. We will made amendments and create a draft. The punishments under the law will be made very stringent. The government has said 314 cases relating to cruelty to animals were pending in various courts across the country. 64 such cases were pending in Supreme Court while 38 were pending in Delhi High Court. All these cases are still pending in the courts. In the draft the government has proposed 3 categories of offences. 1. This includes a minor injury caused to an animal. 2. This is an offence, where a major injury is caused leading to the animal becoming disabled. 3. A major injury is which lead to the violent death of the animal will be penalised. For such offences, the penalties are from Rs 750 - Rs 75,000. Or say for example, a horse is abused, which lead to its death. Now if the horse was purchased for Rs. 2 lakh, the penalty for its death would be three time the cost, i.e. Rs 6 lakh. Or it can even lead to imprisonment for upto 5 years. If any individual causes the death of an animal, they will be fined Rs 75,000. and imprisonment for upto 5 years.

In Odisha there are a total of 602 police stations. Whenever Deaf people go to the police station to file a complaint, communication would be very difficult. Earlier when a Deaf person went to the police station to file a complaint, it became difficult to communicate and they had to use gestures. Police want to help but communication is difficult. Looking at the Deaf person's gestures they would guess and conduct the investigation. If a Deaf person wants to file a complaint and communication is Difficult they can write and explain. However if they can't even write, it becomes even more difficult. If anything happens and if a Deaf person wants to file a complaint, communication is difficult because they are not trained in sign language. Now Odisha State Government for the first time has appointed Indian Sign Language interpreters. The interpreters will be appointed in Odisha police stations. If a there is a case related to a Deaf individual, the interpreter will be called to help communicate. In the same way they will help in Courts as well. State commissioner for persons with disabilities Sulochana Das said, The government has selected 12 interpreters. If a Deaf person wants to file an FIR. The interpreters will help the police to write FIRs of Deaf Victims. In the same way they will help out in courts and make things easy! The government has contacted many institutions that give training on sign language. They have received 12 names of Interpreters. They will soon finalise their appointment and salary. The government said that It is difficult for us to pay interpreters monthly as there are few cases related to deaf people. The frequency of cases is very less. To pay interpreters a full-time salary becomes very difficult. The government said that if there is a Deaf person wanting to file a complaint, the interpreter will be called and paid on a per day basis. Just like that whenever there is a case related to a Deaf person, interpreters will be called and paid. The Odisha government wants to make sure police stations are disabled friendly. There must be services accessible to the blind, ramps for people with physical disability and if a Deaf person wants to file a complaint an interpreter will be available.

On 4th December, 16,394 people were tested for COVID-19. Out of these only 825 people tested positive. The rest tested negative. This means only 5.03% of the people tested positive. According to the BMC, this is a big drop in the positivity rate. The WHO has said that if a country has a positivity rate of 5%, then it is very much possible to control COVID-19. A top BMC official said that, “In the last 10 days the number of positive cases has dropped significantly. This is a big success for Mumbai. However, we can not be complacent.” This is because Mumbai has the highest number of COVID fatalities. Health experts have warned that with the fall in temperatures, the number of cases could increase. Many have praised the BMC efforts to contain the virus in Mumbai’s congested areas and the slum areas of Dharavi.

The Midday Meal Scheme was started by the HRD Ministry’s Department of School Education and Literacy. The aim of the programme was to provide nutritious food to children all over the country. It was a way to attract children to attend school so the children could progress. The HRD ministry said that, in the past three years, 930 children were reported ill across the country after eating the Mid-Day meals. The Ministry received 35 complaints from 15 States and Union Territories regarding the bad food quality. An official with the HRD ministry said that, 930 children were ill but none of them died. It is the responsibility of the State Governments to provide cooked and safe nutritious midday meals to the children. The HRD Ministry has also issued guidelines to various schools. These rules have to be followed by all of them. The rules said that the food must be cooked well. and the food must be nutritious as well. One must not be careless while cooking, the food must be hygienic and everything must be clean. AGMARK Certification is a certificate given to farm produce such as rice, wheat, vegetables, etc. by the Department of Agriculture. The ministry said that for the mid-day meals only AGMARK certified items must be purchased for making the meals. They must not buy products which are not certified as it will not be allowed. They also said that before serving the food atleast two to three seniors of the school management must taste the food. If it is good, only then it can be served. They must do this regularly. The HRD ministry has warned the state government authorities. If the state governments do not improve the quality of their food, if it is not nutritious, if it is unhygienic and if they ignore and do not follow the rules then strict action will be taken.

A 14 year old Deaf boy was lost at the Nagpur railway station in Maharashtra. He was found by the Railway Police, who then realised he is Deaf. Since the boy did not know Sign Language, he was unable to communicate with the police. The Railway Police then took him to a shelter home named Government Boys Children Home. Authorities of the shelter home tried to communicate and get his personal details. However, this was very difficult. Even Sign Language experts were called to help but they too failed to communicate with the boy. The authorities then named the Deaf boy Jayant. Superintendent of the shelter home Vinod Daberao said, “We tried to make an Aadhar Card for the boy. He was taken to the nearest Aadhar centre, but his biometrics were rejected by the system. We were very confused by this. He was then taken to the Mankapur Aadhar centre in Nagpur on 16 July. When we informed the centre officials about his biometrics being rejected, they then contacted the Technical support department in Bengaluru for help. They then found that his Aadhar had already been made in 2016. It was found that his name is Shivam Chauhan. They were stunned to learn his name and that he was a resident of Itauri Bazar in Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh. Local police managed to contact his parents who were very shocked. They then met the boy on 3 August 2021. When his parents saw him at the shelter home they were overjoyed to reunite with their son. They hugged him and started crying. The father said they never lodged a complaint that Shivam had gone missing but they never stopped looking for him. They were very grateful to the authorities who cared for him and took him back home.

4 petitions were filed in the Delhi High Court. On 7th April, Justice Prathiba M Singh reviewed the petitions. They were challenging the collection of fines for not wearing a mask in public. It is now mandatory to wear masks in Delhi. Petitioners challenged wearing of masks in cars when the driver is alone. The court said just like masks are mandatory in public places, it will be mandatory in cars even if the person is alone. The judge said when a person is alone in the car and stop at a red light, they roll down their mirrors to chat with people, beggars, food vendors, etc. In this way the virus can spread if the driver has not worn the mask. Sometimes people spit and spread the virus. This is why it is best to wear a mask. The judge dismissed the petitions. The court even rebuked the lawyers for accepting such a case. They said the lawyers should advice the petitioners to wear a mask. It said if lawyers do this then people will follow their example. This will keep Delhi safe and contain the cases.

Most of the Indians are from middle class families. They are often concerned about their electricity bills. It is a relief if the bill is less but if the bill is high the whole family gets a scolding for wasting electricity. This is all around India. A person got the shock of his life when he got an electricity bill of ₹3500 crore. Let me tell you about it. Sanjeev Kankane and his wife Priyanka Gupta are residents of Shiv Vihar Colony in Madhya Pradesh's Gwalior. The couple received an electricity bill for the month of June 2022 of a whopping ₹3,419 crore. They were stunned and when Sanjeev's father saw the bill he fell sick and had to be taken to the hospital. How can someone get a bill of ₹ 3,419 crore! They were extremely worried. Sanjeev then went and showed the bill to the electricity company. When the company said that there an error,  Sanjeev was relieved. Madhya Pradesh Madhya Kshetra Vidyut Vitran Company General Manager Nitin Manglik said that an employee visits the house to check the units consumed, In the software, when the units are entered, the bill is automatically calculated and copies sent to consumers. While entering in the software, the employee entered the consumer number in place of the units consumed resulting in a bill with an extreme amount. It was a misunderstanding. The employee was scolded and was warned that in case of a repeat mistake, would be suspended. The error was rectified and the new bill of ₹1300 was issued which gave a relief to Sanjeev, his wife Priyanka and his father.

Can you write with both hands at the same time? Very difficult right? In Madhya Pradesh's Budhela village in Singrauli, there is a school named, Veena Vadini Public School. The school teaches English, Hindi, Urdu, Spanish, and Sanskrit. They also teach writting with both hands at the same time! School principal Virangad Sharma was insppired by Dr. Rajendra Prasad, the former President. This is because he can write with both hands. Inspired by this, he started teaching this in his school. Amazing! Pankaj Yadav, a Class 8 student said when he was in the class 3, he first used to write using his right hand, then he learnt to write using his left hand. Now that he is in class 8, he is able to write using both hands. 480 students have passed out from the school who can write using both of their hands. 300 students are currently learning to write with both their hands. The students write using both hands at the same time, they can write in diferent languages at the same time using both the hands! Generally an exam is for 3 hours and if you fail to complete it, you miss the paper. However these students can complete a 3 hour exam in 1.5 hours. There are claims that the students of this school can translate a 250-word text in under a minute. These students are very talented. Mahatma Gandhi could write with both hands. While writing a book, Swaraj, he wrote with left hand when his right hand got tired. Even actor Amitabh Bachchan can write with both hands when one hand gets tired. So what about Deaf people? After selection, the women will be posted in depots close to their homes so they can save time travelling. They will be trained for 1 year. MSRTC is even training 20 women from extremely poor villages to become drivers. Earlier the MSRTC had different posts for ticket conductors and drivers. On 3rd December was World Disability Day. Organisations such as National Centre for Promotion of Employment for Disabled People (NCPEDP), National Association of Deaf (NAD) and American India Foundation (AIF) were involved They had conducted a walk to create awareness on world disability day. The NCPEDP has been doing this for the last 5 years. NAD conducted a skit as well which showed the problems of people with disability. Hundreds of people attended the event. The guests were K Sanghvi, AIF director of livelihood and employment. and NCPEDP trustee and President of NAD AS Narayanan. A woman named Shruti Jha said that her son has Autism. She said the public places like the metros and malls do not have any accessibility for people with disabilities. Another woman named Sunaina said that her sister is disabled as well but there are no good schools near her home. She has to travel a long distance to take her sister to school. All the leaders were aggressively discussing the RPWD Act 2016. Arman Ali NCPEDP Director said that, there is a 4% reservation for people with disabilities but the government is not clear about its execution. The private companies in cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, etc. follow the rules. In rural areas people know the disability rules but they completely ignore it. Mr AS Narayanan said that there are very few interpreters and many do not know sign language. He has urged everyone to sign a petition on change.org to make India Sign language the 23rd official language of India in the Constitution.

You all are aware that Reliance Industries Chairman, Mukesh Ambani is world’s 10th richest man. Recently, he received several death threats on a phone call. Shocking! Let me tell you. One of the call center employee at Sir HN Reliance Foundation Hospital received 9 calls from an unknown person. The call center received the first call at 10.39 am in which the caller abused the person who received the call and gave death threats to Mukesh Ambani. The employee disconnected the call. However, between 10.39am to 12.05pm the call center received 9 such calls which threatened to kill Mukesh Ambani. In one of the calls, the caller identified himself as Afzal. The hospital staff then reported the threat calls to the DB Marg police station. The police immediately started investigating the recordings of the phone call. Police traced the calls to North Mumbai. The found that the person was not Afzal. His real name was Vishnu Vidhu Bhowmik, a  jeweller from South Mumbai. They traced his house in Borivali. The police reached his home and found the 56 year old Bhowmik at home. The police arrested him and filed a case under section section 506(II) of IPC which is related to threat to cause death or serious hurt or to cause the destruction of property by fire. The offence is punishable with imprison­ment of up to seven years, or with a fine, or both. Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Neelotpal found the calls to be strange. He said that Bhowmik is a native of Tripura and has been living in Borivali, Mumbai for the last 30 years with his family. He is a jeweller. He was sent for a medical test to know his state of mind and thereafter investigation would continue. There is a suspicion. A person had filed a PIL in the Tripura High Court, which then asked the Central government to provide details of the Y and Z level security provided to Ambani and his wife as he is not a government official and is a businessman. According to the Central government, providing security was under their purview. The Central Government challenged the Tripura High Court's order in the Supreme Court on the basis that it had nothing to do with Tripura Court. Supreme Court refused High Court's claim and stayed the High Court’s order which asked the Central Government for details. Are these related incidents? Is Bhoumik the same person who filed PIL? It is not clear as yet. There is suspicion that Bhoumik may have made the threat calls as he was upset. This is the second threat that Ambani has received. Do you remember that 18 months back in February 2021, an explosive laden car was parked outside Ambani house, Antilia Now this is the second threat given on a phone call. Do you know why he is threatened? Does he have some problem? Let us know in comments.

I am sure you have seen daily soaps about childhood sweethearts. The characters dump their girlfriends and the girls are left inconsolable. We have always enjoyed the shows where these girls gatecrash their ex's wedding. You may think this happens only in reel life. However something very similar has happened in real life! A couple of months back, a guy was in a relationship with a girl. He then went to another city to earn money and the girl supported him. Making most out of the situation in his absence, the family of the bride who did not like the guy, fixed her marriage to someone else. The girl tried to convince her parents, but they did not listen to her. When the boy caught wind of this, he gate crashed the wedding when the couple were exchanging garlands. The boy barged in between them and forcefully smeared the girl's head with sindoor. People were shocked and the groom stood frozen to the spot. A video of this incident went viral on social media. Have a look. Did you see the video? Strange it could happen in real life. The girl’s family was later seen beating up the guy. The family called the police and the boy was arrested. The bride was finally married to the groom. I am sure you love watching jilted lovers reuniting in movies and daily soaps. This is, however, not the first of such incidents by far. A boy from Madhya Pradesh’s Hoshangabad and a girl from Kanpur had been in a live in relationship for 3 years. However he dumped the girl because his family had liked someone else. She went to the wedding venue but was stopped by the boy's family. She weeping and pleaded them to stop the wedding as she loved him. The marriage continued but she continued to weep and wanted to enter the venue. She screamed pleaded to stop the wedding as she loved him and they were living together for 3 years. The boy's family then called the police and she was taken away.

The Maharashtra state government has made it compulsory to wear masks in public. Any person not wearing masks is being heavily fined. However, the prices of masks in the market vary. There is no fixed price. Each seller has the liberty to decide the price of their mask. Since there is no regulation in pricing, people are not able to buy masks. The Maharashtra State Government has now set up a committee to give suggestions about regulating prices of face Masks and Sanitisers. The committee has now submitted its recommendations to Maharashtra Health Minister Rajesh Tope. Let me tell you the recommendations. Currently the N-95 masks are being sold at exorbitant prices in the market. The committee recommends, that the N-95 mask be priced at around ₹ 19 - ₹ 50 depending on the type and quality of masks. While the one time use, double and triple layer masks should be sold for ₹ 3 - ₹ 4. The rates for these masks have been finalized after the committee performed a detailed study of the cost of manufacturing, raw material, salary of staff, availibility of material, affordability, demand for masks in the market, etc. After studying all these factors they proposed their recommendation for pricing N-95, double & triple layer masks . Once the government approves the rates, everyone has to follow this pricing while selling their masks. This will ensure the masks are affordable to all. Now Maharashtra is the first state to take such a step.

When details about Mumbai Police officer Sachin Vaze’s involvement in the Ambani house bomb scare and Mansukh Hiren’s death came out, there were many accusations of corruption against the Mumbai police and the Maharashtra government. Because of this the Mumbai Police Commissioner Param Bir Singh was transferred to the Home Guards. Angry over his transfer, Singh wrote an eight-page letter to Maharashtra Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray. In the letter he alleged that Maharashtra Home Minister Anil Deshmukh had asked Sachin Vaze & other cops to extort Rs 100 crore per month for him from restaurants, pubs, hotels and other establishments in Mumbai. NCP Chief Sharad Pawar held two press conferences defending Deshmukh, who is a member of his party. Singh then petitioned the Bombay High Court asking for CBI inquiry against Deshmukh’s malpractises. The High Court said that since these were unprecedented charges against the Home Minister, they have directed the CBI to initiate an enquiry and complete it within 15 days. The Maharashtra government is formed with an alliance of Shiv Sena - NCP - Congress. since the allegations of corruption were causing the Maharashtra government a lot embarassment, the Shiv Sena and Congress were pushing for Deshmukh's resignation. But the NCP dug its heels in, defending Deshmukh. Inorder to avoid futher embarassment that would follow the CBI probe, he decide to resign. Soon after he quit, Deshmukh left for New Delhi where he held consultations with lawyers. Deshmukh is expected to file an appeal in the Supreme Court to challenge the HC order of the CBI investigation against him. Dilip Walse-Patil, is the new Home Minister. He was Maharashtra's State Minister of Labour and Excise. Patil is a close confidant of Pawar and has served as his personal assistant. Now he is the Home Minister.

You would have seen many salaried people taking leave from office for wedding or travelling, holidays, or to spend time with their families etc. They apply for leave then go their holidays. Eventhough the person is on leave, the office might call them for some work stating that work is important. Unwillingly the person does the work but then misses out on the holiday fun. Many have to keep their families waiting till they finish their work on Email or Whatsapp etc. Many face this type of disturbance by office colleagues during their holidays. However, Dream11 company is trying to bring a resolution to this problem. Dream 11 was founded in 2008 by Harsh Jain and Bhavit Seth. The founders thought about and announced a policy. When a Dream 11 employee went on a holiday, their colleagues disturbed them by repeatedly calling them. Since the employee is on holiday and enjoying, such calls spoilt their holiday mood. This in turn affects the productivity and they tend to make mistakes as they are not in work mood. The employee cannot focus on work. Better not to disturb. Secondly, it would be that the office is dependent on the employee. In order to stop this dependence, the founders thought of an unplug policy. Which has been named as Dream 11 Unplug. Plug in means 'to connect'. Unplug means 'to disconnect' Similarly when an employee goes on leave, for a week in a year, they would unplug or disconnect from the compnay's work. This is to try and reduce the dependence on the employee and also to let the employee enjoy and spend time with family. The aim is to make other employees take responsibility for the work and reduce the dependence on a particular employee. So, they came up this solution and announced the same. If any co-worker reaches out to another employee during the Unplug or leave time, then he/she has to pay a fine of Rs 1 lakh rupees. No excuses would be accepted as there are backup plans ready and the person has to pay the fine. A co-worker can call up a colleague who is on leave to talk about their wellbeing. However if the call is work related, they will have to pay a fine of Rs 1 Lakh. The founders want employees to work independently and reduce dependence on each other. The aim is also to let the employee enjoy their holiday Do you want your company to stop disturbing you during holiday? then suggest the solution that is being followed by Dream 11. Some might not agree for the betterment of the company. Let us know your thoughts in the comments.

Mumbai is known for heavy rains. Every year during the rainy season there is water logging, delayed trains and people have to walk through floods. Vehicles are stucks in massive traffic jams for hours due to the floods. This happens every year. During the rains you may order food but how will the delivery agents travel in the floods? You may think its impossible because of the difficulty. Now here is a strange story. A resident of Mumbai placed an order on food delivery app Swiggy. It was raining very heavily in Mumbai and travelling by two-wheeler was impossible. The delivery agent picked up the food and since there were floods, he delivered the food on horseback. He galloped away splashing water everywhere. Someone recorded a video of this and it went viral on social media. People were shocked to see a delivery agent on horseback! One user admired the delivery agent's hardwork and his creativity in finding a different delivery option. One user jokingly wrote, “Now this is what I call ‘Shahi delivery'”. Another user said, “I hope he is not delivering pizza, as it would become soggy in the rain. A Swiggy executive saw the video and asked people to help find the delivery agent. Swiggy even announced a Rs. 5000 cash reward to anyone who will let them know about this man riding the horse. The amount will be directly credited to the user's Swiggy wallet in the Swiggy app. However they haven't found the man yet. They also said that they have a few questions for the man in the video. They have questions like “Who is he? Is he young? “Why did he use a horse to deliver food? What is the horse's name? From where to where was the delivery made? Who had placed the order and what were the contents of the order? These are the types of questions Swiggy wants to ask the man and have asked people to help them find him.

Many people love their pet cats, dogs, parrots, etc. They talk to them. The animals follow their master's commands. Pets are trustworthy and loyal. They only follow their master. Pets give peace in stressful situations. People talk to their pets, but people signing to their pets is never heard of. A video of a man communicating with his cat has recently gone viral. A man is seen sitting at the table and eating when his cat taps him and signs that it wants to eat as well. The man then feeds the cat. The video of the two went viral. People were shocked and wondered how the cat learnt sign language. People were shocked but the man wasn't surprised at all as being deaf it was normal for him to communicate this way. People were astonished. It is lovely to learn signing, isn't it? Now is a time when everyone should learn sign language to communicate with deaf and hearing. A cat too is learning sign language. Wonderful! Everyone must learn sign language as it will be beneficial for the future. Sign Language can be learnt by people of any age. Whenever you are at a barber or in a salon, have you seen a whitish semi-transparent crystal? Do you know its name?  Yes! I’m talking about Alum. It is also known as Fitkari. In India, people used to use it a lot in the olden days but not anymore. We use it as it has many benefits. But what is Alum? And what are its benefits? It is composed of potassium, aluminum, hydrogen, sulfur and oxygen. Alum is a salt found in nature. It is found in different sizes. You can consume it in the raw form or once it is processed. It is found in Bihar, Punjab, Nepal and the Kathiawar area. Apart from these parts of India it is also found in Egypt, Italy, England, and Germany. It has great antibacterial properties. Rubbing Alum on cuts, helps to heal it. It also has antiplatelets properties. Thus it is used on wounds. How useful! Due to its high antibacterial properties, Fitkari is a common ingredient in many many medicines. It is also used in cosmetics, skincares and many other products. 1. You all use after-shave for shaving. When you cut yourseld during shaving use Alum it will be very helful. It also ensures that there is no infection. Wow! As we grow older, above the age of 50, wrinkles appear on the skin. Fitkari can help maintain natural skin tone, skin tightness and makes you look youthful. You can rub Alum on your underarm, it reduces odour producing bacteria on our skin. If your underarms become black then applying alum will remove the blackness. Many roll-on deodorant have Fitkari as one of their main raw materials. How useful! 3.If you have dandruff or lice in your hair, Alum will help to get rid of it. Mix a pinch of Alum in your shampoo, and apply it to your hair, twice a week, it will help you in removing dandruff & lice from your hair. For removing lice from your scalp, mix some Alum powder and oil. Apply this mixture to your hair and wash after some time. 4.If you suffer from bad breath, Alum is useful. Take 1 gram of alum and a pinch of rock salt dissolve in a glass of warm water and gargle. However, it can cause nausea and vomiting, so avoid drinking it. So it can be used to treat bad breath. If you have bleeding gums, weak teeth or dental cavities then Alum can help you with that too. Rubbing the paste of 1 gram of alum and some rock salt & rinsing your mouth out can help with your dental issues. 6.Fitkari is often used to heal post-operative wounds better and faster.  It is mixed in water and applied to the affected areas. Its antibacterial and antiplatelets properties help heal the wound more efficiently and stop infections. 7. Water these days has a lot of impurities. All you have to simply do is add a little Alum to the water and all the solid impurities willabsorbed by it. The water can be heated to eliminate any remaining bacteria. Then you can drink it. 8. It is used as a kitchen cleaner. Keep the block in warm water for 5-10 minutes, remove it and then soak a cloth in the water and then clean your countertops with it. Your counters will be smell good and look spotless. Now that you know the benefits of Alum, do not ignore it and use it!

They continued to grow slowly, becoming longer and longer.” While she consulted many doctors to know the reason behind her growing eyelashes, they were unable to find an explanation. She thought maybe it is genetic but no one in her family had such long eyelashes. She said, “I remembered that I had spent over 480 days in the mountain, years ago. So, I told myself that my eyelashes must be a blessing given by the Buddha.” She added, “There might be some connections between my long eyelashes and a stronger body. When I was a child I was very weak. Now because of my eyelashes, I feel quite good and many people think I look younger.” Thanks to the eyelashes, she does not need to wear Kajal. When asked whether the eyelashes caused her discomfort, she said, “They bring only joys, no trouble. A 28 year old Deaf artist had a dream to meet Prime Minister Modi. His dream actually got fulfilled on 23rd July 2022 when he finally got a chance to meet the PM. He met PM Modi along with Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma. Let me tell you how. A couple of months back the 28 year old Deaf artist, Abhijeet Gotani and his mother traveled from Silchar, Assam to Guwahati to meet Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma to present a painting to him. The Chief Minister was highly impressed by the painting done by the Deaf artist. Abhijeet expressed his desire to meet the Prime Minister. The CM politely listened and after Abhijeet left, he wrote a letter to Prime Minister's Office. In the letter he had stated that a 28 year old Abhijeet is an amazing Deaf person and wants to meet the Prime Minister. The PMO replied with an appointment. Abhijeet was happy. The appointment was fixed for 23rd July 2022. Along with his mother, Abhijeet reached Delhi and so did CM Sarma. Abhijeet was overwhelmed seeing PM Modi in real life standing in front of him. Abhijeet gifted a special painting to PM Modi, who loved it. The painting has a series of images showcasing Prime Minister's childhood, the PM speaking at the UNGA and many other beautiful poses. Seeing the painting, PM modi patted Abhijeet's back Abhijeet said in Sign Language which his mother translated, I always had a dream to meet PM Modi and today my dream is fulfilled. Every day I see PM Modi on television and wanted to meet him and finally today I met him in person. He is a very soft-hearted and simple person and I am very happy to meet him. Abhijeet’s mother said,  "I could see and feel the joy in his heart when the Prime Minister patted his back PM Modi is known for motivating skilled and talented youngters, who have then achieved greats heights. I am sure, this will motivate my son to do better.”

Many people suffer from organ failure were their heart, kidneys, liver, etc stop functioning. They require an organ transplant which is no easy feat. A person suffering from heart failure can not use any random heart for a transplant. A perfect heart that matches the patients heart size, blood group, etc need to be found. Only when the perfect match is found can the transplant be done. Finding the perfect kidney is also not easy. The same goes for liver and other organs. It can take 3-5 years to find the perfect match. Some murder people to steal their organs and sell them for many. This happens across the world. An organ transplant is never easy. Doctors across the world have been working for decades to use animal organs for transplants, but it has always failed. However, recently doctors in the USA have performed a miraculous transplant surgery. A pig kidney has been transplanted into a female and the surgery was a successful! Let me tell you about it! The NYU Langone Health in New York City created a genetically altered pig was created using In vitro fertilization techniques. This altered embryo is inserted in the female. This piglet which is genetically altered are known as GalSafe pigs. They were developed to be used for transplant in humans. It is also used as food by people who have meat allergies. These are the 2 special properties of the pig. A woman was brain dead. When a person is brain dead their heart is beating but the body is unable to breathe on its own. Many religious places in India, be is churches, mosques or temples have loudspeakers installed on the top. Some governments have already taken strict action for fixing the volume of loudspeakers or completely removing them so that it does not disturb anyone. The Uttar Pradesh government has so far removed 11,000 speakers from religious premises and many other state governments have taken strict actions. However no such steps are yet taken in Maharashtra. Raj Thackrey the founder of Maharshtra Navinirman Sena (MNS) who is also a cousin of Maharashtra’s Chief Minister Uddhav Thackrey has repeatedly asked the Shiv Sena government to lower the volume or remove the loudspeakers from mosques and has warned that if his demand is ignored, his party workers will start playing Hanuman Chalisa on loudspeakers near the mosque in higher volume. Now Maharashtra’s ex Chief Minister and BJP Leader Devendra Fadnavis has jumped into the controversy that you are aware has been going since long. He said that the Ram Janam Bhoomi in Ayodhya was forcefully captured by mughals after which the masjid was constructed named the “Babri Masjid ''. It was then claimed back by the Hindus. This controversy has been on for several years. “'Yes, I was there when Babri Masjid was demolished, not Shiv Sena,' Let me tell you about it. It is believed that Lord Ram was born in Ayodhya. The old temple was demolished by the moghuls and the Babri Masjid was built on it. You are aware about the dangerous controversy that went on with the Hindus claiming it to the birth place of Ram and the Muslim claiming that originally it was always a masjid. The Hindus along with political parties and its leaders, demolished the masjid. The Muslim community was upset with this and it was matter of contention for years. You are aware that Supreme Court ordered that it was Lord Ram's birth place and that the Babri Masjid would be built on another 5 acre plot elsewhere. Devendra Fadnavis has now said that he was a part of the controversy surrounding the Babri Masjid and not Shiv Sena. All throughout the years, Shiv Sena has claimed its involvement in order to gain massive support of the hindu voters. Fadnavis, while addressing a BJP rally, claimed that no Shiv Sena leader was there at that time. Fadnavis said that the Shiv Sena leaders are scared to even remove loudspeakers from the mosques while the UP government brought down 11,000 loudspeakers then why not Maharashtra government. If they were really involved in demolishing the Babri Masjid, they would have been brave enough to ban loudspeakers. They are just saying this to gain votes. Shiv Sena MP Sanjay Raut on 29th April alleged that efforts were on to separate Mumbai from Maharashtra and make it into a Union Territory and bring in the Centre's rule in the city. You are aware that UTs like Delhi, Lakshwdeep, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Puducherry, Daman and Diu, Ladakh, Jammu and Kashmir are directly controlled by the Central government. Mumbai is a part of Maharashtra. They want to separate it and make it a UT which will be better. Raut further alleged that former BJP MP Kirit Somaiya and a group of party leaders, builders, and businessmen were part of this “conspiracy”. These people have made a presentation to the union home ministry. Raut said that Mumbai has always been a part of Maharashtra and will remain so. He further alleged that PM Modi takes all international dignitaries to Gujarat while Mumbai is “completely ignored". Mumbai is the business capital along with it being a historic place. PM Modi takes all of them to Gujarat as he wants to promote the Modi model. Why is Mumbai, Maharashtra being ignored. Shiv Sena also criticised and felt insulted with the inaugural Lata Deenanath Mangeshkar Award which have been instituted in memory of the legendary singer. The award would be given each year to only one individual with path-breaking, spectacular contributions to the society. The first Lata Deenanath Mangeshkar Award was awarded to PM Modi for his exemplary work for the development of the country. But it was an insult to Shiv Sena as Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray was not invited to the function. Union minister and senior BJP leader Narayan Rane dismissed the claims and said that Shiv Sena floats such rumours. There is no iota of truth in the claims. BJP also said that Shiv Sena is used to creating back to back controversies.

In Delhi on 10th April 2022, when the entire country was celebrating Ram Navami, a celebration was also held in the JNU campus. At the same time, there was also an iftar party that was held on the same day. But tensions had begun on the campus at around 4 pm. There was a violent fight between two groups of students – JNUSU and ABVP members. Both sides have accused each other of pelting stones, flower pots and injuring their members. The staff were unable to stop the fight. The police were called to the campus and they stopped the fight. JNUSU has alleged that the ABVP members assaulted the mess secretary and stopped the staff from serving meat dishes in the canteen and make vegetarian dinner menu. The ABVP claimed that Members of left organizations tried to stop a Pooja from being organized. There is a lot of confusion over the two stories and the police have promised to investigate the matter. The last major incident of violence in JNU had taken place on 5 January 2020 when around 100 masked persons had gone inside the campus and beat up people. Students, teachers and staff, including JNUSU president Aishe Ghosh were injured. We had shared the news earlier, check it out here on YouTube. An FIR had been registered but no arrests were made. The woman said that she was on her period and went to her mother's house. When they had sexual intercourse, the man was shocked to find that no presence of a vaginal opening and found she had a small penis, like a child. The man later took his wife for a medical check-up and told the doctor that his wife is actually a man as she had a penis. During her check up it was found that she has a medical condition. She has "Imperforate hymen & Congenital adrenal hyperplasia". The man was stunned that she did not inform earlier as he could have cancelled the marriage. Or he would have accepted. She should have been honest. So what is imperforate hymen & congenital adrenal hyperplasia? So What is a Hymen? It is a layer that partially covers the women’s vagina and stays intact till she becomes an adult. After the woman has sexual intercourse the hymen tears and bleeds. Now coming back to the condition of imperforate hymen, it is a condition where the hymen fully covers the front part of the vaginal opening which results in the vaginal opening being blocked. Now what is Congenital adrenal hyperplasia. A woman's private parts include the Clitoris - the female erogenous organs, the urinary tracts, vagina and the rectum. You all know this. In this condition, the female's clitoris is enlarged & the private part of the woman looks like the private part of a male child. The man felt cheated and called his father-in-law, asking him to take his daughter back as he was not told about this earlier. The woman had surgery and then returned to her husband after her father forcefully entered his house and threatened the man to keep her. The man later filed a complaint with the police and approached the court seeking a divorce. The complaint was filed in the Gwalior bench of the Madhya Pradesh High Court. The man told them everything. The court said, we can’t believe anything just because someone is saying it, there is no evidence. This is why the complaint was dismissed. He challenged the verdict in the surpreme court and submitted all the medical documents of his wife. The apex court went through the petition and the man’s lawyer Senior Advocate N.K Mody said, this is purely a case of cheating where his client was not told about this condition and was cheated to get married to a male. The International Criminal Court is situated in Hague, Netherlands. You all know that the Russia Ukraine war that began in February 2022 is still going on and there is no end to it. The ICC issued arrest warrant against Russian President Putin for his wrongdoings. ICC said that it is clear that Putin had asked Maria Lvova-Belova to kidnap Ukrainian children and teenagers and take them to Russia. Many Ukrainian parents' children went missing. Though Russia is a member in the UN and NATO, it is not a member of the ICC. if Russia would have been a member, ICC had the power to arrest Putin. Since, Russia is not a member, ICC has no authority. Like Russia, USA and India too are not members of the ICC. Russia did agree that it is at war with Ukraine, but has denied the allegations of kidnapping children. The ICC then said, "There are 123 member countries in ICC. Putin would be arrested if he sets foot in any of these 123 countries. We can't arrest him in Russia as it is not a member country. But will wait and watch. Putin is not bothered by this and has still continued the war. Meanwhile, US President Joe Biden applauded ICC's decision of issuing an arrest warrant against Putin. However many were shocked by this gesture. People said the US was silent when they committed war crimes in Afghanistan and Iraq. When the same was pointed out by the ICC, the US blatantly rejected their authority. Now the Americans play hypocrites by applauding the ICC's decision to arrest Putin. People said the Americans are supporting the ICC because Russia is their enemy. Now ICC will wait and watch. let's wait for further updates.

There are many wealthy businessmen who are not as well known who invite moviestars like Salman Khan, Shah Rukh Khan to their weddings. How do they know each other? Do you think the celebs attend these events out of politeness only because the host is rich? However, this is not at all the case! These wealthy individuals pay celebrities to attend their events. Yes they do pay them! These celebrities do not know each other but the families invite them to increase the prestige of the families. The celebrities are paid to take photos & dance at the event. You all must be shocked by this! Do you think they are paid 50,000 or a few lakhs? That's not the case. They are paid crores of rupees. Do you want to know more, wait I will tell you. Have a look at these celebrities dancing at events. Did you see that? Wasn't that stunning! You must enjoy watching these celebs at such events. I am sure if you had the money, you would surely love to invite celebrities to entertain guests at a family wedding. Do you think all actors charge the same price? They all have their own rates. When you invite a celebrity to a wedding function, what do they do? Well they sing, dance, take pictures and enjoy at the event. Let me tell you what their prices are. Katrina Kaif charges Rs 3 crore. Hrithik Roshan charges Rs 2.5 crore. Priyanka Chopra charges Rs 2.5 crore. Akshay Kumar charges Rs 2 crore. Ranbir Kapoor charges Rs 2 crore. Salman Khan charges Rs 2 crore. Ranveer Singh charges Rs 1 crore. While his wife Deepika Padukone also charges Rs 1 crore. Shah Rukh Khan who is known as the King of Bollywood charges Rs 3 crore. In an interview Shah Rukh was asked why he attends wedding when he is well to do and has a happy family. Shah Rukh said that he is an actor and dearly loved by his fans. Whenever he is paid to attend functions by anyone, he does not feel ashamed as it is his job. Just like my fans show me love, I do the same and give them happiness by attending their events. He does this for his family. In the future who knows I may not remain as wealthy as I am today. I might be in huge trouble. I am saving to prepare for such a calamity. I am sure you found this information very interesting. If you had the money to invite a celebrity to your family wedding, who would you invite? Let us know in the comments!

Today I will talk about the double-money scam. Suyo Abhi Enterprises & Platinium Investment and Finance Global Solutions comprised of a team of 6 Deaf individuals who have all been arrested. You all know this. ISH News has released multiple videos about this in the past. You can check these out by clicking on the description box below on YouTube where you will find 3 links. Click on those for the entire story. On facebook click on the description box on top for the entire story. Now there is an update in this news. Many Deaf investors who lost their money, sent in applications to the Pune police. The police have all these in record. The police also received demand drafts from investors who profited in the scam. All these demand drafts of the profit money and the application letters have been handed over to the court. Since the news is out of the limelight, the Deaf Community has been waiting for an update in the matter. Are the 6 Deaf people still in jail? Are they out on bail? What is happening? Now let me tell you that these 6 Deaf individuals are still in jail. They are in Pune's Yerwada. None of them have been given bail. The police have in file all the complaints sent by the Deaf. All the demand drafts have been presented in court. Now I am sure you want to know about the newspaper article circulating on whatsApp about the Pune police's claim of having Rs 1 crore. What is this about? ISH team read the article and spoke to police officer Amol Kale. I will now tell you all the details shared by him and the information from the newspaper. Mr Kale has said that, 'I received many letters and met many Deaf individuals in person. 467 complaint letters are on file. A list of investors who sustained losses was given to the court. Out of the 467 complainants, 60 investors profited from the scam. When these 60 investors heard about the arrests, the scam, they returned their profits. Till now the police have collected demand drafts worth Rs 1 crore. All the demand drafts that were made in the name of District Judge Pune have been handed over to the court. The names of the investors who incurred losses have also been submitted to the court. The police are genuinely happy that the 60 investors willingly came forward with the profits. Also another genuine fact is that, these 60 investors are from financially weak backgrounds. They don't hold high positions like officers, businessman, etc. They are carpenters, plumbers, etc. All of them had invested in the scheme. When they heard about the scam, they realised money was never invested in the share market. The money was rolling within the community and the Deaf were duped by the Deaf. One of them personally met the police and handed over the demand draft. The DD was only for Rs 4,000. The police told him not to return the money as it was a nominal amount, the Deaf man said that this is wrong. He wanted the police to return the money to the Deaf who are suffering. He does not want to profit from such scam. The police were shocked. Someone returned Rs 1,500, Rs 1,000, Rs 2,500, etc. Those who earned profits like Rs 80,000 also returned the money. All of these small amounts, have come to a total of Rs 1 crore. The Rs 1 crore has been given to court but that amount is nothing compared to the large chunk lost by the investors. Once both the amounts are equal, it can be used to return the money to the investors. The police requests the other investors in India who profitted from the double money scam to return the money. It will help to relieve many Deaf from their suffering. Please understand this and return the money. Many Deaf refuse to do this as there is no law to force them to return the money. Are you trying to find loopholes? Ok. When SAE & PIFGS created advertisements about the double money scam, did you check whether they are RBI or government recognised. No you blindly invested without checking. Now when the cops are asking for the money, you will question us about the law? You need to understand that money were never invested in the share market. The money was taken from one Deaf person and given as double to the other. Like this the money was circulated. Are you happy to see Deaf people lose money? These people suffered to save every penny. You may be least bothered and blame SAE & PIFGS for the scam advertisments. But no! You need to understand that those 6 Deaf lied and duped everyone. Return the money. Deaf should support the Deaf. Please try to make DD and return the money. If you don't pay it. okay. The police will investigate the matter and find all the investors. Now wait and see what action they take.

Urmila Matondkar told the media, “Shiv Sena's women's wing is very strong. Urmila said I am very happy to be involved in it. She said I am proud to be a part of Mumbai and wish to work on women's and children's issues. Urmila has been open in talking about issues like Citizenship Amendment Act, on actor Kangana Ranaut for comparing Mumbai with Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) and about nepotism issue in movies. Hyderabad and other parts of Telangana have received heavy rainfall. The streets in Hyderabad were flooded, cars floated in the water, and 15 people died. There were power cuts in several areas. This is the first time since 1903 that Hyderabad witnessed so much rain on 13th October 2020 and by 14th October 8:30 am the rainfall had doubled. The MeT department responsible for monitoring the weather issued, a yellow alert for Hyderabad which means everyone needs to be alert and keep an eye on weather updates. People were asked to stay indoors and the state government declared a holiday on 14th and 15th October. NDRF and SDRF which are disaster management teams helped evacuate people from the floods. Tolichowki Nadeem colony was flooded and over 600 people from 170 homes were rescued using boats. There were many pictures and videos of the damage caused by rains on social media. Cars drowned in the rainwater in some areas. Trees and electrical poles were uprooted as well. In a video a man was seen being washed away by the floodwater in the heavy rains. He tried holding on to anything to save himself, but the strong currents drove him away. Eye-witnesses screamed but the fear kept them away from helping the man. Last night a compound wall collapsed killing 9 people and a two-month-old baby. The situation in Telangana is being closely monitored by CM K Chandrasekhar Rao. In Andhra Pradesh, 10 people died due to rain-related incidents in the last 48 hours. Chief Minister Jagan Mohan Reddy held a high-level meeting and also ordered compensation for the families. Madhya Maharashtra, south Konkan, Goa, and Coastal and North Karnataka must also be ready for the downpour as the depression has moved westward. The IMD has issued a warning to these places.

Mr. Alok Kumar​, Chief Administrative Office of Northern Railway, said that, this project of the IRCTC is one of the most difficult and will take a long time to execute. You all know about Kingfisher Airlines head honcho Vijay Mallya, who defaulted on a loan of Rs 9,000 crore and fled to United Kingdom. You know that he is in the UK for all this time. The Indian banks and the government have been trying to recover the defaulted amount and had filed a case in the UK High Court demanding that Mallya be sent back to India. This case has been going for three years. He was earlier arrested by the police but has been let out on bail. Now UK court is thinking about whether to allow Mallya to stay in the UK or send him back to India. After getting bail, Mallya has been living in a luxurious bungalow in London. It is one of the most expensive & luxurious properties named Cornwall Terrace Apartment. Mallya and his family-mother Lalitha who is 95 years old and son Sidhartha were staying there. It`s believed that Mallya and his family own numerous other properties in the UK and elsewhere. However, in 2012 Mallya took a loan of 20.4 million pounds - about Rs 185.4 crore - from UBS bank which is a Swiss Bank. In return, he mortgaged the Cornwall Terrace Apartment. In 2017, the loan expired and the loan was not paid. The bank filed a case in court demanding that Mallya be evicted and the house be given to the bank. He was given a deadline of April 2020 to pay the amount otherwise he would be evicted. He again failed to pay the amount back. You all must be going on holidays with your family, your kids but many of us feel uncomfortable leaving our pet dog and cat behind. We are always tensed and hate leaving them behind. People consider pets their family but flights do not allow pets onboard. Now they will be allowed! Stunned? Akasa airlines by Rakesh Jhunjhunwala You all know him as the famous sharemarket tycoon. Sadly he passed away. His Akasa airlines will now allow pet dogs and cats on their flights. Wow! I am sure you are happy but you have to pay some fees for the same. The fee amount to take the pets onboard the Akasa Air flights would be announced shortly. However there are certain rules. Pets should weigh not more than 7 kgs. Pets above 7kg will be allowed in cargo. The first flight with pets takes off on 1st of November. The bookings for the same will start from 15 October. I am sure you are very happy to travel with your pets. However remember only pet dogs and cats will be allowed and they must be vaccinated. Akasa Air has become the second commercial Indian carrier to permit passengers to travel with their pets. Air India had imposed all the rules before. Aksa has become the second. How amazing! Currently, it has a fleet of six planes and the number is expected to touch 18 by March next year. The airline also plans to launch international operations in 2023. First time something like that has happened! Are you happy with this decision? Or do you want large dogs to travel with you as well? Let us know in the comments.

In a shocking incident, on 9th January 2022 in the Haveri district of Karnataka a branch of Canara bank caught fire. You may be thinking that it would be an accident. No, it was set on fire by a man. Shocking! The man has been arrested and has been identified as Wasim Hazaratsab Mulla. During interrogation he confessed that he had submitted an application to the bank to secure a loan. The bank later rejected his application because CIBIL score is calculated on the payment history of a loan. If someone takes a loan and is irregular in repaying it, the CIBIL score is poor. The man's application was rejected due to low CIBIL score. Angered by the bank's decision, the accused reached the bank’s branch late at night broke open a window, jumped in, spilled petrol inside the bank’s office and then set it on fire. The villagers saw smoke coming out from the bank and called the fire brigade. They also caught the accused and handed him over to the police where he confessed to his crime. The police were stunned with his madness. In the bank computers, cash counting machine, passbook printer, CCTVs, and many other things were all destroyed all amounting to losses worth Rs. 12 lakh FIR has been filed and accused has been arrested.
