IDCA is the Indian Deaf Cricket Association. It was formerly known as Deaf Cricket Society (DCS) but was renamed to IDCA. Sumit Jain - sign name - is the President, IDCA and Ajay Kumar - sign name - is the General Secretary, IDCA. IDCA has sent Indian teams to various International tournaments and hosted many games in India as well. Let me tell you about them. The Bangladesh Deaf Cricket Association in Dhaka, hosted a Deaf T-20 Tri Series International Cricket from Sept. 2018 between India, Bangladesh & Pakistan. IDCA had organised the Deaf-ICC T20 World Cup 2018 in Gurugram sponsored by Star Sports. In the final Match, Sri Lanka beat India and won the World Cup. From 11th to 15th November 2019 at Rohtak, Haryana Haryana Deaf Cricket Association hosted the 4th T-20 National Cricket Championship League for Deaf. The match was won by Maharashtra. From 24th Nov to 5th Dec 2019 in South Africa, the Deaf Cricket South Africa hosted, International Deaf Cricket Series. When South Africa won and India lost the final. From 28th January to 3rd February 2020, Sri Lanka Deaf Cricket Association hosted the International Deaf Cricket Series. The finals were played by India and Sri Lanka. Sri Lanka won the match. Women 2nd T-20 National Cricket Championship for Deaf was held between 9th to 12th February 2020 in Hyderabad. It was hosted by Telangana Deaf Cricket Association. Various states participated but Maharashtra's women team emmerged victorious. The IDCA is a full member of Deaf International Cricket Council (DICC) and is working closely with them. Stefan Pichowski - sign name - is the Chairman Deaf-ICC & M. ZahirUddin Babar - sign name - is the CEO Deaf-ICC. Many countries around the world are members of DICC. Have a look. DICC also received new interest from Cricket Association for Deaf Qatar, to join DICC membership list. The DICC Cricket ODI World Cup was going to be held in November 2020 but it has been postponed to February-March 2022 due to rising cases of COVID-19. In 2016 the DICC held the DICC Championship in UAE. Pakistan beat England in the Finals. In New Delhi from 1st - 5th March 2021 IDCA will host, the "2nd ODI National Zone Cricket Championship League for Deaf". Depending on players performance in the zonal tournament, selections will be made for DICC World Cup. However, if another lockdown is imposed, the tournament will be postponed. If there is no lockdown, the matches will be held.

A 19-year-old Zomato food delivery agent has tested positive for coronavirus in Delhi. He was delivering food till last Sunday 12th April. Since he tested positive he has been admitted in the hospital. In the last 15 days that he worked, he delivered food to 75 families in areas like Hauz Khas, Malviya Nagar and Savitri Nagar in Delhi. These 75 families have been quarantined and door-to-door health checks are being performed by the authorities. Seventeen delivery boys also came in contact with the boy and have been quarantined in Chattarpur. The restaurant where the rider worked has shut the branch for 14 days. Officials say, the delivery boy doesn't have any travel history and they suspect he may have caught the virus while delivering food to an infected family. The Indian government allowed food delivery services to help during lockdown as people can't get out of their house. Lakhs of people in India are dependent on such delivery services.

Instead he focusses on understanding matter, making reforms in education and eventually became an engineer. The character was inspired by a real live person, Sonam Wangchuk. Wangchuk filmed a video against the backdrop of the Himalayas. Which has now gone viral on Twitter and WhatsApp. He spoke about Indians boycotting Chinese Apps and products. According to Wangchuk we are all aware about the tensions at the Indo-China LAC. Do you think the Chinese military has only targetted India? China has engaged in military conflict with India as well as Hong Kong, Taiwan and Vietnam. He said 140 crore Chinese population is very unhappy with the Chinese government. This is because of the Chinese government's failure in handling the COVID outbreak The 140 crore population was prepared to protest against the government. Fearing a revolt from the angry population, to distract its people, the Chinese government is engaging in military conflict with countries across the world. This was divert the people's attention from the true problems of China. Mr Wangchuk said that, if India wants to defeat China, then we do not need to use arms and amunition. Instead we must use our 'Wallet Power'. What does Wallet Power mean? China manufactures things such as laptops, mobiles, cheap clothes, etc. They also make many Apps. India must stop purchasing these. This will destabilise their sales. TikTok is the most downloaded App by the youth of the country. China has earnt crores through this. When there is a war between Indian and Chinese armies, Indian citizens are supporting China by buying their products and Apps. China then redirects all this money to fight with the Indian army. Chinese products must be boycotted. We need to stop buying Chinese products and try to reduce their sales. Due to their reduced sales in India, their economy will easily tank. When the Chinese citizens see this, they will revolt against the government. We need to attack their economy. He says there is no need for a military war. Wangchuk even spoke about PM Modi's 'Atmanirbhar Bharat’ which means self-reliant India. We should buy from Indian grown businesses and help our economy, instead of buying Chinese products. Hence we must support PM Modi and buy from Indian businesses and help them develop. He appealed that, in one week we must remove all Chinese Apps such as TikTok, CS Scanner, MI Apps, etc. Within one year, it may be difficult to remove Chinese hardware from our lives. If you are using any Chinese product, no problem. Within a year, if it gets spoilt, and you plan to buy a new phone, then make sure you do not buy from Chinese brands. Instead opt for other brands. Do not buy any product that is made in China. You can do this on one year. Take a pledge to do this and inform others to do the same. If we are united and all of India boycott Chinese products, China will automatically understand looking at its declining economy. Due to its economy, China will take a step back from the border disputes and will agree for peace talks. This is a much better alternative. Wangchuk said that just because we are boycotting Chinese products, doesn't mean we boycott or oppress Chinese citizens. We are only against Chinese government and its products. There is nothing against its people.

Every time we get our salary, some money is deducted because of tax. Why is the tax eating my money and for what? Every time anyone buys essential items like soap or groceries or if they go to a restuarant, on the bill you see that there is some tax levied. When you buy something, you have to pay tax. For buying anything, we have to keep on paying taxes. Even when you pay for petrol, the bill includes tax. We pay so much of tax, what happens to all the tax money? But in the first place, why do we have to pay tax? Whenever we pay tax, the money goes to the government. Government collects the tax money from everyone. When you get your salary, you plan and budget your expenses like food, electricity bill, rent, etc. and the balance remains. All of us do money management and hence save money for the future. Similarly, the Government also plans things with the tax that is collected. The money is used for building roads, schools, hospitals, and other infrastructural developments. This money is also used to support setting up of small businesses. The government collects the tax money and even uses it to help farmers. Managing the tax money is not easy and has to be done every year. The amount of money spent on different things changes from year to year. For example, during the 2 years of the coronavirus pandemic, very little budget was set for farmers or for setting up small businesses. rather the money was used for hospitals, vaccines, etc which the government provided free to people. It was used for research and treatment of Covid-19. The budget does not remain the same always and varies according to the situation. 66% of India's population is poor which means 2 out 3 people are so poor that they do not have enough money to buy essential items. They can surely not pay tax. This group constitutes 66% of the population! Only 1% of Indian population pays income tax which is the same as 1 in 100 people. The remaining 99 people are unable to pay income tax as their salary gets over in paying for innumberable things or their salary is too low to afford highly priced things. Government is aware about this and make it affordable by giving subsidy in transportation, free schooling, subsidy in school fees, free medical services in hospitals etc. All this is provided from the money collected as tax. A part of the tax money is used to provide free services like education, medical etc. What about the remaining money? India has taken a loan from the United Nation owned World Bank which is situated in USA. World Bank gives these loans to help countries grow. India too has taken a loan. It is similar to how we take loans for buying a house, mobile or vehicle. We too repay the loan in installments and with interest. Same ways, India has to repay the World Bank loan in installments and with interest. India owes 600 billion dollars to World Bank. Whoa! Thats a huge amount to be paid back. 10% of the tax money is used on defence. This includes purchase of high-ended military equipments, fighter planes etc. It also includes the salary of the military staff. They have to be paid well as they are the ones who at the time of attack on India, will help protect the people of India and ensure peace. Remember, you must pay your tax as the money is used to pay for others things that help the country develop. The second phase of the 2019 Lok Sabha Elections, were held on 18th April 2019. Elections were held across 12 states, for 95 Lok Sabha Seats. According to the Election Commission, 68.1% of the population cast their votes. In the 2014 Lok Sabha Elections, 69.5% of the population, had turned up to vote. This year the voter turnout had decreased. The number should have been the same, or higher. The elections were held peacefully in all the states. Except for a few incidents in West Bengal and Manipur. In West Bengal, 76.4% of the people turned up to vote. Similarly in Assam 76.4% of the people turned up to vote. Puducherry recorded a voter turnout of 78.1%. Manipur recorded a voter turnout of 78.5%. Tamil Nadu recorded a voter turnout 71.2%. Karnataka recorded a voter turnout 68.2%. Odisha recorded a voter turnout of 62.4%. Bihar recorded a voter turnout of 62.04%. Uttar Pradesh recorded a voter turnout of 62%. Chhattisgarh recorded a voter turnout of 73%. There were two violent incidents reported, but casualties haven’t been reported. The only state that saw a low voter turnout was Jammu & Kashmir. In Srinagar only 14% people cast their votes. Elections were held for 10 Lok sabha seats, in the Marathwada and Vidarbha region of Maharashtra. 63% of the people turned up to cast their votes. Three villages in Solapur boycotted the elections over water crisis. In Karnataka, one polling staff died of a heart attack. another polling staff also suffered a heart attack. The states of Assam, Maharashtra and Karnataka. reported complaints of faulty voting machines. In Tamil Nadu, as many as 384 faulty EVMs were replaced. 692 VVPAT machines were replaced as well.

Campa Cola vanished by the year 1999, after two US-based cola brands - Coca Cola and Pepsi made their way into India. The two new colas defeated Campa Cola and became people's favourite. Are you aware that Parle Agro too manufactured different drinks like Thumbs Up, Limca, Gold Spot, Citra, Mazaa and others. In 1993, Coca Cola bought these from Parle Agro and included them in their brand. In 1990s Campa Cola was in the market, However, when in 1993 Coca - Cola bought Parle Agro's colas, the company did not buy Campa Cola. as it's market had already reduced. Gradually it started disappearing and in 1999 it finally vanished from the markets. Now there is good news, Reliance Industries' Mukesh Ambani, bought Campa Cola for 22 Crores. Reliance acquired Campa Cola in a bid and plans to re-launch the product by October this year during Diwali. Surprising! Now that Reliance has bought Campa Cola, there will be stiff competition between soda behemoths like Coca Cola, Pepsi and now Reliance owned Campa Cola. Earlier Campa Cola was the most popular cola drink but after Coca Cola and Pepsi entered the market, Campa Cola vanished. Now that Campa Cola is back in the fray, the competition is worth watching. Reliance Industries have identified around two dozen other potential brands like Campa Cola which are losing their market. According to sources, Reliance is working on acquiring these brands. The company is also in advanced level negotiations with an edible oil brand, namkeen brand and a soap brand. The Economic Times reported that Reliance’s strategy is to aquire small-sized companies which have faded over time, and valued at only a few crores and not for 500 - 1000 crores. They plan to aquire these brands and revive them. This is as per Economic Times report. to launch Jio Mart and Reliance Retail like Smart Bazaar on WhatsApp alongside their apps. This will enable customers to order groceries over WhatsApp. Wow! Reliance does has amazing business acumen. Campa Cola will be launced in October and be available for purchase in Reliance Retail shops, JioMart outlets, Smart Bazaar and with shopkeepers that buy Reliance items. On 19 March 2019, Nirav Modi was arrested by Scotland Yard in London. He was arrested on the charges of fraud against the Punjab National Bank. He was arrested in a London Bank, where he was trying to open a bank account. On 19th March, he spent the night in jail. The next day on 20th March 2019 he was presented in court. He put forward a bail application of Rs 4.5 crore. The judge considered him to be a flight risk, and rejected his bail application. The Judge said that he will remain in custody till the 29th of March 2019. In South-West London the Her Majesty’s Prison (HMP) is the largest prison in London. Nirav Modi was transferred to this prison. The cells in this prison are designed for one individual only. Since there 1,430 prisoners in this jail, multiple prisoners have to share one cell. Nirav Modi was made to share such a cell. The prisoners are hardly allowed to come out of their cells. It is filled with inmates who have drug and mental health problems. His arrest has made the extradition process easy for Indian Government.

The BBC published a report on 17th November 2020. It said that workers in Indian factories supplying goods to famous chains such as Ralph Lauren, Marks & Spencer, Tesco & Sainsbury’s have alleged that they are being overworked and exploited. The BBC interviewed people in these factories but withheld their names for the workers’ safety. Let me tell you about their struggles. A woman working in a factory that supplied clothes to luxury brand Ralph Lauren said, “We are made to work continuously, often through the night, sleeping at 3 am then waking up by 5 am for another full day. Our bosses don’t care. They are only bothered about production, they do not care about our sufferings.” One of the women workers at a factory supplying Marks & Spencer said, “We don’t get toilet breaks, we don’t get time to drink water on shift. We barely get time to eat lunch.” A worker said, “They have increased our workload. Our bosses do not allow us to go home and forced us to stay late & finish the work. They don't care if we reach home late. They yell at us and we suffer quietly. If we leave halfway they abuse us and threaten to fire us. We fear losing our jobs so we continue working. The worker added that during lunch time a manager would stand behind the workers in the canteen. When we start eating, within minutes the manager blows the whistle to send everyone back to work. We were made to work overtime and stopped from going home until the work was completed. A widow worker said, “They ask us to work so late I can’t even feed my children at night. They should not treat us like slaves, they should give us respect for our time. According to BBC’s report, according to the India’s Factories Act, no worker should exceed more than 48 hours a week or 60 hours with overtime. Workers should also not be made to work for over nine hours in a day. The companies are in violation of the law. The report also said that all the workers are overworked and underpaid. They are unable to survive on such a low salary and live in impoverished conditions. Once the report was published, all four brands, Ralph Lauren, Marks & Spencer, Tesco & Sainsbury’s said they were shocked and would investigate the matter.

Did you know most of us eat really healthy food, but despite eating the healthiest food in the world, end up making 7 mistakes that take away all the benefits of our healthy food These are 7 mistakes that you either make before, during, or after a meal Because of them, despite eating the healthiest foods, So whether you're making just 3 mistakes or all 7 of them,  do watch this video till the end because you'll learn not just about the mistakes you're making,  but also how to fix each of them "Oh! But my food habits are already good. I don't have any problems" So why do I need it? Do you feel really light after having food?  Do you feel energetic from morning to evening? Are you at your ideal weight? If your answer is no to any one of these questions, it means you're making one of these 7 mistakes Come let's find out what these 7 mistakes are and how you can fix them 1st mistake - eating without hunger We come and stand in front of the fridge after every 2 hours When you keep eating again and again  throughout the day like this, by the time it's lunch or dinner, you don't even experience real hunger anymore You still eat lunch or dinner, but your digestive fire is not even burning and on your extinguished digestive fire,  you dump a plate full of dal-rice, roti-sabzi, and idli-sambhar on top of it Now listen to this carefully Without hunger, every bite you take is like poison for the body because food eaten without hunger cannot be digested at all And if it won't digest, then how will it come out of your body? It will stay stuck inside and keep rotting Stop snacking and munching in between Think of eating food like conducting a havan ritual Before conducting a havan or prayer, we prepare for it gather all the ingredients needed and keep it together We bow down before we take a seat and slowly offer the ingredients to the fire to raise it slowly Is there anyone who casually throws the ingredients while walking here & there? No! Because you know there are some rules to conducting a havan But when it comes to the fire burning in our stomach, why do we forget everything  and keep throwing ingredients into it while casually something or the other? even if the digestive fire is not lit Please understand - eating food is like doing a havan We should sit down comfortably and slowly add ingredients to the fire and the ingredients should only be added when the fire is burning properly If we add food when our digestive fire is low, then the fire will be extinguished and our food won't digest either So between your breakfast and lunch, between your lunch and dinner, between your dinner and breakfast, remember not to keep snacking or munching Do you know what the best sauce in the world is? Which one is it? Not tomato! Not schezwan nor soya! Your hunger is the world's best sauce When you're really hungry, even simple and plain food tastes amazing When we eat without hunger, we have to keep adding lots of things to make it tasty salt, chilli, spices, oil, lemon, we keep adding them all So in summary, eat only when you're hungry Real hunger can be experienced as a growling sound in your stomach and fake hunger is that which demands something salty, tangy, spicy every 2 hours If you're not hungry, then skip your meals We're afraid of skipping meals these days,  but eating without hunger is much worse than that Come let's move onto our 2nd mistake And that is - eating when you're angry, irritated, tensed, or stressed Imagine you're sitting down to have dinner after a long hard day of work Your plate has your favourite food You're feeling really hungry too the kind of hunger that makes a growling sound in your stomach you're just about to put the first bite in your mouth, but suddenly your phone rings You find out that your best friend has gone through an accident What do you do? You keep your plate aside that very moment Even if your elders tell you to eat just a little bit No! I'm not feeling hungry right now But how did your hunger die in just 30 seconds? Because when there's any kind of problem on your mind  like fear, stress, tension, irritation, or anger, the whole energy in your body starts going here When all the energy in your body is working here,  then will there be any energy left to do the work here? No! Whatever you eat when you're sad, angry, or when you don't feel like it, it turns into a poison once it enters your body because we can't digest it. And there's an example of this in Indian culture too When someone dies, until their last rites are not performed, no one is allowed to use the stove at home Why did our ancestors create this rule? Because they knew in times of sadness and distress,  family members can't digest their food properly So when you're eating, eat only when you're happy, relaxed and comfortable Now if you're eating while watching a violent movie or a sad news story, you're eating while others are arguing around you then how will your mind be at ease?  While eating, if there's something giving you even a little bit of stress, set it aside immediately and eat in a stable, peaceful and happy state You'll see how much of an impact this one change will make on your digestion Come, let's move onto our 3rd mistake  Always eating with forks and spoons The Britishers left a lot of things in our country One of them is the habit of using forks and spoons  Wherever you go, you'll find people eating with forks, knives and spoons these days But our Vedas have always taught us to eat with our hands Why? Because when you touch your food with your fingers, the nerve endings in your fingers immediately send a signal to your brain that food is about to enter the body and the same signal is sent by your brain to your stomach, intestines, liver, & kidney By doing this, all your organs are prepared before food comes into the body Your stomach starts releasing digestive juices, liver starts releasing bile and intestines start getting lubricated On the other hand, when we eat with forks and spoons, our body doesn't get a signal Another benefit of eating with our hands  is that they don't allow us to eat anything too hot or too cold Lord Krishna teaches us never to eat anything too hot or too cold So the next time you see forks and spoons on the side of your plate, keep them aside and eat with your hands without hesitation While eating with your hands, don't ever feel embarrassed Show the world what the right way of eating looks like While eating food, the 4th mistake that you may be making -  Mixing too many foods at once Have you ever eaten a plate that looks like this? A bit of dal, some rice, and 2 rotis of course, 2-3 types of sabzis along with it, some salad, some raita, some papad of course! How else will you get flavour? So some papad too. Oh! We forgot about the chutney and pickle And why not end it on a sweet note after all this? If you eat a plate like this, no matter how hungry you are, no matter how relaxed you are, even if you eat with your hands,  your poor stomach will be confused about what to digest Look, your stomach can only digest one type of food at a time It can only release one type of digestive juice at a time So when you give it food like this, which has lots of different things in it,  your stomach won't be able to release so many different types of digestive juices What you can't digest will keep sitting and rotting in your body and creates problems like acidity, headache, obesity, lethargy, and pimples a book which compiles the 2000 year old teachings of Jesus Christ He says: "Be content with 2-3 foods as given by Mother Nature" Let me tell you truly, if you put all kinds of foods into your body,  the peace of your body will be lost and there will be a war waging inside you What should you do? Eat only one type of food at a time The next time you see 8-9 different items on your table, take only 2-3 items instead of taking everything Instead of mixing too many grains at a time, eat only one grain at a time If you see roti and rice in front of you, eat only one of them at a time Come, let's move onto our 5th mistake - not chewing our food properly Chewing! We know all about it, but don't do it We've heard all about it from childhood that you should chew your food 32 times But what do we do? We never understood its importance While watching TV, talking, without even looking at our plate, we're gulping our food But remember this one rule from now on -  Before swallowing any food, chew it so many times that it turns into a juice Until you don't chew it and turn it into a juice, don't swallow it down Why? Because the more you chew it, the  The more saliva is released, the easier it will be to digest your food Let's understand this another way. Surely, you would've boiled a potato before If you put the whole potato inside without cutting or peeling it, then it takes almost 15 mins to boil it but when you cut it into small pieces, how much time does it take? Barely 7 mins. Almost half the time Exactly this is what happens with your stomach When you eat without chewing properly, it will take almost 20 hours to digest it But when you eat it by chewing it properly, by turning it into a juice, then it will digest properly within 9-10 hours On top of that, you'll experience much more energy, lightness, mental clarity Because the work done your teeth can't be done by your intestines Okay, all this is fine! But how do we do it? As soon as the plate comes in front of me, I can't help eating everything quickly  I don't even remember about chewing my food And when I remember it, my meal is over already! Look, there are 2 things If you can do them, then chewing will easily happen on its own I've often seen people whose one bite is equivalent to half a roti If you eat such huge bites, then forget about your stomach, even your teeth won't be able to do their job properly 2nd thing - while eating, only focus on your food Human beings are one of a kind. We keep thinking about food the whole day but when food is on our plate, we're thinking about everything else except it If you're doing 5 different things while eating, then you can't pay attention to chewing So take small bites and eat peacefully without any distractions You'll be able to focus on chewing naturally The 6th mistake - eating till our stomach is absolutely full Go to your kitchen and take a blender Now stuff it with ingredients till the top Then turn it on. What happens? Will you be able to mix anything? No, absolutely not! Forget about the blender. Think about your washing machine If you totally stuff it with clothes, will it be able to wash them properly? No! Why? Because it's Nature's law that to mix anything you need some empty space When we don't do this with our mixer, why do we do it with our stomach? Eating till we're totally stuffed. It's almost turned into a new ritual We feel that unless we don't eat until we're full, we'll become weak Our Shastras teach us that we should only fill our stomach till half its capacity Leave 1/4th space for the digestive juices and 1/4th space empty for it to churn  But how will I know how full my stomach is? How do we practically follow this rule? It's easy. When you feel like taking a second serving, then stop for 2 mins After 2 mins, if you still feel like you want that second serving, then take it By giving this break, you'll be able to find out that your body had no need for it You'll stop by yourself. One more important thing! It doesn't matter what you eat. When the theatres opened, people rushed to watch movies. This helped the theatres come back in business. The discounted tickets are a 'thank you' gesture for moviegoers who contributed to the success. They hope that this one-day discount will persuade more people to return to theatres and the shows will be housefull. Theatres are currently struggling to compete with the OTT platforms like Hotstar, Amazon Prime, Netflix, etc as these OTT platforms provide subscriptions where you can watch many movies during the subscription period. A man was arrested in Florida, USA. Let me tell what was his crime. Casey William Blake printed a fake cheque at home mimicking his original cheque from his bank. He put in a random amount of $1,30,203 on the fake cheque which is approximately Rs 1 crore. Casey then walked into a Porsche showroom. The salesperson showed him the various car models. Casey then decided upon the porche 911 Turbo and presented the fake cheque. Casey was overjoyed to buy such a luxurious car with a fake cheque. He even posted a picture of himself with the car on Social Media. Since Casey was able to buy such an expensive car, he became very confident and made another fake cheque. He then drove to a jewellery store in Miramar Beach, Florida. At the Jewellery store, Casey purchased 3 luxury rolex watches. Casey then handed over the fake cheque. However, this time Casey was not that lucky when he was able to buy the Porsche car. This time the Jewellery store kept the watches until they could verify the cheques. On 30th July, the store realised the cheques were fake. By then even the Porsche dealership realised the cheque was fake They both filed a complaint. Casey was arrested on 30th July and is now in Jail. He confessed that the cheque was fake but the account number is real.

A beluga whale was seen last week in the waters near Finnmark of North Norway. Finnmark is Norway’s most northerly country which Russia. told Norwegian media that they were going to put out their nets, when they saw the whale swimming between the boats. They discovered a device which was attached to a harness. This harness was attached to the friendly beluga whale. The harness had the words “Equipment of St. Petersburg” labelled on it. Cameras or other devices could be attached to this harness. This showed that the animal had been trained by the Russian navy, as a part of the “Marine mammal special force” Audun Rikardsen, professor at the department of Arctic and Marine Biology at the University of Tromso said that it was not good for the fish to have the harness attached to it for a long time. He said that the Russian Navy must have attached the harness to it, and not the Russian Scientists. Both United States of America, and Russia, have trained marine animals for wars. Russia is also known to train underwater mammals for military purposes. In the US, the Navy Marine Mammal Programme is going on, where animals are trained to detect enemy equipment, protect the ports, and recover objects from the sea bed.

They will make sure the aircrafts are ready to fly whenever the President, Vice-president or Prime Minister wish to travel. ‘Manual Scavenging’ is a term mainly used in India, where the drains containing drainage water including human excreta, when blocked causes water to accumalate, is cleaned manually by a human being. Manual Scavenging is very dangerous for the life of these people. Also, they do not use machines, they use hand tools such as buckets, brooms and shovels. This is extremely risky for human life. These are the best as it would go inside the manhole with the instructions given by the operator The robot will go inside the manhole and work exactly like how a human does. Reports also said that it can go about 10 meters deep into the manhole. the human is substituted by the robot. The operator can control and operate it seamlessly. The Bandicoots also have sensors that can detect and warn of the presence of toxic gases. It saves us from any such problems. K Venu Gopal, the Superintendent Engineer of Water supply & Underground Drainage Management, GVMC, said that it is better to use such robots, it replaces the manual scavenger and a person just needs to operate it. AFSPA stands for the Armed Forces Special Powers, Act. Through this law the Indian Parliament, grants the Indian Armed Forces special powers in disturbed areas, which pose a security threat. When the Central or State government declares an area disturbed, the law can be applied. This law is active in Assam, Nagaland, Manipur and Arunachal Pradesh. This law gives the Indian Armed Forces the power to shoot persons who pose a security threat, the power to arrest such persons, and the power to destroy property in such disturbed areas. The AFSPA law is extremely controversial. Many say that the law violates Human Rights. Arguments regarding this law, are still going on. A review of the security, in Arunachal Pradesh's six districts was conducted. No security threat was found. After 32 years, this law has been removed from 3 of the 9 districts in Arunachal Pradesh. The law will remain in areas near the Myanmar border. Last year, AFSPA was completely removed from Meghalaya. This is because, there was an improvement in the security situation. In J&K this law was passed in 1990, and has remained ever since. Recently the Indian National Congress said that if they win the Lok Sabha Elections, they will make many changes to the AFSPA law. This has lead to a huge political controversy.

You all know that last year, Delhi's Baba ka Dhaba, a small eatery owned by 80 year old Kanta Prasad and his wife, ran into financial troubles due to the COVID lockdown. He was in tears because of his woes. A YouTuber released a video about this and people flocked to his Dhaba, People ate at his dhaba and donated money to support him. With the lakhs of rupees received in donations, in December last year, Kanta Prasad had started a new restaurant just a few minutes away from his old Dhaba in Malviya nagar. The name of Kanta Prasad's new restaurant was also 'Baba Ka Dhaba'. However after opening in December 2020, the restaurant shut down on 15th feb 2021. This is because an expense of Rs 1 lakh was involved. Rs 36,000 per month to be paid workers, Rs 35,000 for rent, including electricity bill, water bill, etc. As compared to the expenses, the returns were less. This is why he shut down the restaurant. Reports say the restaurant, which initially saw impressive crowds, gradually lost customers and was vexed by mismanagement. This is why Kanta Prasad shut the restaurant. Mr Prasad, however, says that he will now run his dhaba till the day he dies. He has also planned his retirement. He said that because of people’s generous donations he and his wife were able to save up Rs 20 lakh.

You know when a child grows up, some are short, some are average in height while some grow tall and some very tall. Most of us face no problems in life, everthing is normal. However, there is always a problem in flights. When you sit in a flight, AC, seats, service, duration etc is all comfortable except for the legroom which is extremely uncomfortable and causes a lot of inconvenience while walking out. This is major problem for people who are tall as for short people, it is easier. Rumeysa Gelgi, from Turkey holds the Guinness World Record as the tallest woman. In 2014, Gelgi held the Guinness record as the tallest teenager. She is the tallest in the world with an height of 7ft 0.7inches. She also holds the world record of the longest finger. In October 2021, she was recognised as the tallest woman in the world. Surprising! But Gelgi is not able to take flights and has never been on a flight ever. This is because of her height and it is difficult for her to board a flight. Gelgi's incredible height is due to a rare genetic condition called Weaver Syndrome. The condition causes increased and rapid growth, However she uses wheelchair as the condition also results in limited movement of the joints and instability in walking. That is why she needs to use a walker or a wheelchair. She has never taken a flight. She wanted to take a flight but could never do it because of her height and limited legroom. Recently, Turkish Airlines offered her help if she wanted to board the flight. She told them she wanted to go to USA. Turkish Airlines agreed. The airline turned six seats of the plane into a stretcher to accommodate her and provided her maximum comfort. Social media video showed Gelgi entering the airport in a wheelchair and then comfortably lying on the stretcher. Gelgi was comfortable during a 13-hour flawless flight from Istanbul, Turkey to San Francisco, USA. She thanked Turkish Airlines for the their help. Gelgi said she works in the technology sector and will be in the US for six months to find more opportunities. Gelgi, in an Instagram post, thanked Turkish Airlines for the comfortable flight. Turkish Airlines responded to her thank you note, assuring her all the help in the future. Gelgi said she had never taken a flight earlier, but now on she will and she was very happy.

Only experts astronauts and supremely intelligent persons were allowed onboard rockets. Civilians were never allowed to visit space. You all know about this. Richard Branson’s Virgin Galactic was the first company to start international space travel for tourists by launching its high speed spacecraft. You all know about this. The 2nd was Amazon founder Jeff Bezos’s Blue Origins. Now SpaceX is the 3rd to do the same. It is owned by Elon Musk. Do you know Musk is also the owner of car company Tesla! Now there is something really exciting about this. All the space vehicles launched by Virgin Galactic & Blue Origin were manned by the staff onboard. However, SpaceX's spacecraft is fully automatic and the 4 people onboard merely enjoy the ride. They have to do nothing as the rocket is fully automatic. This is done for the first time in history. There were 4 people onboard the fully automated rocket were all general civilians and not astronauts. I am stunned by this! The rocket was 200-feet long and had a speed of approximately 28,000 km/hr. Do you think it would return to earth after a short time? The rocket would spend 3 days circling the earth's orbit. They would spend 3 days looking at the earth's orbit. Isn't that amazing! It was launched on 15th September from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. So 4 people are on board the SpaceX rocket that will tour the earth's orbit for 3 days. You may wonder what will these people do for 3 days? Won't they get bored sitting idle or floating in zero gravity? Each and every hour of their 3 days in space has been planned with activities. It includes astronomy research, time for pleasure, etc. Isn't that wonderful! If you wondering whether the rocket has toilet, well it does but the 4 passengers will all have to share one toilet. No showering will be available and crew will not have beds to sleep in. Instead they all have to sleep in the same reclining seats they will ride in during launch. These passengers had to pay for their tickets. The mission was fully funded by one person and the other 3 passengers boarded the rocket for free. This person was named Jared Isaacman aged 38. He is the founder of payment processing company Shift4. Similar to PhonePe & GooglePay in India. Isaacman is a billionaire who personally funded the mission and brought the 3 passengers on board. The other 3 people onboard the flight were either chosen personally by Isaacman or they were selected through competitions. These 4 individuals then took off in the rocket. How cool is that! Now you may wonder who the other 3 individuals are. Let me tell you. The first person as I said earlier is Jared Isaacman who sponsored the mission. The 2nd person is Hayley Arceneaux, a 29-year-old cancer survivor. She will be the chief medical officer on the flight. Arceneaux is the first person to go to space with a prosthesis, a titanium rod in her left leg. Sian Proctor, 51, was an ex-NASA staff. The last person is Chris Sembroski aged 42 who was an ex-Air Force officer in the US. So these were the 4 passengers onboard the rocket. The team has worked with SpaceX to train since February. In SpaceX’s next trip which will launch in 2022, passengers will spend an entire week in space as compared to the current 3 day mission. A retired NASA astronaut will escort three wealthy businessmen in the upcoming mission. Roscosmos is the state corporation of Russia. Its similar to India's ISRO. Roscosmos will launch a rocket which will have a 3 people onboard. and a Japanese business tycoon will be onboard the flight. The launch is not merely for space tourism. The crew is all set to shoot a movie for the first time in space. Isn't that cool!

Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman presented the Union Budget 2021-22 on 1st February 2021. She used a tablet to deliver the paperless Budget address. This Budget comes amid the novel coronavirus pandemic, which has led to massive economic disruption in India. This is why the Budget assumes great significance. Here are the highlights of Sitharaman’s speech: 1. She allocated ₹2,23,846 crore for health, ₹1.18 lakh crore for road infrastructure, ₹1,10,055 crore for Railways and ₹3 lakh crore for power. 2. Sitharaman said that the taxpayers must not feel overburdened by the various financial revisions announced in the 2021 budget. she surprised taxpayers by not announcing any change in income tax slab rates. This has been heartily welcomed by many. She also did not announce the much talked about COVID Cess as well. Cess is form of tax. This was a surprise for many. 3. The Finance Minister proposed that senior citizens above 75 years of age earning only pension and interest income from deposits would not be required to file Income Tax Return. 4. ITAT is a judicial institution and specializes in dealing with appeals related to Tax. Now people can file appeals with ITAT electronically. If a personal hearing is needed it will be done via video-conferencing. 5. NRIs who choose to settle in India after retirement after spending significant time abroad on a job faced difficulties with receiving money from retirement accounts, as they were heavily taxed. Now the rules will be relaxed. 6. Once an individual declares their Dividend in their Income Tax Returns, they will have to pay Advance Tax as per the norms. 7. Serious tax offences of concealment of income of over ₹50 lakh can be reopened till 10 years. 8. The finance minister has sanctioned ₹35,000 crore for the COVID-19 vaccine. Sitharaman also said that if more funds are needed, the government will provide it. 9. Various Custom Duties on imported products have been revised. These revisions will affect the price of various commodities. Gold, silver and other precious metals like platinum and palladium will get cheaper. This is due to the reduction in its custom duty. An increase in custom duty can lead to certain products becoming expensive. Iteams such as mobile phones, compressors for refrigerators, LED lamps, solar lanterns, etc. will become expensive due to an increase in customs duty. Imported alcoholic beverages will also get more expensive. Leather products such as shoes, bags, handbags, diaries, etc will become expensive. Automobile parts and polished synthetic stones are set to become costlier. 10. India has currently approved 2 vaccines. 2 more will be approved soon. 11. ₹300 crore was granted to the Government of Goa for celebration of 50 years of Independence from the Portuguese.

People send emails, chat, use social media, use mobile data, video calls, etc. via the 4G network. This has been going on for a while now. In a few years, 4G will be replaced by 5G and provide high speed data. However, many people around the world are against 5G because it can cause harmful effects on humans and the environment. Now actor Juhi Chawla, who is also an environmental activist, filed a case in the Delhi High Court against the implementation of the 5G network in India. Juhi Chawla said that, “Just because I am against 5G does not mean I am against technology. Once 5G is set up, according to research network cell towers will give out radiation. These radiations which can not be seen, will harm unaware humans, birds, insects, trees, and all forms of living organisms will be exposed to its harmful effects. The radiation will cause health problems in humans and have a severe impact on animals and trees. Since the network cell towers have been found to be highly dangerous, Juhi Chawla does not want the 5G network as it will cause permanent damage to our environment. This is why she is against 5G. In her complaint Juhi Chawla said she wants the 5G authorities to certify that that 5G technology is safe for senior citizens, man, woman, adult, child, infant, animals, and every type of living organism, flora, and fauna. She wants them to confirm this. The complaint was heard by Justice C Hari Shankar. He has transferred the complaint to another bench and the hearing is on June 2.

The men's cricket team practice a lot and get selected to play Test, ODI and T20 International matches. These cricketers are rich as they are paid a whopping amount by the BCCI. You all know this. Now, the Women's cricket team too is giving splendid performances which are at par with the men's team. However, there was pay disparity between the men's and the women's teams. Let me give you an example. For every international match, BCCI paid each player of the men's playing team a match fee. For example, match fee for men player is Rs 6 lakh for a 50 overs ODI. While the women cricketer was paid only Rs 1 Lakh. The match fee for the men is Rs 15 Lakh for a Test match, while the women were only paid Rs 4 Lakh. For T20 the male player is paid Rs 3 Lakh. Information is not available for women players. In a good news, on 27th October 2022, BCCI announced that a pay equity policy,which means men and women players would get the same match fees. Thats wonderful! This means the women players will now get Rs 6 lakh for One-Day International, Rs 15 lakh per Test match, and Rs 3 lakh for a T20 International. This is the same as the men's team. However one thing has been kept the same. When the players play a match, they get match fee. There is annual retainership which is paid at the end of the year for the number of matches played by the player. Based on the number of matches, the players are graded into A, B and C and they get a whopping amount. A Grade player is the one who B is lesser matches and C is the least number of matches which maybe due to injury, rest etc. The Grade A men players get about Rs 7 Crore while Grade C get paid about Rs 1 Crore While the women player get paid very less. Grade A - Rs 50 lakh, Grade B - Rs 30 lakh and Grade C Rs 10 lakh. Women are paid Rs 50, 30 and 10 Lakhs while the men get Rs 1 - 7 Crores. The pay disparity is because the men’s team play more matches than the women’s team every year. However on 27th October 2022, BCCI announced on Twitter that the match fee for ODI, Test and T20 will be equal henceforth. WIth BCCI's annoucement about equal pay, India has become the second country to implement equal pay after New Zealand. Hope the other countries follow the same and have pay parity between men and women players. Former India captain Diana Edulji said BCCI's decision of equal pay is good. It is better now. She said that earlier in the era when she was playing, women's cricket was not under BCCI. Women's team was run by the Women’s Cricket Association of India and they had to pay from their pockets for traveling for international matches. Also there was hardly any match fee paid. Now it is much better and players are being paid well. She is happy and applauded BCCI's decision. The current Indian Captain Harmanpreet Kaur also expressed her happiness by sharing the tweet and thanked BCCI. Now you see that India is paying its men and women cricketers equal. Do you think it is a good decision? Let us know in the comments.

Price of Kishori pistachio increased from Rs 400 to Rs 550, apricot went from Rs 1,500 to Rs. 2,100 and Gurbandi almonds went from Rs 1,600 to Rs 1,900. The traders have asked the Central Government for help to get dry fruits from other countries. As the festival season like Navratri and Diwali is soon approaching there will be a demand for dry fruits. If the price remains high it will severely affect their business.

The Wrestling Federation of India has said they could not believe that Sushil Kumar who is India's most famous wrestler, could have stooped so low by getting involved in a murderous brawl. Just imagine, can you travel in a train or a metro without trousers, just in your underwear? You wear a shirt, coat or a jacket but not your trousers. You might think this is not possible and you will feel embarrassed travelling in your underwear. Trousers have to be worn. Right? This has actually happened in a tube train in London, UK where everyone was travelling wearing only their underwear. Photos and videos of people walking around in their underwear went viral on social media. It was for celebrating and enjoying the  ‘No Trousers Tube Ride Day’. People travelled, sat, read newspapers in the tube wearing an underwear. Looking at them some stipped down to their underwear. People waiting for the train to come were all in their underwears. Many even had funny messages and various designs printed on the back of their underwear. Many were amused and enjoyed the moment. Surprising! What was the aim? The idea started from New York, USA and was implemented in others places around the world. A group of 7 people initiated this idea of travelling wearing only an underwear. They pretended not to know each other and, if asked, claimed that they had just forgot their pants. People felt happy seeing them and the mission expanded. It started with men and grew into an international celebration with dozens of cities around the world participating each year. The event is celebrated every year once in the month of January. In New York it is known as 'No Pants Subway Ride.' In London the same event has a different name and it has now gone viral. In New York the event was not initiated for awareness or fund raising. The founder said, "The aim of the day was to enjoy and a make everyone laugh and smile. People are stressed and when they see something like this, they get amused. It spreads  positivity. That is the only aim. In London too it was started for the same reason. In New York it started from 2002 and went till 2020. Amazing that they have been doing this for so long! Since 2 years the event has been cancelled due to Covid-19 pandemic and other reasons. However in London, the day was celebrated in the month of January. Now even women participate and enjoy travelling in their underwear. It has become viral. The founder of The Stiff Upper Lip Society, Ivan Markovic said This is just for entertainment and fun. It is not to raise money or awareness. If you do it for raising money, someone might object to it. It is better to just do it for enjoyment and fun. No Pant Ride was also initiated in Tokyo, Japan and other places. In Moscow, Russia the No Pant Ride drew attention from local police who after a few days called the organizer for questioning. He was released without charges. Amazing! This was only for the metro trains. Do you think in India it is possible to travel in the local trains or metro only wearing an underwear? You think it is not possible? Or you think it is possible as it is just for fun? Let us know in comments.

Incase you missed it, click here to watch. The world is aware about Iran's issues. They have a strict rule which says that Iranian women travelling to any country, including athletes, must cover their hair with a headscarf, or hijab, and their arms and legs with loose clothing. Even the slightest show of skin is unacceptable. They have to be fully covered and violators would be strictly punished. Elnaz Rekabi, is a 33-year-old climber went to South Korea to compete at an international tournament. She competed with only a headband and had removed her hijab. When she was being awarded the medal, Elnaz herself removed the hijab. A next to her helped to put the hijab back on, Elnaz shrugged her off. Later while speaking to the media she said her headscarf had fallen off unintentionally. She arrived at the airport without a headscarf, covering her hair with a black baseball cap and a hoodie. She was greeted by her family and many people called her a heroine. Recently a news has surfaced of her house being demolished and the video has gone viral. Iran's news agencies have confirmed that the house has been demolished, but says this was due to the family not having a valid permit for its construction. Hence, the demolition took place. Elnaz Rekabi's brother a top athlete - is seen crying in the video, which is going viral on the internet. So do you think her house was demolished because she didn't wear the hijab at the tournament? Or is it because the family did not have proper permits? Let us know in the comments.

Strangely none of the school officials were informed as well. How weird! Anyway on 10th June 2020 the Commissioner of Disabilities cancelled the registration of the school. It was cancelled without giving any reason and without allowing the Trust to put across its points. The commissioner directed that no new admissions be conducted by the school for 2020-21 and the students be transferred to other schools. He ordered to shut down the school. People were extremely unhappy with this decision. The trust, however, appealed before Mahrashtra’s Social Justice Minister Dhananjay Munde on 7th July 2021. However for a long time there was no response to the letter. After 10 months the minister held a virtual meeting. During the meeting the trust spoke about the cancellation of the registeration and how the school was shut down. The minister merely listened to all this and did not say anything. He then left the meeting. People were stunned by his behaviour. On 27th December, 2021, the district social welfare officer, zilla parishad, wrote to the commissioner asking for the school to be blacklisted. The trust were shocked that they were blacklisted without a discussion. In January 2022, the trust challenged the commissioner’s order in Mumbai HC and requested to stay the order. The truth in their petition said NCP leader Umesh Patil in solapur has acted out of jealousy against the Trust. They alleged that Patil through corrupt means is eagerly interested to grab the school by transferring it to his trust. He is doing this by shutting down the school and canelling its registeration. Later the trust found that MSJE minister Dhananjay Munde had already given his final decision of shutting down the school. No explanation was given for any of this. Justice Milind Jadhav asked who took the decision to cancel its registration. Government advocate Prakash Pujari replied that the “final order was of the honourable minister.” Justice Jadhav remarked, “Only a minister can do such things.” The judge said this is heartbreaking. Instead of encouraging education among Deaf children they are shutting down. The judge was furious over the ministers orders. He said how could he play dirty politics and ruins the children's lives. Disability Commisioners stated that the school had 19 faults. The judge looked at photographs of the institution and said they were contrary to the 19 faults pointed out in the report. He gave the state government 6 weeks to reply and at the same time gave a stay order on Munde’s decision.

In his speech he abused and insulted Mahatma Gandhi and praised his assassin, Nathuram Godse. He also said that Muslims are taking over the country, they should be removed and there should be only Hindus. People were shocked by his hateful and oppressive speech towards the muslims. Congress leader Pramod Dubey who was at the event, filed an FIR with the Raipur police on 26th December against Kalicharan Maharaj. Kalicharan Maharaj who is from Maharashtra, had gone to Raipur to give a speech at the event. But he was arrested by Chhattisgarh Police from Madhya Pradesh's Khajuraho. How did he reach MP? Let me tell you. After knowing about the complaint agaisnt him and fear of being arrested, Kalicharan went to Khajuraho and booked a guest house there. However, he did not stay in the guest house, but stayed in another place 25 Km away. Police looked for him at the guest house but he wasn't found. To evade the police from tracking, all his close aides had also switched off their phones. On 30th December the police finally tracked him down, arrested him and took him to Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Later Kalicharan was presented before the court which remanded him to police custody for two days. Madhya Pradesh Home Minister Narottam Mishra said that Chhattisgarh Police had violated norms by arresting Kalicharan without informing the Madhya Pradesh Police. In reply to it, Chhattisgarh Chief Minister Bhupesh Baghel said, Kalicharan humiliated the Father of the Nation Do you have a problem? Aren't you happy that such a man has been arrested? BJP leader Brijmohan Agrawal, who was present at the event, tweeted in support of Kalicharan, with the hashtag #ReleaseKalicharanMaharaj. Even at the court, where Kalicharan was presented, a group of people raised slogans seeking his release. FIRs have also been registered against Kalicharan at police stations in Akola and Thane in Maharshtra. Both these FIRs are being transferred to Raipur.

Harnaaz Sandhu from Chandigarh, Punjab has been crowned Miss Universe. She is just 21 years old! Miss Universe 2021 is the is 70th edition of the franchise and now Harnaz has won it. In 1994 actress Sushmita Sen won the Miss Universe title. After her actress Lara Dutta won the title in 2000. 21 years later India has won the Miss Universe title for the 3rd time! The event was in Eilat, Israel. The pageant was broadcasted live across the world. However it was not at all easy! Towards the end, judges shortlisted the top 3 participants. Andrea Meza, former Miss Universe 2020 from  Mexico, crowned Harnaaz at the event. Let me tell you how she won. The judges asked a simple question. They asked, "What advice would you give to young women watching on how to deal with the pressures they face today? Paraguay & South Africa's answers were not impressive but India's answer was the best. She said, Nowadays there are many youngsters who are distressed. The only way to get over this is to believe in yourself. People are stressed because they do not believe in themselves. If you do not believe in yourself it can be a major problem. Constantly comparing yourself to others will create a lot of pressure and you will not be able to manage your life. This will automatically create stress and lead to negativity. Believing in yourself and accepting your flaws is extremely important. By doing this you will surely find your way to success. I am here because I believed in myself despite my troubles and did not compare myself to anyone. It helped my manage my problems and be successful. This was all because I believed in myself. Thank you. Judges were very impressed by her impactful statement and hoped youngsters would learn from her. This is why she won the crown and it is proud moment for India. Harnaaz started her beauty pageant journey when she was just 17. She has previously been crowned Miss Diva 2021, Femina Miss India Punjab 2019. Along with pageantry she is also pursuing her MA. She has also worked in these two Punjabi films. We applaud her determination and hope people follow her example.

One other person commented that Uttar Pradesh has 75 districts, and requested the govt. to make it 76 by declaring this auto a district officially. Near a farm in Sulur Tamil Nadu, there is an Air base of the Indian Air Force. The IAF's LCA Tejas took off from the air base. It had a fuel tank with a capcity of 1,200 litres. When the aircraft was in the air, the fuel tank just dropped out. In 2001, 4,500 such aircrafts were purchased. Since 2001, there were no incidents recorded. Now the fuel tank just dropped off. When the fuel tank fell, none of the buildings or people were hurt. Everyone was safe. People heard a loud crash and rushed to the scene. When the fuel tank fell, there was a 3-foot crater with remains of the broken tank. An Air Force officer said that there was no fuel in the fuel tank and will investigate further. A similar incident occured in Haryana. The IAF's Jaguar Jet was in the air and was dropping practice bombs. Suddenly a bird got stuck in the engine. The aircraft had to do an emergency landing. He even asked the states trace 30 contacts of every infected person and test them. Positive patients must be quarantined to contain the spread of the virus. Chief Ministers must do this to contain the rising cases. States of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Punjab have witnessed a huge increase in cases. Modi said, "I don’t want to say anything on the allegations being levelled from various states. I will only talk about controlling the pandemic. Chief Ministers and the government need to be united to contain the virus. Modi said we are in the midst of a war and everyone has to fight the Coronavirus. Now that we have experienced doctors, nurses, paramedical staff & vaccines. we can contain the virus. Earlier we were unequipped to deal with the crisis. Now we have gained experience and it will be easy to fight it. Modi also came up with a vaccine festival called ‘Tika Utsav’ from April 11-14. HIV is a sexually transmitted disease or it can be transmitted when a person is given HIV infected blood during blood transfusion. That is why the blood is tested for HIV before blood donation. People should go to proper tattoo parlours and ensure that the tattoo artist uses a new needle everytime.

Even though the matches have been moved to the UAE & Oman, the BCCI will continue to be the host of the tournament. The matches will be played across 4 cricket grounds. The matches will be in UAE's Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah and also Oman. The T20 World Cup will start on the 17th of October and the last will be played on the 14th of Nov. The IPL will also be held in UAE from September 19 to October 15. However, immediately after the IPL the T20 world cup will also be held. Once IPL ends on October 15, T20 world cup will be on 17 October. This would prove to be a big headache for the BCCI. Another problem is that because of IPL and T20 World Cup, many players may not be available for the matches. England & Australia have already made it clear that it will not release the players for the IPL. We will have to see what happens next.

You all must have noticed that when a couple after getting married, divorce each other, the children suffer. Laws all over the world regarding divorce, custody of children, alimony etc are different. Israel has a bizarre divorce law. The world is shocked to know about this law Let me tell you about this strict law. Noam Huppert, an Australian, was in love with an Israeli national & married her. They both lived in Australia. They had 2 children aged 5 years and 3 months. In 2011, Huppert and his wife seperated due to disagreements. His wife left Australia and returned to Israel with her 2 children. The husband then followed them to Israel in 2012 to stay close to his children. However, after seeing his children, he was stuck in Israel and has been ordered by the Israel court to not return back due to the ongoing divorce case. His ex-wife had filed a case in the Israeli court seeking money support for their children. The court gave a ‘stay of exit’ order to him which means that he cannot leave the country. The court ordered, Huppert to pay monthly to both of his children until they turn 18. He must pay 5,000 shekels that is around Rs. 1 lakh 20 thousand a month for each of his two children till they turn 18 As in Israel the laws in favour of women are very strong. In case of divorce, men are expected to pay 100 percent of their income to their kids. So, Huppert has to pay for both his children. It is shocking for him. The court order unclear if he can pay the entire sum in advance to lift the stay of exit order, that is why is still stuck there. The court has extended its order and he is banned from leaving Israel. You will be shocked to know the date that the court has given him. It is 31st December. You maybe thinking it will be 2022, or 2030 or 2050 The court order is till 31st December 9999. Oh my god! Shocking! It isn't 8 years. It is 8000 years. Shocking, the man has been ordered to not leave Israel for 8000 years. Huppert is very stressed and told an Australian news agency, I have been stuck since years. But I am not the only one. There are many foreign nationals who have been suffering only because they were married to Israeli women and are banned to travel. He said he was speaking out to help others who maybe suffering like him. so that the world can take notice of this and maybe help in making the law less stringent and allow the men to go back. Others should also open up about it. British journalist Marianne Azizi, who has been raising awareness about this stringent law, said that the exact number of men affected by this law is not known. Studies are going on and would be announced later. This law has been dubbed "draconian and excessive" by human rights groups.

So as per the government's formula, divide 50,412,235 by 288 and multiply it by 1000. Now 288 multiplied by 1000 is 2,88,000. You all are aware that Egyptians have a very strong culture of mummifying the dead Kings and Queens by applying oils, wrapping them in fabrics and keeping them in coffins. The coffin is then placed inside a pyramid along with a lot of things. They strongly believe that the things that they loved would be needed for their afterlife. This is the reason why the men and women are mummified and buried along with the things. Surprisingly, for the first time in history a pregnant mummy along with the foetus has been found. There are people who died thousands of years ago. These bodies decompose and scientists use the skeletal structure to study how humans looked at that time. They want to study the difference in facial features of humans now and then. For this, the skull is scanned and reconstructed using 2D and 3D technique. These techniques help us understand the shapes of their face and their features. The bones also help us understand the person's height. The bones help to reconstruct their face using 2D 3D techniques. Without the bones it is not possible. It helps see the similarities between man now and at that time. Many studies like this have been done. The pregnant mummy was found in 1826. However nobody knew about the foetus. Polish scientists found the foetus a year back. Generally people are mummified alone. The mummy was found in 1826 but the foetus was found last year. Since then no one knew about it! The mummy's bones were still intact! Upon further research, scientists say the baby was 7 months old. How did they know this? The foetus head circumference was measured and it was found that it was in the 7th month of its life. The foetus and the mother were mummified together for the first time in histoty. Upon reconstructing her face they found how she looked at that time. However this is not completely accurate. Chantal Milani share what is the most useful to scientists. She said when people die their body decomposes and only bones remain. She said, 'Our bones give a lot of information about the face, height & dimensions of an individual. A wide skeleton suggests a fat person, an elongated shape would mean a tall person. A small skeleton means a short person. It also helps to learn more about their facial features and jawline. Using 2D and 3D techniques one can actually put a face to the skeleton. Its not completely accurate but helps us see how the person looked. Hew Morrison said, " Fingerprint identification or DNA analysis are not an option in such bodies. Only bones help in the 2D 3D reconstruction. For the first time an Egyptian mummy was found along with her foetus. Many Kings and Queens have been mummified. This woman has been named the 'The Mystery Lady’ Since then the research has been going on. At the Swedish island of Gotland, there was a war. The war occured in 1361 and that time people faught using swords. Many died in battle. Now a mass grave was found at that site. One male body was found. He had a gash on his face from his lower jaw up across his nose, and had several broken teeth. When the wound was further studied, the face was reconstructed. They found he was a warrior and had a gash on his face. See? You can clearly see the gash. It was all because of the 2D 3D scans.

Under this contract six Scorpene submarines by a technology transfer from the French company, were to be manufactured in India. It will run on electricity and diesel. The story of Tripura District Magistrate Shailesh Kumar Yadav has become the viral news. Have a look at the video to know why. Did you see the video? Yadav became famous after this video went viral. In the video he was seen raiding two weddings with police officials on 27th April. The raid was because the weddings had flouted the 10pm curfew. Yadav was seen aggressively talking to the wedding guests about the violations. When one person showed him the permission letter for the wedding that was signed by Yadav himself, Yadav tore the letter to shreds and threw it away. People were stunned by his behaviour. He assaulted the priest, the groom, and was seen yelling at people to leave the venue. He even interupted the guests who were eating and told them to leave immediately. The police even lathi charged a few. Around 30 guests were arrested and released later Everyone was very shocked by this. Following this, the DM faced major backlash from politicians and locals, while many others supported the DM's actions as they were for the safety of the citizens. The bride’s mother, Sabita Deb alleged that, I am devasted by what happened and will never forget it. I had never imagined that on my daughter's wedding someone would assault and arrest the guests. I am shocked by the misbehaviour and the day was completely ruined for me. Yes we broke the curfew rule, but the muhurat was for 11:30 pm, so we were all there. We did not intentionally break any rule. I am traumatised by his misbehaviour. Many of the guests were detained for two hours by the DM and were released after the local police intervened in their support. The wedding rituals were completed later. On 27th April after facing a major backlash he spoke to reporters saying, “I apologise if anyone was pained by my actions. My aim was not to pain or humiliate anyone but my aim was to keep people safe from the Coronavirus. I am sorry. Opposition parties and the BJP lashed out at the State government and demanded action against the District Magistrate. On 28th April panel of two IAS officers was constituted to probe Yadav's actions. They have been directed to submit the report to the Tripura government. There were many rumours circulating that Yadav was fired but that is not the case.

A story has gone viral on WhatsApp, newspapers & the internet about a hearing woman from the UK, who took money from Deaf person and never returned it. You all must be aware about this. This Deaf person works as a teacher at NIHH in Bandra, Mumbai. I spoke to this person and they showed me all the WhatsApp chats which made everything clear. I will now tell you what he told me. This person has said that the information in newspapers is partly correct and partly incorrect. There has been a huge misunderstanding. Here is what they told me. The woman from UK connected with the Deaf individual on Instagram. The person accepted her friend request and they began getting to know each other. The woman said that since she has a 10 day holiday she wanted to come to India. The Deaf person said Mumbai is a great tourist place and would take her along for sightseeing. The lady thanked him for the help. She booked a ticket and sent an image to the Deaf person who welcome her with open arms. She said she reached the airport & even shared an image of herself in the flight. However she landed in Delhi instead of Mumbai. When the Deaf person asked her about this she said she has some work there, once she is done she will come to Mumbai. The girl then messaged him saying she has a problem in Delhi. She said that she has a DD worth 60,000 pounds. but she was unable to exchange it for Rs 61 lakh. She didn't know what to do. She had problems with exchanging the currency, and had to pay for registeration, visa and other airport expenses. She had no cash but just had a DD. The woman then requested the Deaf person to lend her money. The deaf person was smart enough to know it was a risk, that is why he was hesitant. After hiring an interpreter, the Deaf individual communicated with the woman. The person then decided to transfer Rs 49,900 from their SBI account to the woman's acquaintance account. She was very grateful and promised to return the amount once she lands in Mumbai. The Deaf person asked her to go to the manager in the airport. She then asked the Deaf person for money to stay at a hotel at the airport. The person then transfered Rs 30,000 from the same SBI account to her. Now that she had a place to stay she need money to eat. She asked for Rs 15,000 and the Deaf person transfered the amount. She said that once the procedure is complete, she would come to Mumbai and return the amount. Suddenly she sent an image of herself admitted in the hospital. The Deaf person was shocked. When asked what happened, the woman said, when she went to get the currency exchanged, there was an altercation where she badly beaten up. This is why she was in the hospital. The Deaf person asked her to get well soon and said nothing else. When she was supposed to leave on the 4th day, she asked the Deaf person to transfer Rs 30,000. The Deaf person said that he has already given her enough money and is now out of money. He cannot lend her anything. She requested for the money and that she was in the process of getting the money and would return the money soon. The Deaf person was very hesitant and she said that she would not dupe him like others. The Deaf person still did not agree. Then he returned home to his wife. The wife was aware about all this. The Deaf person told her that he can't give Rs 30,000. The wife said that she felt very bad to see a woman like her being injured. This is why she asked him to transfer her money. The Deaf man then took a loan from people and gave her the money. He said this is the last time he is giving her the money. The woman said she would come to Mumbai soon. She then asked him for Rs 12,000 to book her tickets to Mumbai. The Deaf man transfered the amount to her. She thanked him. He then asked her to share a PDF of her flight tickets. She said she would send soon. He kept asking for the tickets so that he would know whether she was arriving on Terminal 1 or 2 at Mumbai airport. However the message only received 1 tick on whatsapp. When the message was delivered she said was in the flight and had to switch off the internet. He kept messaging. At the end of the day there was no responsed. After waiting at NIHH for so long, he went back home. He thought maybe she was tired or sleeping and would reply in the morning. So he waited. When the wife saw the chats, she realised that he had been blocked. The man was shocked by this. It was not possible to complain to the poilce at night. He waited patiently & the next day he went to the police station with an interpreter to file a complaint. The police then filed an FIR. He was duped of Rs 1.38 lakh. They are now trying to sort out the matter. So this was the entire story. Just want to say that do not mock this person for lusting over a girl or think he invested to get double returns. There are WhatsApp chats as proof. So please do not mock him. Now that I have told you this, next time be careful before transferring money to strangers.

People are talking a lot about WhatsApp's new privacy features. Whenever you close down a chat with some on WhatsApp, it shows the timings of last seen and online mode. We can see the each other's last seen timings. but at times, we can switch off the last seen timings from the settings. You all know about this. Apart from last seen timings which can be seen when we are chatting on WhatsApp, we can even see other who are online. If you wish to chat without showing anyone that you are online, you can do so. This is a new update and the online status can be switched off. You can send messages without the person knowing that you are online. Thats the 2nd update. There is another update. If you quit a group on WhatsApp, others would know about it. However, in a new feature, when you leave a group, others would not know about it. This can be done from the updated settings. Most of you would have seen this. What does it mean? I'll tell you. Since several years WhatsApp has a policy that chats are only visible to the sender and the receiver of the message and no one else. The chats are not even visible to the company. It is just between the sender and receiver. Sometimes if police or the government or anyone else want to kno the details of the chat between two people, WhatsApp cannot provide the details as the chats are encrypted. This feature has been there since long and people now are glad that their chats are private. However, there is no option to switch of the end to end encryption feature. The feature is auto-enabled for all users. All messages, photos, videos, voice messages, documents, status updates, calls etc are not saved by WhatsApp. Under end-to-end encryption no one can access any of the data. It is only visible on the mobile that you are using. No one can access the deleted messages even someone requests for it. If you do not want others to login to your mobile and read your chats, you can password protect the app with fingerprint, password or pattern lock. There is nothing to worry, no one can access your chats. Also all your images etc are safe. The news about WhatsApp's new features went viral. However, the problem is,  Indian government's current IT rules states that, in case of any issues or riots, WhatsApp must provide the identification of the first originator of the message. However, WhatsApp has a policy of end-to-end encrypting all messages and there is no data saved. The policies of the Indian government and WhatsApp are against each other. While the Indian government needs the data, while WhatsApp claims that it respects user's privacy. WhatsApp hasn't yet informed how it plans to manage situations when the government asks for details This is a huge problem.
