Viruses and the disease that cause them have different names. People often know the name of a disease, but not the name of the virus that causes it. For example everyone knows about the dangerous disease AIDS. Which virus causes it? It is HIV. Currently the disease that has spread all over the world is the Coronavirus. When the disease first spread it was called the ‘2019 Novel Coronavirus’ On 11 February 2020, the WHO Chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced, the new name of this disease. ‘COVID-19’ He said that, in COVID-19 'co' stands for corona, 'vi' stands for the word virus, while '19' signifies the year of its initial identification, meaning 2019. Hence the name COVID-19. But why was the name changed? According to International rules when a new disease immerges it can not be named after any place such as India,USA, UK, Japan, China etc. It can not be named in reference to any religion or animal. For example Swine Flu, which was named after Pigs that cause it, spread all over. This affected the pork bussiness due to the stigmatisation of the disease. Similarly even the disease Ebola was named after a place in Africa where it originated. This is why WHO adopted the name ‘COVID-19’ so that there is no connection to any religion, place or animal. The name of the Virus that spreads COVID-19 was not randomly selected. When the virus immerged it was properly studied. Its genetic features, mode of transmission and other factors were understood. After this the WHO announced 'SARS-CoV-2’ to be the name of the virus. The name SARS-CoV-2 was given because the genetic structure of the virus was similar to the SARS virus that spread in China in 2003. So now you won’t get confused as the Coronavirus was renamed COVID-19 but the meaning is the same.

In all she lost Rs 34,000. When Harshita tried to confront him again, he disappeared. They are conducting an investigation and have registered an FIR. The hunt for the man is on. Harshita was not able to sell her sofa and she also made a huge loss.

Deaf individuals across India are shocked over an incident in Pune, Maharashtra where 4 Deaf individuals were arrested. Newspapers such as Sakal, Pune Mirror, Samna, etc. have all published this story. I will now tell you about it. The sign names of the 4 Deaf who were arrested are - Suyog Mehta, his wife Chanchal, Abhijar Ghodnadiwala and Pradeep Kolte. They have been arrested for duping the Deaf Community in India through a scheme that doubles investors money. They not only Duped the Deaf but also Deaf Blind individuals. They cheated more than 550 individuals and have now been arrested. The pune police have arrested them. 1 particular newspaper published an astonishing article. Suyog Mehta and the rest of the gang despite being Deaf in a shocking act have betrayed members of their own community. For example a Wolves and Sheep never mingle because the Sheep fears to be hunted. In order to be part of the flock the Wolf then dresses like a Sheep. This leads to the Sheep treating him as their own. Later the wolf hunts the sheep. Suyog was the same. He evoked a feeling of kinship, used sweet words and promised to support the Deaf in India by doubling their investments. This is how many Deaf fell into his trap and invested in his scheme. Also Suyog was the Kingpin who roped in Abhijar to advertise the money scheme. Abhijar would broadcast videos explaining that the scheme was profitable & risk free. Deaf individuals fell for these and invested around Rs 4.5 crore. This is why the 4 individuals have been jailed. They face FIRs under the IPC's section 420 for duping people, section 406 - criminal breach of trust and 20 B - criminal conspiracy by promising people to double their money. They have also charged them under Maharashtra's MPID and various other laws. You all must be wondering what did Suyog's wife Chanchal do? Pradeep & Abhijar were advertising the scheme. So what was Chanchal's role? A complaint was lodged by Harshal Pinjan who as a clerk at the Dehu Road Cantonment Board as he had been cheated. Pinjan said that he met the Abhijar in August 2020. Abhijar then proceeded to explain the scheme to Pinjan by showing facts and promised many benefits. Abhijar aggressive convinced Pinjan and promised to double his investments in 2 months. He showed an unsure Pinjan videos of other Deaf individuals who benefited from the scheme. When Pinjan was still not convinced, Abhijar brought in Suyog, and said that Suyog is an expert in shares, he could double the investment. Suyog also convinced him. Pinjan was still not entirely convinced and backed out. Suyog's wife Chanchal then convinced him by saying that she is confident the scheme would double his money. That's how Pinjan fell into the trap. He emptied all his savings including fixed deposits and pawned his wife's jewellery. He then had a sum of Rs 8 lakh which he then invested by transfering to Chanchal & Pradeep's bank account hoping for good returns. 2 months later he heard only vague excuses. Despite contacting them several times, they did not respond. That's when Pinjan realised he had been duped. He then filed a complaint with the help of a social activist Manisha Dharne. Manisha then brought the case in front of Pune police commissioner Amitabh Gupta. Gupta was shocked and felt that there were many others who were duped like Pinjan. The 3 male accused are now in police custody together and are not in judicial custody yet. They will remain there till 18th December. Whereas Chanchal is currently in the women's jail in judicial custody. The investigation is challenging as crores were invested. Since there is no such scheme in the market, police are wondering where it all started. To communicate with the accused, the police have called an interpreter to understand the matter. Bhagyashree Navatake attached with the police's economic offences wing and cybercrimes said, After Pinjan filed the complaint, the complaint was not filed immediately. They investigated transactions, conducted a deep probe decided the scam was true. We found evidence of the accused promising to double the investors money. Only after this, the arrest was made. Suyog has emmerged as the kingpin and officials suspect a mastermind behind the scam. However their identity is being investigated. Cops suspect there are many other companies owned by the Deaf like Suyog's that is promising to double investments. An investigation will be conducted and they plan to make many arrests. Through this scheme many Deaf individuals profited whereas many were also duped. Assistant police inspector Amol Kale said, These 4 have been arrested in scam for cheating Deaf & Deaf Blind people like them through the scheme. Many Deaf individuals fell into the trap because of various videos shared on social media. In one video Suyog gifted a car to a Deaf person. Suyog said he is thankful for people who invested in th scheme. After making a killing in the share market he was able to double people's investments. With the leftover money he was then able to gift a car to a Deaf man for his hardwork. People across India were shocked to see him earn so much in a short time. This is how they were convinced to invest in the scheme but none of it was real. He also gave such gifts to others and spread videos and photos about it to convince people. The police has now launched a huge investigation and are going through the accused's passbooks, their shares, etc. Suyog started doing all this after learning about the share market. Dhananjay Jagtap was also one of the victims. Jagtap invested Rs 30 lakh in the scheme hoping to double his investments to grow his business. On Suyog's assurance, he invested the amount. However he never saw any money. Suyog made random excuses and then stopped answering. The police then began suspecting Jagtap's Platinum Investments & Finances Global Solutions which also promises to double investments. The police suspected him and found that even he has delayed paying investors back. This is why Jagtap was arrested and is being questioned. He will remain in custody till 20th December as he needs to be questioned. A newspapers quoted the police saying, along with the 4 accused, even Jagtap will remain in police custody. They will remain in custody for long because it is difficult to understand how the accused advertised the scheme. They are also investigating who created plans, logo, investment scheme, account number, graphics, etc. They want to know where the person stays and whether he was aware about the scam. The investigation is going to take a while. An interpreter will also be roped in. A Deaf boy Vishal Kunjir, who was duped. He was a farmer. He fell for the scheme and invested Rs 27 lakh. He got this amount by borrowing from his relatives and emptied all his savings. All in the hopes to double his money. The accused told him he would give double or triple the amount in a few or even 9 months. Suyog had said the amount could be doubled to Rs 54 lakh or tripled to 1 crore. That's when Kunjir decided to give his money. Kunjir fell into the trap by seeing the car gift video. Seeing Suyog gifting the car because of Deaf peoples investments, Kunjir had a feeling of kinship and invested the amount. Sadly he lost all his money. Pushkar Patil and Anuj Mantri representing Abhijar & Pradeep said, Our clients were not at fault. Suyog was the mastermind. Suyog scamed Abhijar & Pradeep members of his own community to lure investors. The investments brought in by the two were all eaten up by Suyog and they were left with nothing. They simply interpret the information without getting stressed or intimidated. They merely interpret the answers to the questions asked by the press. They do this without a worry and leave once their work is done. The one who are stressed are government officials or dignitaries while answering the questions to avoid embarassment. Queensland Deputy Premier Steven Miles held a press conference in Brisbane in a garden. Mike Webb was interpreting very efficiently and professionally. While he was interpreting, a bird relieved itself on him. The bird was an owl. When this happened, the interpreter cursed mid-way and removed his jacket, Then someone gave him a tissue to wipe his forehead. The entire incident was caught on camera live and it went viral. It was so funny. However Mike did not leave the event half way. He was not at all disgusted. He removed his jacket, cleaned himself and continued interpreting. He did all this very quickly and continued interpreting the event. Many found this very funny. The Queensland police joked that they would surely catch and interogate the owl for its offence. People commented on Mike's professionalism, work ethic and joked about it as well. While some argued saying “it’s brings good fortune".

Bollywood actress Jahnvi Kapoor has started shooting for a film in Punjab. The name of the film is "Good Luck Jerry". The film is produced by Anand L Rai's Colour Yellow Productions and directed by Sidharth Sengupta. The shoot was going on in Bassi Pathana area of Punjab. A group of angry farmers barged in on the set and stopped the shoot. According to the local police the protesters said that, for a long time the farmers have been protesting. But Bollywood celebrities have not shown support to the farmers on social media. This why they were upset and stopped the shoot. The farmers insisted that Jahnvi must show support to the farmers on social media. Jahnvi Kapoor then posted an Instagram story in which she wrote, Farmers are very important for the country. They are the ones who keep the nation alive. I hope a resolution is reached soon between the government and the farmers that benefits the farmers. After she posted on instagram, farmers went back and the shoot resumed. Good Luck Jerry will star Janhvi Kapoor in the lead. Other stars in the film are Deepak Dobriyal, Meeta Vashishth and Neeraj Sood. The shooting of the film would continue till March.

They owned a Royal Enfield and scooty. During the violence many Muslims were very afraid and wanted to escape. These two Sardars, transported 60 to 80 Muslims to a safe location on their two-wheelers. The father and son duo say they had sensed the situation was spiralling out of control in Gokalpuri in northeast Delhi. People chanting Pro CAA slogans, Jai Shri Ram and raising slogans in praise of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. These people even chanted slogans saying that those against the CAA will be shot dead. Because of this the Muslims in the locality then gathered for a meeting. They were all afraid of being shot by the mob. The large hindu mob had gathered at the main road outside Gokalpuri and were chanting Pro CAA slogans. The Muslims found it difficult to leave, as they could be shot or lynched by the mob. Mohinder Singh then offered to help and started moving them from Gokalpuri to Kardampuri, which is one kilometer away. He ferried them on his motorcycle. Mohinder Singh, said that his son was on the Bullet motorcycle and he was on the scooty, and they took three to four people at a time. They took 20 such trips. They even recused women, men and children on their bikes. For some of the boys who could be easily identified as Muslims, they tied Sikh turbans to conceal they identity and protect them from the mob. Mohinder said, “I did not see Hindu or Muslim, I just wanted to keep people safe. I only saw that they were human like me. Most importantly I saw little children. I felt like they were my children, this is why I rescued them. There is nothing more to say. I just felt it was important to save everyone. Gokalpuri saw some of the worst violence in the three days of rioting, which has left almost 40 people dead. Head constable Ratan Lal died of a bullet injury that he sustained here. Muslim shops, houses and a mosque were burnt. The Muslims have run away in fear and are yet to return. Mohinder Singh said that these riots reminded him of the 1984 Anti-Sikh riots, when Indira Gandhi was assassinated by her Sikh bodyguards. Because of this, Sikhs were targetted and there were violent riots. Delhi's riots were just the same.

Grant David Whitaker (Sign Name) is a 25-year-old Deaf man from Mackinaw, Illinois. On 20th August, his family went to the Lake County, Illinois police and said that Grant was missing and they could not find him. Grant and Mavrick Fisher (sign name) were working together. Mavrick was 21-years-old and also lived in the USA. The two of them were working together to create a Deaf farming community. Grant did not agree regarding their future plans and wanted to leave. According to the police, Grant’s family had said that Mavrick and Grant had gotten into a fight due to their disagreement. After this Grant went missing. This news has created a furor in the American media and the Deaf community is circulating the news as well. You have heard about the news channel Daily Moth. Two anonymous individuals were in touch with them. These two individuals told the entire story to the Daily Moth. The first individual said that, Mavrick had said that while travelling to Elko, Nevada Grant and Mavrick had a disagreement and a very big argument. This is when Mavrick killed him. Mavrick said Grant was a demon and felt threatened by him. So he picked up a rock, smashed Grant’s skull and killed him. The second individual also repeated the same story of Mavrick smashing Grant's skull with a rock. After telling the two individuals all this, A few days before he left for Mexico Mavrick said that, after smashing Grant's skull he placed the body in a sleeping bag and placed it inside his car. The body remained there for a few days. He said that the stench was unbearable. His skin had turned yellow and there were worms. The second person even warned Mavrick and told him to be careful of fingerprints as the police would catch. According to Mavrick, it was Grant who tried to kill him with a knife. This is why he used the rock to kill him. A video has gone viral where Mavrick is in Mexico and is walking and recording himself in sign language. He said he would rather die than to go to jail. The first individual said that Mavrick had decided to turn himself in to the police, but wanted to enjoy a few days in Mexico before going to jail. The Mexico police have arrested Mavrick. They then questioned him regarding where Grant was. Mavrick told them where Grant was. Hearing this, the American police found Grant's body in a car in Lake County. The Mexican police deported Mavrick to San Diego, USA. Where the American police arrested him as he was a dangerous killer. In California, a murderer can be jailed for up to 25 years or for life. Now that Mavrick is jailed, he will not be released on bail. Pam Embry Thierry, is Grant's grandmother. She thanked the entire Deaf community for their information and support. It was because of the two brave individuals information that the killer was arrested. If they had not come forward with the information, Grant's family would continue to worry and would never be able to find him. She thanked everyone for their information. Shelby Viguier was Grant's cousin. The Dailymoth took permission from her before broadcasting her Facebook message. In her Facebook post she said, she and Grant were cousins who grew up together. They conversed in sign language and she learnt ASL because of him. She had promised Grant to teach her baby sign language. Recently she gave birth to a baby. She took a picture of the baby signing 'I Love you.' For a long time there was no reply and now she heard about his death. He would never meet her baby. Grant's cousin is very sad but has promised to fulfil her vow to Grant and will teach her baby sign language.

Former Australian cricket legend Dean Jones has died of a massive heart attack on 24th September. The 59-year-old Jones, was part of the Star Sports commentary team in the ongoing IPL 2020 which is being held in Dubai. He did the commentary from a hotel in Mumbai. Jones made his ODI debut in 1984. Jones played very well and helped Australia win their first World Cup in 1987. Also, during the India vs Australia test match in 1986, Jones had an amazing innings scoring 210 runs in Chennai's extreme heat. After the match, Jones ended up in the hospital on a saline drip due to the severe exhaustion. In his life, he played 52 Test matches scoring 3,631 runs at an average of 46.55. Jones also played in 164 ODIs and scored 6,068 runs with the help of seven centuries and 46 fifties. He was cricket analyst for the IPL for a while now. Jones is survived by his wife Jane and his two daughters Isabella and Phoebe.

Over 14 lakh students were to appear for the CBSE Class 12 board exams. The students were waiting for an announcement since mid-April when the exam was postponed due to the COVID-19 situation in the country. For many weeks, students and their parents were very worried about the board exams and the COVID situation in India. Yesterday on 1st June PM Modi announced that 12th Board exams for both CBSE and CISCE Class 12 exams have been cancelled. The decision was made after taking feedback from states, teachers, etc and also because of the uncertain COVID situation in the country. He said, the health and safety of our students is of utmost importance and students should not be forced to appear for exams in such a stressful situation The students will be assessed as per marks scored by them in tests conducted during the year. More information on this will be announced in a few days. Since PM Modi's announcement on 1st June evening, netizens are celebrating the decision and have flooded social media platforms with hilarious memes.

In Madhya Pradesh's Ujjain, there is an association named MDA. It was founded on 3rd January 2018. Their President is Hemant Dagre - sign name - and General Secretary is Faizan Khan - sign name - Have a look at their Board members. Due to Modi's continuous extension of the lockdown, people were struggling due to unemployment & starvation. The Deaf community in Ujjain approached Faizan at the MDA for food and support. After a lot of contemplation, Faizan approached the President Hemant Dagre. They had a discussion and both agreed to support the struggling Deaf community. Dagre said they had only Rs 5,000 which were not sufficient. Then the MDA Board contributed funds and various members contributed as well. They collected Rs 7,000/- and now they had a total of Rs 12,000/- There were many Red Zones in Ujjain due to which travel was difficult. They waited. Then on 1st June 2020 the government ordered the relaxation of the lockdown. GS Faizan then contacted the Board members and volunteers. They met on 2nd June 2020 and purchased food items such as rice, wheat flour, onion, oil, etc. It was then made in separate packages. Once that was done, on the next day 3rd June, they distributed food to people living 2 km away. We applaud MDA and their volunteers for supporting Deaf individuals. The PM always travels for meetings, seminars, meetings, etc. Whenever he travels, he has a very strict itinerary. Once his flight lands at any place, he is swiftly taken to the venue. Once he lands, he is never made to wait for transport. As soon as he lands, he greets people and he is driven off. Everything is very carefully planned. There is no room for mistakes. His bodygaurds are the Special Protection Group personnel and they always protect him from any attacks. Modi's car is always in the middle of the convoy and he is given the highest security. There are never any errors. All the PMs in Indian history have been given very strong security. The reason for such high security arose after the assasination of Congress leader Rajeev Gandhi in Tamil Nadu. A woman wearing a suicide vest bent to touch his feet and detonated the bomb. A security lapse led to his death because of which security for all PMs was increased. There is not even a second's delay. However yesterday Modi was stuck on a flyover in Punjab for more than 20 minutes! Modi has never had to wait for so long. Oh my god! He had to wait for 20 minutes! How shocking! Let me tell you why this happened. PM Modi had landed in Bathinda, Punjab yesterday 5 Jan 2022 and was to be flown to Ferozepur for a BJP rally by a helicopter. He was supposed to talk about various developmental projects for the upcoming elections. Upon landing in Bathinda he was supposed to be flown in an helicopter to Ferozpur. However, low visibility due to extreme weather conditions, he went to the venue via road. There were alternate routes in place. From Bathinda to Ferozepur it take 2 hours and all security arrangements had been made. Around 10 km from the rally site, the PM's convoy which was on a bridge was blocked by farm protesters. The convoy could take any other route and were stuck on the flyover. PM Modi was seen waiting in a black armoured Toyota Fortuner surrounded by SPG officers. For the first time Modi was made to wait for so long. The security weren't able to solve the problem and Modi ended up waiting for 20 minutes. Modi then had to cut short his visit and head back to the airport. The rally had to be cancelled. This security lapse is very disappointing. BJP chief JP Nadda lashed out at Punjab CM and said, ‘It is sad that PM's visit to launch development projects worth thousands of crores for the upcoming elections. But Modi was made to wait because of the security lapse and had to cancel the rally. This is very wrong. CM Channi refused to get on phone to help Modi reach the venue. State Police was instructed to prevent people from attending the rally. Does the state not support Modi? This is a Congress conspiracy! In response to this CM Channi said, ‘As a Punjabi, I would die to protect Pm Modi but there was no danger to his life. There was no security breach. We have every respect for our Prime Minister. BJP leader and Union Minister Smriti Irani said, ‘It was a murderous conspiracy to kill the PM. The Congress hates him, now they want to harm him.’

On 1st Febrauray 2024, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced the Union interim budget 2024-25. We have general elections scheduled between April to May 2024,  therefore the government has announced an interim budget until the new elected government presents its annual budget. Now let me tell you some key points of the interim budget announced by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. 1. Through the Pradhan Mantri Suryodaya Yojana, in 1 crore households in India, solar panels on the rooftops will be installed. 1 crore households will be made solar powered. Under this scheme, 300 Units Of free electricity will be provided to these 1 crore households every month. The households are expected to save ₹15,000 to ₹18,000 on electricity bill per year. 2. FM announced a new Rural Housing Scheme that will allow those living in rented houses, slums, chawls, etc. to buy or build their own house in the next 5 years. Government will also build 2 crore new houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) to meet the high demand of the growing population. 3. More medical colleges will be set up using the existing infrastructure. 4. Finance Minister Sitharaman announced that Healthcare cover under Ayushman Bharat scheme earlier was not given to Accredited Social Health Activist (ASHA) helpers. However now the Ayushman Bharat healthcare scheme has been extended to all ASHA workers as well. 5. The Lakhpati Didi scheme is focused on women. The target of the Lakhpati Didi scheme has been increased from 2 crore women to 3 crore women. The aim of this scheme is to encourage women to establish micro-enterprises and earn a minimum annual income of ₹1 lakh. The scheme trains women in LED bulb making, drone operation, tailoring, weaving, etc. The women can then set up a micro-enterprises conprising of 11 - 12 people. 6. Last year ₹5.94 lakh crores were allocated to defense. This year funds allocated to defense have been increased by 4.5% to ₹6.21 lakh crores. 7. Policies and schemes focusing education, skill development, support for startups, and sports achievements have been promised. 8. Finance Minsiter announced that a corpus of ₹1 lakh crore has been kept, that would be available on loan at minimal or nil interest rates for 50 years. This is to encourage research & development in ‘sunrise domains' which are new but fast growing and expected to become important in the future. There will be nil interest on this loan and ₹1 lakh crore corpus has been kept. 9. 40,000 railway coaches are promised to be converted to Vande Bharat standard. Metro Rail to be expanded to other cities as well. 10. The new ‘UDAN’ scheme has been introduced. There are Tier-1, Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities. Tier 1 are metro cities such as Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru etc which have good air connectivity. Tier - 2 cities are cities which have 50,000 to 100,000 population. and Tier - 3 cities are the ones that have 20,000 to 50,000 population. Under the UDAN scheme 517 new routes will be introduced to connect tier-2 and tier-3 cities. Upgradation and expansion of the existing airports will also be taken up. 11. Green energy reduces air pollution and protects the environment. Green energy such as biogas, CNG, electric cars will be a major investment in the future. 12. The Central Government has funds for states to developed infrastructure, branding, marketing to increase tourism etc. Central government will provide long-term interest-free loans to states for their infrascructure development, tourism etc. The aim is to encourage all the states to develop. 13. Government has plans to increase farmers' income and will promote private investment as one of the post-harvest activities. 14. Has the Income Tax slab rates, GST rates, other taxes & import duty changed? Finance Minister announced that there has been no change in these. 15. Capital expenditure has been increased by 11.1% to ₹11.11 lakh crore for infrastructural development and increase port connectivity on all Indian islands including Lakshadweep, Andaman and Nicobar, etc. This plan has been announced to boost tourism on all the islands. 16. Developmental assistance aid fund for Maldives last year was ₹770.90 crore. This year it has been reduced to ₹600 crore. The budget of 2024-25 is an interim budget. A Legend Airlines’ chartered flight took off from Dubai and landed at Châlons Vatry airport, 160 kilometers away from Paris, France for refuelling. Paris officials received an anonymous tip that the passengers were likely to be victims of human trafficking. I will tell you what human trafficking means. The officials grounded the flight and blocked the entry and exit. Human trafficking is transportation of people and exploiting them by forcing women into sexual slavery, child labour, slavery etc. The flight had 303 passengers  including 11 unaccompanied minors and a 21-month-old child accompanied by an adult. The passengers were initially confined to the aircraft but were later permitted into the terminal building and were provided with makeshift beds and meals etc. It was clear it wasn't a case of human trafficking but since the flight was enroute to Nicaragua, Central America, it probably was a case of illegal immigration. Out of the 303 passengers, most of them were Indians and especially Tamilians, Gujaratis and Punjabis. They were given bedding, meals etc at the terminal itself. Two passengers were taken under police custody on suspicion of involvement in an illegal immigration ring. The airport was turned into a makeshift courtroom and judges, lawyers carried out emergency hearings to determine the next steps. The lawyers said the situation was not handled properly by the French authorities and authorize the plane’s departure to Mumbai on 25th December 2023. During the hearing at airport terminal, interpreters were called in to facilitate communication between the French authorities and the Indians. The flight for permitted to depart to Mumbai on 25th December 2023. The flight got delayed as 25 passengers including 5 minors refused to return to India instead of Nicaragua and decided to remain in France and seek asylum. After a lot of discussions, the aircraft took off from Vatry airport and landed in Mumbai with 276 passengers. The Indian authorities dispatched an investigation team and expressed their concerns over the potential human trafficking. It is also unclear why the flight was sent to Mumbai instead of resuming its journey to Nicaragua. It is not clear if people are travelling to Central America to illegally to USA and Canada from there. Two arrested people are still in France for investigation. Also when the others will be put on domestic flights is not known. According to US Customs and Border Protection(UCBP) data, about 97,000 Indians were apprehended while unlawfully crossing into the US between October 2022 and September 2023. ISH News had released videos of such incidents earlier. where a family froze to death and families drowned while crossing the Canada - USA border illegally. You can watch the video here. And now this flight was sent back to Mumbai. Thousands of Indians try to enter USA or Canada illegally by first flying to Central American countires. For example, if an Indian does not get visa to go UK or USA, they obtain a tourist visa for the European Union' allowing free movement across 26 countries, and then illegally go to UK. Many people have been caught using such donkey routes. Donkey route originates from the Punjabi word "dunki," meaning to move from one place to another. Just like the flight that was caught recently, Shahrukh Khan’s movie Dunki tells the story of people going through the ‘donkey route’!

Munawar Faruqui is a stand-up comedian from Junagadh in Gujarat. Munawar and four others have been arrested. for passing indecent remarks against Home Minister Amit Shah and Hindu Gods during a show at Indore, Madhya Pradesh. Faruqui and four others were arrested as people were upset with the remarks. Police said that the comedy show was held at a cafe in 56 Dukan area in Indore. In-charge of Tukoganj police station Kamlesh Sharma said that Munawar and others were arrested on complaint received from Eklavya Singh Gaur. Eklavya Singh Gaur is the son of local MLA Malini Laxman Singh Gaur. Eklavya filed a compaint against Munawar and others that they were disrespecting Amit Shah and the Hindu gods. Eklavya Gaur and his associates had gone to the show as audience. During the show Munawar spoke indecently about Amit Shah and Hindu God. Eklavya objected to the comments, he argued over it and also forced the event to stop. 5 people were arrested including Munawar. The four others were Edwin Anthony, Prakhar Vyas, Priyam Vyas and Nalin Yadav. Eklavya Gaur told reporters that 100 spectators were sitting in a small hall. Social distancing rules were also not followed and it was organised without the permission. District Court Judge Yatindra Kumar Guru heard the arguments of both the sides. Manawar and Nalin Yadav had applied for bail. After hearing arguments of both the sides the judge rejected the bail plea. Anshuman Shrivastava, lawyer for Munawar Faruqui and Nalin Yadav, said that the allegations were vague. He said the two were arrested under political pressure. The lawyer for Eklavya Gaur, Vimal Mishra opposed the bail stating that inspite of the coronavirus situation the event was organised without permission. disrespecting Hindu Gods and the event was full of obscenity despite the presence of minor boys and girls. So, no bail should be given.

The police on 16th September found bodies of four people in Gairigaun area of Tinkune in Kathmandu, Nepal. The bodies were found in Shree Dibya Sawmill. Police were shocked to see the gruesome murders. Let me tell you how the police came to know about the incident. Out of the 4 dead, 3 were from the same family - a mother, her son and his wife. The man worked as a security guard at the sawmill. The fourth victim was 20 year old Nabin Rai. Police wondered about the reason for the murders. A 28-year-old man named Dipendra Rai, who lived in the same house, found the bodies. He immediately rushed to the police station and informed them of the murders. However, the police arrested him after noticing blood on his clothes. Rai was released after police found that he had no involvement in the killing. On the same day on 16th September 2023, the police teams reached the site for investigation. After returning to the police station, they checked the CCTV footage of 15th September 2023 of the area. In the footage of 15th September midnight, they found a suspicious man roaming around with a bag. In the footage, he was even seen running on the footpath next to road. The police was suspicious about him. Police found that he was in the Pepsico area and launched a search operation. He was finally found and arrested. While questioning the police found that the man is Deaf. The accused has been identified as Sindhupalchok resident, Sanjay Bhandari. Police questioned him about what he was doing in the Pepsico area. He wrote in English, “I Killed Four People” on a piece of paper. Since communicating with Bhandari was difficult for the police, they called an interpreter and got his statement with interpreter's assistance. A few days ago, Bhandari had a prior altercation with Nabin Rai after being struck by a motorcycle driven by Rai. In a bid to take revenge, Bhandari reached the saw mill where Nabin used to live. Bhandari killed Nabin with a khukuri, which is a small sharp knife commonly used by locals in Nepal. After killing Nabin, he killed the 3 other people who lived downstairs for the fear of being caught. After killing Nabin upstairs and the family downstairs, Bhandari escaped from the site. When asked what he was doing in Pepsico area, Bhandari said, "Police would have caught me in Sindhupalchok, so I went to Pepsico area to take refuge at a friend's house. I climbed a tree to gain entry into the compound, However, not finding my friend there, I proceeded to another house. That is when the police caught me." Police took his statement with the assitance of the interpreter and still further investigation is going on. Sadly 4 people lost their lives.

India shares a border with Bangladesh and China. A man was allegedly trying to cross over into India illegally through the India-Bangladesh border. The Chinese national was arrested by the Border Security Force for entering illegally. This happened on 10th June. The border force seized two iPhones, 1 Apple Laptops, an Indian SIM card, a Bangladeshi SIM card and 2 Chinese SIM cards, US dollars, Bangladeshi Taka & Indian currency. They even found 2 debit cards, five money transaction devices two small torchlights, two USB drives, 3 batteries and many other things. During the interrogation, the intruder identified himself as Han Junwe, a resident of Hubei province in China and he is 36 years old. When asked how he reached India he said, he reached Dhaka, Bangladesh on June 2 on a business visa and stayed there with a Chinese friend. On June 8, he came to Chapainawabganj, district in Bangladesh and was staying at a hotel there. 2 days later on  10 June, he tried to enter India but was caught. The BSF have seized his passport as well. As per documents seized from his possession, it is believed that Junwe was working for Chinese Intelligence Agency in India. According to a statement issued by BSF, Junwe is a wanted criminal. He revealed that he had visited India four times before and this was not the first time. He visited Hyderabad in 2010 and Delhi and Gurugram thrice after 2019.

After the Queen's death, Indian government declared a day of mourning during which the Indian flag will be drawn at half mast on all the government & non-government buildings. Also, during mourning period, there will be no celebration in the country. After Queen Elizabeth’s death her eldest son Prince Charles has became the new King. King Charles announced that his eldest son William & his wife Kate will be crowned as the new Prince & Princess. Let me now tell you about Queen Elizabeth II's life. Queen Elizabeth Windsor was born on 21st April 1926. Queen Elizabeth belonged to the royal family which forcefully ruled India for a long time. Indians fought a long battle before getting independence in 1947. Queen Elizabeth's father died in 1952 after which Elizabeth at the age of 27 was crowned as the Queen of UK on 2nd June 1953. In an interesting fact, Elizabeth never went to a public school. She was educated at home with Margaret, her sister. Unlike other prince and princess, Queen Elizabeth was taught at home. Elizabeth's schooling also included learning to swim, ride, music, dance etc. In another interesting fact, do you remember World War II? Young Elizabeth asked for her parents' permission to help the World War II victims. However, her father was not agreeing as she was a royal. But Elizabeth was adamant and finally her father had to give in. She then drove service ambulances and food trucks. Being from the royal family and not from the army, Elizabeth still helped in the war. To honour her efforts, she was given the rank of Junior Commander. Later, Queen Eliabeth married Prince Philip and brought him into the Royal family. They had a stable relationship and marriage for more than 70 years before Prince Philip died in 2021. You may think that being a Queen, she would not pay taxes. But, Queen Elizabeth too paid taxes since 1992. This was because Windsor Castle, the Queen's weekend residence, was destroyed in fire. The public protested against paying millions of pounds for its repair through their taxes stating that it was Queen's property. Queen Elizabeth voluntarily agreed to pay for 70 percent of the cost of repairs and also pay tax. She was the first roayl to accept paying tax like common people. She also decided to open her home at Buckingham Palace, London to the public to generate extra funds from tickets. As per reports, Queen Elizabeth is also known to be a dog lover, She owned more than 30 dogs of the corgis breed She loved dogs so much that her dog accompanied her almost everywhere. Queen Elizabeth's crown still has the most expensive Kohinoor diamond that was forcefully taken from India. It was not Queen Elizabeth who had taken away the diamond, but her ancestors. The Kohinoor is still mounted on the crown of the Queen. Seeing this the Indians are not happy. as it reminds us of the atrocities and the death caused by the Britishers on Indians before independence in 1947. Indians are not happy seeing this. Fortunately, PM Modi’s personal account @narendramodi, was not hacked. This account has over 61.8 million followers on Twitter. He is one of the most famous world leaders on Twitter. There was a similar incidence in July when the Twitter accounts of famous personalities were hacked. Celebrities like Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, Barack Obama, Bill Gates, etc. were victims of hacking. A seven-and-a-half-year-old cocker spaniel, Khushi in Delhi has undergone a pacemaker implant surgery to correct her abnormal heart rhythms. After the surgery she became very energetic! In India there are many people who undergo pacemaker implant surgeries for abnormal heart rhythms and quickly recover. This is first time a pacemaker was implanted in a dog. Let me tell what a pacemaker is. When people have abnormal heart rhythms it, this means per minute there are less heart beats which leads to less blood circulation Once the pacemaker is implanted, the heart begins to beat normally per minute and the person is high energised. Khushi had a similar problem. Which is why a pacemaker was implanted in her. Dr Bhanu Dev Sharma, a veterinary doctor said, "Khushi’s heart had complications. There was a blockage in heart. Her heart rate was 20 beats per minute compared to the normal 60-120 beats per minute, But Khushi heart beat only 20 times per minute. This is why she was operated on December 15, 2019. After the surgery there was a big change in Khushi! She became very happy. Before the surgery, she used to be extremely tired, she fainted,was lifeless and slept the whole time. After the surgery now she is happy and full of life! It feels as if she is back to puppyhood.

CISF is a security force that frisks and checks passengers at airports, metros, petrol pumps etc. B Dilli is a Sub Inspector of the CISF at Manipur's Imphal airport. He was responsible for checking the passengers while they entered the airport. While frisking passengers he noticed a passenger, named Mohammed Shereef a resident of Kozhikode, Kerala. who was supposed to fly from Imphal to Delhi on 2:40pm flight. The officer passed the metals detector over the Shereef's body. Whenever the metal detector went past his hips, it started beeping loudly. The inspector inquired whether shereef had any metal object on him but Shereef refused. However officer Dilli was suspicious and took him to a private room. The officials again questioned him, but shereef denying the presence of metallic objects. The security offical was not convinced and sent him for an x-ray. The X-ray revealed that there were 4 packets of gold inside his rectum. When the officer confronted him, Shereef confessed. When the officer asked what the packets contained, they found that gold ornaments would be difficult to insert inside the rectum. These ornaments, gold biscuits can be easily detected when smuggled. This is why gold is made into a paste similar to pastes made in blenders. Shereef has put packets of gold paste inside his rectum so that he would not be caught. However he was caught. This maybe because of some metal in the packet was detected. He was extremely annoyed at being caught despite the planning. //The official found that the packet weighed approximately 900 grams and was valed at Rs 42 lakh. Inserted 4 packets of this inside his rectum but he was arrested. He has now been handed over to senior officers of the CISF and Customs for further investigations. He may have travelled from Kerala to Manipur to collect the gold and then go to Delhi but he was caught.

Petra De Sutter was elected as the Vice Prime Minister of Belgium. Petra is a transgender woman. She is the first transgender woman appointed as the Vice Prime Minister. Her name has now been itched in history. People in future will know her as the first transgender Vice PM of Belgium. Europe has many transgender people in politics but none at such a high ranking post. This makes Petra the first one. After her appointment Petra Tweeted, In Belgium and in most parts of Europe, being gay, lesbian, female or male does not matter. A person's skills, intelligence etc are valued and all are treated equally. Petra said I am proud of Belgium and parts of Europe. Petra added that now that I am selected, I will spread awareness all around the world to stop discrimination against the LGBTQIA+ community. It includes gay, lesbian, bisexuals, etc. Such individuals within the LGBTQIA+ are entitled to their human rights and they must not be discriminated. This is the sign for the LQBTQIA+. The community should not be suppressed as they are humans too. Petra in her last year's election campaign speech said, people talk first about her being transgender. She said that being a transgender is a part of me but I have other skills. I want people to talk about my work in politics along with me being a transgender. Petra is a gynaecologist and is now one of seven Deputy Prime Ministers in Belgium. LGBTQ+ rights groups are very happy and proud by Petra's appointment. Matt Beard, executive director of international LGBTQIA+ advocacy group All Out said, We are delighted that a member of the trans community has been appointed on the Vice Prime Minster post .” World over LGBTQ+ rights are more accepted now. Till a few years back, members of the LGBTQ+ community were never elected for high ranking political posts. Now if their work is good, they are elected. For example in Thailand, there were many candidates for the PM. One person named Pauline Ngarmpring was the first transgender candidate for prime minister. LGBTQ Victory Institute which supports LGBTQ+ candidates said, more than 880 LGBTQ+ candidates will take part in elections across the country this year.

British Prime Minister Boris Johnson arrived at Ahmedabad, Gujarat on 21 April morning. Johnson was greeted by state Governor Acharya Devvrat and Gujarat CM Bhupendra Patel. When their convoy exited the airport, they were greeted by Gujarati dancers. The British PM was very touched by this. Soon after his arrival he Tweeted, It’s fantastic to be in India, the world’s largest democracy. India is destined for greatness. I am ecstatic to collaborate on projects and new innitiatives, which would lead to the employments & development in both countries. I am very excited for this. During his one day stay in Gujarat, Johnson visited the Sabarmati Ashram. Which was Gandhiji's residence that has been turned into a museum. Johnson visited the museum which had Gandhiji's writings, meetings, bedroom and all his personal items. The PM was very inspired by the visit. He wrote in the visitor's book at the ashram, Gandhiji was the best. He was such a simple man, who wore a white shawl and used a walking stick. However he had two strong principles. Truth & Non-violence. These changed the world. The british left and India gained independance. I am very inspired by this simple man. He then met famous industrialist Gautam Adani who greeted him with flowers. After their meeting, Johnson visited the JCB factory in the Panchmahal district of Gujarat. Images of him climbing on a JCB went viral on the internet. He also visited the Akshardham temple in Gandhinagar. Later in the day, Johnson spent nearly an hour at the under-construction Gujarat Biotechnology University. The university was set up by the state government in collaboration with UK-based Edinburgh University. Johnson held a meeting with the CM Bhupendra Patel, science scholars and other academics. It was only for 15 mins. Yesterday evening he left for Delhi. Today, 22 April, he is going to have a meeting with PM Modi. You may know that while many countries have condemned the Russian invasion of Ukraine, India has taken a neutral stand. Western, USA &  European countries have asked India to clearly state its stance on the issue. India is yet to say anything. Especially the US, has accused India of not taking a clear stance against Russia. When asked whether he will talk to Modi about the Russia-Ukraine war, Johnson said, “I think everybody understands that India and Russia have historically had very different relationships compared to Uk-Russia relations. I am looking forward to talking about this with PM Modi.” After his meeting with Modi rumours say that Johnson was expected to announce major investment and new collaboration on cutting-edge science, technology, etc Today Prime Minister Narendra Modi received UK PM Boris Johnson at Rashtrapati Bhavan and they will have a meeting. The UK Prime Minister will also hold talks with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar.

People take many pictures and videos of friends & family. These high resolution files are generally stored on Google Photos. For so long there was no limit over the number of files that could be saved on the service. However, many are confused over Google Photo's latest policy update that starts from 1st June. People are worried that they may lose all their images from 1st June. That's not the case. Google has said that, Photos and videos that have been before 1st June 2021, will remain as it is. Post 1st June, users will be given a storage limit of 15gb. Once the 15gb storage is used up, individuals will have to buy more storage on a monthly or yearly basis. Do not worry, Prior files will remain as it is. If you have used up your 15 GB free storage across Gmail, Google Drive and Google Photos you will have to purchase additional storage as per plans meant for Indian users. Google has stated that Pixel smartphone users will be able to upload unlimited content for free as they are using a Google phone. Such users need not worry as they will be able to upload unlimited files even after 1st June.

Yesterday i.e. 7th August evening, an Air India Express plane from Dubai bound to Kerala tried to land at Kerala's Kozhikode International airport. But when it tried to land, due to the strong winds it had to turn back. When it tried to land the second time, the flight skid and crashed into the valley. The aircraft fell 35 feet from the hilltop runway. The mishap took place at about 7.10 pm and the aircraft was badly damaged. Rajeev Jain, at the Civil Aviation Ministry said, Rescue operations are on and passengers are being taken to hospital. A total of 191 people were on board. 17 people have died but the number may increase. 112 have been injured and many are still stuck inside the debris. Pilot Deepak Vasant Sathe & co-pilot are no more. The cockpit and the front door of the flight were completely damaged due to the impact. The Kozhikode airport, carved on top of a hill is one of Kerala's most prominent international terminals and handles significant flights from abroad, The Vande Bharat flight programme was intend to bring back Indian citizens stranded abroad due to the pandemic. The flight was bringing back Indians from abroad after the restrictions were eased. Fire engines and ambulances rushed to the spot. Emergency services personnel were seen working in the dark and spraying the wreckage with water. It is believed that heavy rains in Kerala may be one of the reasons for the mishap. Local MLA told reporters that the aircraft fell 35 feet from the hilltop runway due to heavy rains. Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan tweeted, “I have instructed Ambulance and Fire Force to take urgent action & make necessary arrangements for rescue and medical support.” PM Narendra Modi spoke to the Kerala CM offering support and offered condolences to the families of the deceased. There has been heavy rainfall throughout the day in Kerala because of which there were landslides and the plane crashed.

Once a farmer and his wife lived in a village with their small son. They loved him very much. We must have a pet. The farmer said to his wife one day, When our son grows up, he will need a companion. This pet will be our son's companion. His wife. One evening, the farmer brought with him a tiny mongoose. It's a baby mongoose. said his wife, but will soon be fully groomed. He will be a friend to our son. Both the baby and the mongoose grew. In five or six months the mongoose had grown. to its full size, a lovely animal. with two shining black eyes and a bushy tail. The farmer's son was still a baby in the cradle, sleeping and crying alternately. One day the farmer's wife wanted to go to the market. She fed the baby and dragged him to sleep in his little cradle. Picking up the basket, she said to her husband. I'm off to the bazar. The baby is sleeping. Keep an eye on him. Frankly, I don't like to leave the child alone with the mongoose. You needn't be afraid, said the farmer. The Mongoose is a friendly animal. It's as sweet as our baby and they are the best friends you know. The wife went away and the farmer having nothing to do in the house. decided to go out and take a look at his fields not far away. He ran into some friends on the way back and didn't return for quite some time. Now the synopsis for the rest of the story. The farmers wife returned home from the market carrying a heavy basket. She found the mongoose at the entrance of the house with blood. on his face and balls. She jumped to the conclusion that it was her son's blood. and the mongoose was the guilty one. She cried. touching the mongoose who lay dead and still. Unaware of her sobbing. The farmer's wife. who had acted hastily and rashly, stared long at the dead mongoose. They were there to make sure if a protest started in J&K they would control the situation. Close to a school barricades were put up and they were checking the cars and bikes passing through. A motorcycle approached with two terrorists. They then open fired. The police then fired and a gunfire ensued. In this gunfire 5 CRPF jawans died. 3 CRPF jawans were injured, one policeman was injured and one woman was injured as well. They were all taken to the hospital in Anantnag. The terrorist group Al Umar Mujahideen have taken responsibility. They said that they had ordered the two terrorists to do this. The police did not believe this. They believe it was the Jaish-e-Muhammad. In the gunfire, out of the two terrorists one of them died while the other ran away. When the police searched the terrorist, the found that he was from the JeM. They also found an AK-47 riffle. Inspector General Ravideep Sahi of the CRPF said that after the Pulwama attack this was the first attack of this kind. The Amarnath Yatra which many pilgrims attend will begin on 1st July and end on 15th August. To reach the cave shrine in South Kashmir Himalayas, the pilgrims will have to pass through the same road where the gunfire took place. The ICC has introduced a minimum age policy of 15 years for players to play international cricket. The ICC in a statement said, "The minimum age policy has been enforced because, the players will be mentally prepared to participate in international tournaments and it will also safegaurd players. In Under-19 international tournaments, both male and female players need to be above 15 years of age. If there is an exceptional player below 15, for example in India. Then an application can be made to the ICC to allow the player. All details about the player's exceptional qualities must be presented before the ICC. On evaluating various factors, the Board may make an exception and allow the player to play. Earlier there was no bar on the age of a cricketer to play any form of international cricket. Pakistan's Hasan Raza, holds the record of being the youngest to play international cricket. He played between 1996 and 2005.  He made his Test debut when he was 14 years and 227 days old. Former legendary batsman Sachin Tendulkar is the youngest Indian to play Test cricket for the country. He made his Test debut at the age of 16 years and 205 days.

The Central Government set up a committee which consisted of doctors, virologists and other experts. They were tasked with finding the number of COVID infections in the country and projecting the number of future cases in the country. They came up with a unique mathematical model to ascertain the number of infection. The committee prepared a report which was released on 18th October. According to the report, till now India reported 7.55 million cases of the coronavirus and is second only to the United States. There are a lot of cases in India. Manindra Agrawal, a professor at the Indian Institute for Technology (IIT), Kanpur and a committee member said, “As per our calculations around 30% of the population is currently infected and it could go up to 50% by February.” He said their research use a very different method. India started its vaccination drive against the Covid-19 on 16th January 2021. As of 30 November 2021, India has administered over 1.24 billion doses overall, including first and second doses of the vaccine. The vaccination drive is still going on. With the emergency of the new Omicron variant, there is a spike of cases in India. A third vaccine dose or a booster shot to strengthen the body is being contemplated to curb the Omicron outbreak. It is not clear whether 2 doses are enough to protect against the virus and India is deliberating whether we need the booster shot. Dr. Samiran Panda, Head of Epidemiology and Communicable Diseases at the ICMR said, Researchers are studying whether the booster shot can protect against Omicron. Also don't be under the impression that being fully vaccinate makes you immune to COVID-19. The 2 doses of the vaccine reduces the severity of the infection. Keep this in mind and do not be under the wrong impression that you are completely immune. Studies are still going on to ascertain the most effective time interval between the two vaccine doses. Research is still going on as there is no clarity over this. Currently the time interval of 84 days has to be followed. The government is yet to approve the booster shot. Till then people need to get their 2 shots, wear a mask, sanitise and practise social distancing. It will take some time to ascertain to time interval between 2 doses and to approve the booster shot. Now with Omicron in India, we don't know how much it will spread, its effect on the elderly & and its severity. In the USA, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention which is similar to the ICMR in India has recommended booster shot doses for Covid-19 to all adults who are 18 years and older. Canada is also planning to recommend booster shots but only for those people with comorbidities. Austria, Germany, Italy, Israel, South Korea, Brazil, United Kingdom, etc. are offering booster doses to all adults. Whereas Sweden and Spain have allowed booster doses only for the elderly. India is stil deliberating over this.

The Third Phase of the 2019 Lok Sabha Elections held in 15 states, are now complete. Elections were held in Daman & Diu and Dadra & Nagar Haveli as well. The Third Phase of the election, were for 117 Lok Sabha seats. Now the elections for 302 out of 543 Lok Sabha seats are over. The elections were held peacefully in most of the states, except for a few minor incidents. Some of the candidates in these elections were, BJP president Amit Shah from Gandhinagar, Gujarat, Congress Chief Rahul Gandhi, who is contesting from Wayanad. Congress leaders Shashi Tharoor, Mallikarjun Kharge and Samajwadi Party founder Mulayam Singh Yadav. In the Third Phase of the elections, the total percentage of people who voted were 67%. In the 2014 Lok Sabha Elections, it was 69.3% Two Indian states recorded the highest percentage of voter turnout. Tripura recorded a voter turnout of 81.6% and Assam recorded a voter turnout of 80.8%. due to problems over the application of government schemes. Anantnag district in J&K recorded a voter percentage of 12.9%. In the 2014 elections, the voter turnout in the same place was 39.37%. In Anantnag the polling staff were travelling in a vehicle, when they met with an accident by falling into a gorge. One policeman died and 5 were injured. a congress activist was killed. The Congress have blamed Trinamool Congress, but they have denied the charges. voters complained of problems with EVM machines. 76 votes had already been placed. The voters were unable to place their votes. the button allotted to the Congress candidate was jammed. The machine was immediately replaced. PM Modi cast his vote at a polling booth in Ahmedabad. He even conducted a road show. The Congress complaint against them. The EC has asked the Ahmedabad District Election Office 22 states and union territories have now finished voting. 8 more states are yet to votes.

India has been witnessing issues with electric scootersince the beginning of 2022. In Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh a detachable battery of the scooter was kept on charging in the bedroom, and the family was sleeping close by. Suddenly the battery exploded killing one person and injuring three others. Another incident occurred in the Vasai area of Maharashtra’s Palghar district. A 7 year old boy Shabbir Shah Nawaz was sleeping with his grandmother in the hall of their house. The battery of their electric vehicle was kept on charging close by. At around 4.00am the battery exploded. Shabbir was grievously injured while his grandmother sustained minor injuries. They were quickly taken to the hospital. Shabbir had sustained 70% burns. However, he succumbed to his injuries on 3rd October 2022 after being treated for 10 days. It was due to his burns. The social media reports claim that it was a detachable 24 Ah Lithium Ferro Phosphate (LFP) battery, was faulty and exploded due to overheating. In Odisha's Jajpur district a man named Kishore Badra worked in his paddy field. While returning home after working in his paddy field a snake bit him on his leg. The incident happened on 11th August. Badra said, “I did not put on chappals while I was walking in the night. That's when the snake bite me. I switched on my torch and found it to be a poisonous snake. In order to take revenge, I took the snake in my hands and bit it repeatedly, killing the snake on the spot. He came back to his village with the dead snake. On reaching home, his wife was shocked and he told her the whole tale. Soon he became the talk of the town and Badra exhibited the snake to his shocked friends. Some onlookers advised Badra to visit a nearby hospital as the snake was poisonous. Instead he went to a traditional healer. He asked the healer whether the poisnonous snake could harm him. The healer told him that he was fine and there was no problem. This is not the first time a snake has been bit in India. In Gujarat, a 60-year-old man was bitten by a snake but then the man also bit the snake multiple times. The snake died and even the man could not survive as the snake was poisonous. Luckily for Badra, his biting the poisonous snake had no impact on him.

The Army has been deployed in Manipur to manage the situation & ensure peace in the northeast. Assam Rifles is a paramilitary force that focuses on anti-terror operations. 46 Assam Rifles is based in Manipur. On 13th November 2021, Colonel Viplav Tripathi, Commanding Officer of 46 Assam Rifles had gone to visit a military base in Manipur. After his visit, he left in a convoy of cars. Tripathi was accompanied by his wife Anuja (36), son Abir (5) and other officers. When they were at a remote village near the India-Myanmar border terrorists threw an IED bomb after which there was heavy firing from both sides of the road. Sadly Colonel Viplav Tripathi, his wife, son and 5 other soldiers lost their lives in the attack. Their deaths comes as a terrible shock to the nation. This is the first time that a wife and child lost their lives. Earlier their have been many militant and military casualties but this is the first time that civilian family members lost their lives. Manipur-based terrorist groups PLA and MNPF have claimed responsibility for the attack. A similar incident had occured in 2015, where 20 soldiers were killed in an attack by terrorists in Manipur, after which the Army launched a surgical strike on their camp. Prime Minister Narendra Modi tweeted his condolences and condemned the attack. Manipur Chief Minister N Biren Singh condemned the incident and promised a counter-operation has been launched to track down the terrorists. Colonel Tripathi was posted in Mizoram's capital Aizawl before Manipur. People who knew the Colonel say he was a polite, humble officer and would often help civilians in his area. Tripathi is from Raigarh, Chhattisgarh but he moved away for work. Tripathi's grandfather who was a freedom fighter & a politician who worked for India. His grandfather inspired him to don the army uniform. A pall of gloom descended on Raigarh town when the news reached, with locals rushing to his house to express their condolences. People were devastated over the family's death.

One year and a half after the Congress formed the government in Rajasthan, they maybe on the verge of losing power. All due to the ongoing tussle between CM Ashok Gehlot and Deputy CM Sachin Pilot of the Congress party. Let me tell you about it. According to Pilot, he helped Congress win the 2018 elections in Rajasthan However, Ashok Gehlot was made the CM instead of Pilot. The Chief Minister and the Deputy had many differences in opinions. They did not agree over the various policies formulated for the state of Rajasthan. They did not agree over portfolio allocation in Rajasthan for sectors such as education, roadways, health, etc. Pilot was even miffed about not being appointed Chief Minister. The Congress party was then split into two camps. One groups of MLAs supported Gehlot while another supported Pilot. Recently the SOG launched an investigation on Pilot against allegations over his attempts to sabotage the government. Pilot became even more angry and said, “I can not put up with this humiliation.” He then went to Delhi to meet Congress Party head Sonia Gandhi to discuss this. He was then missing for two days and there was no update. Then suddenly Pilot announced a list 30 MLAs who had pledged their support to Pilot and would follow him, if he left the Congress. The Congress then called a sudden press conference at 2.30am on 13th July and said all 109 MLAs of Congress have signed a letter and expressed their support to the party. They announced a mandatory meeting for all MLAs at Gehlot’s residence at 10.30 am on 13th July. If any MLA missed the meeting, strict action would be taken. Pilot did not attend the meeting. It is not known exactly how many MLAs attended the meeting. After the meeting all the MLAs were taken to a resort near Jaipur to ensure the support from MLAs and avoid any horse trading. The total number of seats in the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly is 200. A party needs a majority of 101 seats to form a government. Congress has 122 MLAs and BJP has 72. Currently the Congress is worried, that if Pilots leave the Congress with 30 MLAs, the Congress would lose Majority in the assembly and thus the government. Sources say that Pilot has been in talks with the opposition party BJP saying he has the support of 30 MLAs. But BJP said if Pilots joints, they are ready, but can not give him the post of CM due to internal leadership issues. Now Sachin Pilot has been removed from his post as Deputy CM. A similar incident had occurred in Madhya Pradesh. When MLA Jyotiraditya Scindia left the Congress with his loyal MLAs and switched to the BJP. The Congress government collapsed and the BJP came in power in MP. People say something similar may happen in Rajasthan as well.

An official involved with the government's Make-in-India initiative said, For example, if you manufacture mobiles in Vietnam, since there is no demand for such phones in the local market, they have to be exported. Indian Railway currently has over 13,450 passenger trains which is used to carry approximately 24 million passengers daily. Additionally, Indian railways also has 9,141 goods trains which carry coals, oil etc The normal capacity of existing goods train is 90 coaches. Each coach carries about 100 tonnes of goods. The whole train carries about 9,000 tonnes in one journey. Indian railways made a new and amazing train. Indian railways has made an extremely long train which will take a long time to pass through. Alibaug Police headed the arrest. Everything was kept top secret. When they reached Arnab’s home in Worli, Mumbai, Goswami and his wife didn’t open the door for an hour. Despite the police repeated requests, the Goswamis did not open the door. When his wife opened the door, she immediately started recording the police. When the police handed her the notice for Arnab’s arrest, but his wife tore the papers. The police had to forcefully arrest him and put him in the police van. Arnab claimed he was assaulted by police at his home. Anvay Naik was the managing director of architect firm Concord Design Private Limited. He had built Republic TV’s luxurious studio and they owed him Rs 83 lakh. However the amount had not been paid. Plus 2 other companies had to pay Naik. The three companies owed Naik a total of Rs 5.40 crore. Naik stressed over this, decided to end his life along with his mother in a farmhouse in the village of Kavir, Alibaug. When the police arrived at the scene they found a suicide note which said they had committed suicide because the 3 companies failed to clear the payment. Naik’s wife filed a complaint of abetment against Arnab. Police investigations in the suicide, revealed that Naik first strangled his mother then committed suicide. 1 year later in 2019 the police closed the case because there was no proof against Arnab. Republic TV then said they had paid the entire amount to Naik and it was a fake case against them. The Maharashtra Police will now be questioning Goswami and ask him to provide evidence to back his claims regarding payments to Anvay. a tale of two birds. The synopsis of the first part is A mother bird and her two young ones lived in a forest. The mother was killed in a storm and the young birds were separated from each other. Each found a different home. Now, listen. There once lives. a bird and a two newborn babies in a forest. They had a nest in a tall shady tree. And there the the mother bird took care of her little ones. One day, there was a big storm. There was thunder, lightning and rain. And the wind blew down many trees. The toll tree. in which the birds lived also came down. A big heavy branch hit the nest. Fortunately, for the baby birds, the strong wind blew them away. to the other side of the forest. One of them came down near a cave where a gang of robbers lived. The other landed outside a Rishis ashram, a little distance away. Days passed and the baby birds became big birds. One day, the king of the country came to the forest to hunt. He saw a deer and rode after it. It ran deep into the forest followed by the king. Soon the king lost his way. and didn't know where he was. Suddenly, he heard a voice cry out. Quick, hurry up! There is someone here under the tree. Come and take his jewels and his horse. Come and take his jewels and his horse. or else he'll slip away. The king was amazed. He looked up and saw. big brown bird on the tree under which he was sitting. He also heard faint noises. As soon as he was taken to the cave, he quickly got on to his horse and rode away as fast as he could. Now the synopsis of the second part of the lesson. The king was amazed to hear a similar voice again. He came to know the bird's true story. He met the Rishi who explained the behavior of each bird. He came to a clearing which looked like an ashram. It was the Rishis ashram. The king tied his horse to it. tree and sat down in its shade. Suddenly, he heard a gentle voice announce. Welcome to the Ashram, Sir. Please go inside and rest. The Rishi will be back soon. There is some cool water in the pot. Please make yourself comfortable. The king looked up and saw a big brown bird in the tree. He was amazed. This one looks like the other bird outside the cave. He said to himself aloud, Your right sir answered the bird. He is my brother, but he has made friends with robbers. He now talks as they do. He doesn't talk to me anymore. Just then, the Rishi entered the Ashram. Welcome, sir. He said to the king, please come inside and make yourself at home. Then you can share my food. The King told the Rishi the story of the two birds and how each had behaved so differently though they looked so alike. The Forest. is full of surprises he said. the holy man smiled and said. After all, one is known by the company one keeps. that bird has always heard the talk of robbers. He imitates them and talks about robbing people. This one has repeated that he has always heard. He welcomes people to the ashram. Now come inside and rest. I'll tell you more about this place and these birds. How did the two baby birds get separated? Where did each of them find a home? What did the first bird say to the stranger? What did the second bird say to him? how did the Rishi explain the different ways in which the birds behaved? which one or the following sums up the story best? 1. A bird in hand is worth 3 in the bush. 2 One is known by the company one keeps 3 A friend in need is a friend indeed.

Pictures of Pooja Devi driving a bus in Jammu and Kashmir had taken the internet by storm. This is because, in J&K men are the ones who drive buses. For the very first time, a woman was seen driving a bus. This has shocked many. According to an India Today report, Pooja is in her thirties and is the mother of three children. Her daughter studies in Class 10, son in Class 7 and the youngest son in Class 2. Pooja always wanted to drive a bus and wanted to break the stereotype that only men can drive. Hence she gave it a shot and and ferried passengers on Jammu-Kathua route for the first time in December 2020. Pooja Devi said, "I always dreamt of driving heavy vehicles since I was a kid. I come from a very poor family. My father was a farmer. Pooja said she wanted to apply for a learner's license but could not due to financial difficulties. Pooja spoke about the hardships she faced including opposition from her family. Her family thought that 'driving was not a good profession for women'. Her husband was not supportive about it as well. Her husband would say she did not have the skill for it despite her continuous reassurance. However she continued working towards her dream. Pooja Devi used to drive taxi, rickshaw and now dreams of driving heavy vehicles. Rajinder Singh taught her truck driving. Pooja would even teach others who wanted to learn driving. There was a time when she felt that no one would give her a bus to drive. But the Jammu-Kathua Bus Union had faith in her. Which is how she started driving along the Jammu-Kathua route. Pooja said her youngest son in Class 2, cannot stay at home without her. Her husband is a labourer. So she takes the child along with her in the bus. Pooja has requested the government to help them financially. Pooja aims to take up driving as a profession. Male drivers and passengers have praised her for her driving skills. Kuldeep Singh, a bus driver said, We are all very proud of Pooja. Other women should take inspiration from her. Women are doing very well in every field. I hope more women in J&K will start driving passenger buses.” A passenger said, "When I saw a woman driving the bus, I was very surprised. We feel proud of her. It is a historic moment for J&K.”

On 24th August 2020 evening in Raigad, Maharashtra a building collapsed killing one. Also officials fear that 25 people are stuck under the debris. Sixty people have been rescued. The rescue operation has been going on for more than 12 hours since the building collapsed yesterday evening. Three teams of the NDRF who manage natural calamities and 12 teams of the fire brigade are at the spot. The five-storey building had 45 flats. The building has collapsed when it is only 10 years old. Home Minister Amit Shah on 24th August 2020 described the incident as "tragic" in a tweet. Shah has spoken to SN Pradhan, the chief of the NDRF to provide all possible assistance. Two Maharashtra state ministers - Aaditya Thackeray and Eknath Shinde - visited the accident site yesterday. Mr Shinde said, "The contractor Yunus Shaikh is responsible for the disaster and a case has been registered against him and also the architect. They were now being questioned. Also, if any government officials are involved by giving illegal approvals, strict action will be taken against them. A probe into the incident will begin after the rescue operations are over. Those who have suffered serious injuries are being taken to Mumbai, about 60 km away, for treatment.

You know that a lot of people in Mumbai are suffering from flu. ISH News released a video about it recently. If you haven't seen the video, you can have a look at it here. The increase in cases of flu is seen not only in Mumbai but in other parts of the country as well. Influenza H3N2, a kind of flu is spreading in the country now. The flu which has been in wide circulation for the past two-three months causes a persistent cough that lasts for days, sometimes weeks. A lot of people are suffering from this kind of persistent cough. This is similar to how earlier Covid had spread, now flu is spreading. However, flu is because of seasonal changes and even pollution which increasing in the number of patients. People are a little worried if this will create a situation like Covid-19 and its induced lockdowns. Out of fear, people are indiscriminately using antibiotics to protect themselves. Antibiotics are used to treat bacterial infections. The current flu is a viral infection and cannot be treated by antibacterial medicine. Indian Medical Association (IMA) has warned against the use of antibiotics without a prescription. Let me tell you some of the symptoms and the precautions of the flu: Lets start with the symptoms. 1. There will be fever often above 100 degree Fahrenheit. 2. Sore throat and severe coughing 4. Runny nose and sneezing 6. Muscle and body aches 6. Fatique, tiredness and weakness. These were the 6 major sympotoms. Here are the precuations to be taken: 1. Annual flu vaccinations should be taken. It is advised to receive it in October, so that you can prevent from seasonal flu. This has been advised by doctors. 2. Regularly wash your hands, especially after using the restroom, before consuming food or touching your face, nose, or mouth. You can even use a sanitizer. 3. Avoid crowded areas where the virus can quickly spread. However, if you need to go out, wear a mask. 4. Restrict your interactions and sharing of food etc with sick people. 5. In case of flu, stay at home for 24 hours after the fever has subsided. Also cover our mouth while coughing or sneezing to avoid spreading the illness. Consult a doctor and take medicine exactly as directed by your doctor. Don't skip any dose of the prescribed medicine. Take the same number of doses as prescribed. In order to recover quickly, some people take extra doses of medicines. Don't increase the dosage of the medicine on your own. To be healthy and keep yourself safe, follow the prescription of the doctor.
