Earlier on 4th June 2017, in Unnao, Uttar Pradesh a 17-year-old girl was raped. The girl was raped by an MLA named Kuldeep Singh Sengar The girl's family were furious and filed a case in court and demanded that the MLA must be jailed. Later the MLA then threatened and scared the family. They forced them take their FIR back. Then on 8th April 2018 he was arrested by the police for possessing a gun without a license. This is why they arrested him. It was then revealed that it was planned by the MLA, his brother and three policemen. They framed him for possessing a gun without a license and arrested him. Her father then died while still in jail. The MLA's brother then had the girl's uncle arrested. How did he do this? The MLA's brother created a story and said that the uncle had murdered someone. He was arrested and sent to jail. The girl was shocked by all this. First her father died, she was raped, her uncle was jailed and she was a constant target. She was furious and went and stood outside the UP CM's residence. She threw petrol all over herself and tried to burn herself. When people saw this they restrained her. The CM then ordered the CBI to investigate. They then arrested the MLA and filed four cases against him. On Sunday, the girl, along with her aunt, her aunt's sister, and her lawyer were all going to meet her uncle jailed in Raebareli in Uttar Pradesh. They were in the car when suddenly a truck rammed into their vehicle. The truck drove away and the license plates of the truck were smeared in black paint. It was so that no one catches the number. When the car toppled, they were very critical. The lawyer is badly injured and very critical. The girl is even more critical. Her collarbone, ribs, arm and legs are fractured. They were all taken to the hospital. The girl is in a difficult situation and is on the ventilator. These may be her last days. Before she was in the hospital, police had given her a security detail. Two days after the car accident, the girl's family wrote an open letter to the Supreme Court. Her mother said that the MLA was responsible for everything that happened to her family. He has killed and jailed many family members. They said this in an open letter. Before these things happened to the girl, the police gave her security. But when during the car accident the police weren't with her. Then how did the truck crash into their vehicle? There were a lot of questions for the Police. They were asked that even after providing security , why did the accident occur? Many such questions were asked and the police were under a lot of pressure. They finally filed a case against the MLA. In India everyone was shocked that an MLA used his power for wrong reasons. This is completely wrong and everyone is shocked.

On 11th December 2019, Lalit Vasoya, a Congress MLA from Dhoraji asked the Gujarat Government to answer how many malnourished children were there in Gujarat. The Gujarat government in a written reply to Congress MLA said that there are approx 2 lakh malnourished children in Gujarat. These 2 lakh malnourished children are in all 33 districts of Gujarat. Dahod had the highest number of malnourished children which is 42,000. While the Narmada had the second-highest. Porbandar and Botad had the lowest number of malnourished children. Anganwadis are located in rural areas of various states. It takes care of malnourished and hungry children. They were started by the Indian government in 1975. Their aim was to reduce child hunger and malnutrition so that children be healthy. The government gives healthy food to children of Gujarat. But still children are malnourished. The government also provides milk to children in 20 districts of Gujarat. They even provide breakfast and fruits to children of 3-6 years, twice a week. But still children are malnourished. The Gujarat government also said that the two institutes which are Hyderabad's National Institute of Nutrition (NIN) and Mumbai's International Institute of Population Science (IIPS) will conduct accurate surveys regarding malnourishment as they want to know.

National Award-winning lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has won the Richard Dawkins Award. He is the first Indian to win this award. The Richard Dawkins Award is named after the famous biologist. The award was named after him. The award encourages people to be critical, supportive, promote equality, refrain from corruption, etc. The award is presented to those who are secular, rational and logical. Other famous awardees include Ricky Gervais, Stephen Fry, Bill Maher, etc. But Javed Akhtar was honoured with the award, for his critical thinking about various religious beliefs, for not blindly following religious beliefs and constantly question them and for his moral values. Javed Akhtar has supported various social causes, without favouring any religion. He supports everyone regardless of their religion. He is not shy about his opinions and openly voices his disagreements. He has expressed his views on issues like CAA, Islamophobia and others. Shabana Azmi in her tweet wrote, "Javed Akhtar always looked upto Richard Dawkins for critical thinking and honesty. Now you are awarded by Dawkins himself. Congratulations! You are a Hero! Other celebrities like Anil Kapoor, Nikhil Advani Urmila Matondkar and Dia Mirza also congratulated him on Twitter.

On the occassion, Raj Thackeray, the chief of political party Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS) was speaking at a rally. He also showed a video. He said, "In Mumbai's Mahim sea, you can see a piece of land when there is low tide. This piece of land could be seen when the water recedes and not in high tide. Suddenly, there was something strange happening and when there was high tide, 2 flag poles could be seen. The video of which was captured by a drone camera. When the water receded, there was something being constructed and people were seen wading through neck deep water to reach the place. Very soon a path was seen to reach the place. What was being built there? In a lot of places in India there are dargahs which are shrines built over the grave of a revered muslim saints. Similarly in Mumbai there is popular Haji Ali dargah which is built in the middle of the sea with an entry road over the water. An illegal dargah was being built in the Mahim sea. He threatened that if it is not immediately demolished, he will make a Ganpati temple in the same place. Thackeray added, "Popular lyricist Javed Akhtar was invited to Pakistan. There he very strongly spoke in support of India and Indian Muslims. I want more strong Indian Muslim like him who will talk in support of India. All this time, the BMC did not do anything about the encroachment . However, the next day on 23rd March 2023 morning, about 100 BMC officials and the police reached the spot and saw that an illegal construction was taking place. It is reported that the structure was immediately demolished on the behest of CM Eknath Shinde and Dy CM Devendra Fadnavis. Officials also demolished 40 to 50 illegal huts that had come up along the shoreline near the illegal dargah.

Air India recently has faced controversies due to the 2 urinating incidents. Now one more incident has occurred, again with Air India. Sarvapriya Sangwan posted an image on Twitter and said that she found an unusual thing in the food served on the Air India flight which was not chickpeas but a small piece of stone. The was the third incident with Air India in recent times. The woman complained to the aircraft crew. She then shared a post about the food on Twitter. Responding to her tweet, Air India apologized for the incident. They said that they will take this up immediately with their Catering team. They asked the woman to give them sometime to check. Tata Group Chairman, N Chandrasekaran on 8th January 2023 admitted that Air India's response to a drunk passenger urinating on a woman and going scot free should have been faster and stricter. On 9th January 2023 there was a Bengaluru - Delhi Go First flight. There were passengers who had compeleted their security check, got their boarding passes etc. They were boarded onto 2 shuttle buses which would take them to the aircraft. The passengers of the first bus boarded the aircraft. However before the passengers of the second bus boarded the plane, the flight took off. The passengers failed to understand why the flight took off even though they had their boarding passes. There was no call for the missing passengers. The flight just took off leaving 50 passengers behind who were cramped up in the bus and were waiting. It was a 6.40 am flight which left the passengers behind. Inspite of posting a lot of messages on Twitter, the airline did not respond. After a while the airline replied in short, "We regret the inconvenience caused." Strange! The 50 passengers were reportedly accommodated on an Air India flight that left at 10 am. Later the airline decided to offer all affected passengers one free ticket for travel on any domestic sector in the next 12 months. The aviation regulator DGCA has sought a report from the airline on the incident & has ensured strict action.

Indian cricket team will tour Australia from November 2020 to January 2021. This will be India’s first international tour after the New Zealand series in February and March 2020. Looking at the coronavirus situation, cricket and the players have had to adapt to the ‘new normal’. Compared to earlier, now the time is very different. The BCCI has decided to send a massive 32-player contingent for the Australian series. Also, there will be a strong group of support staff that will accompany them. A senior BCCI official said that a large pool of players will be selected because if any of the 11 players get injured, there replacement will have to be flown in from India. But due to the current COVID restrictions they may have to quarantine and follow many protocols. To avoid this, the BCCI decided on sending a large group of players. Incase any player is injured, they can be easily replaced. This was the reason for the large contingent. India’s tour of Australia will include three ODIs, three Twenty20 Internationals and four Tests. The BCCI selection committee will announce the squads for all three formats later in the week. For the IPL 2020 being held in Dubai, UAE, the BCCI left it to the franchises to decide whether they want their family with them. But this time the BCCI has said that it will not allow the families of the players to accompany them to Australia.

Indian Car manufacturers & dealers have taken several steps to ensure safety & precaution during the pandemic. In one of the latest initiatives, Tata Motors has taken safety precautions a step further. Tata Motors is now delivering the Tata Tiago, inside a plastic wrap. Prior to delivery, the car is completely sanitised and place inside the bubble. Tata shared the images on social media and said the cars on display are completely sanitised and safe. The plastic bubble was called the 'Safety Bubble'. Customers can view the car while the car is fully covered. Tata Motors has also taken other initiatives. In April this year, after the first lockdown, Tata Motors started its digital, contactless buying program 'Click to Drive'. It would deliver the car to your doorstep. Tata integrated 750 outlets across the country into one online platform and offered the option to get new cars delivered at home. In August, they launched health and hygiene accessories for its customers. The new cars would come with air purifier, air filter and sanitisation kits. The air purifier can be easily fitted in the cup holder slot of all Tata cars. The air filter can be installed in the Nexon and the Harrier. Sanitisation kit included hand sanitiser, N95 masks, hand gloves, safety touch key, tissue box, etc.

FIFA World Cup 2022 is taking place in Qatar this year Football fans from around the world are excited to see the football matches in Qatar. You are all aware Qatar has clear roads, futuristic skyscrapers and architecture. Fan from around the world are in Qatar for the FIFA World cup. The FIFA World Cup 2022 started on 20th November 2022 Before the match there was an extravagant opening ceremony with stunning fireworks. The match started after the ceremony. Let me tell you the rules that Qatar has announced for the fans travelling for the world cup. 1. In the stadium fans, especially women are not allowed to wear clothes that reveal the shoulder. They are also not allowed to wear clothes that don't cover the knees. Any skin revealing clothes are not permitted. People are expected to wear clothes that have sleeves and are below the knee. The clothes should match the dress code. The men are allowed to wear t-shirts with sleeves, shorts etc. but they will face fines and jail time if they remove their shirts and t-shirts during the match. Women wearing sleeveless tank tops and tops with offensive slogans will be fined. Swimwear is allowed at hotel beaches and pools, only. Other than these places, swimwear is not permitted in public places. 2. Qatar has completely banned beer at the World Cup stadiums. Fans have been asked to avoid purchasing duty-free alcohol from the airports as the importation of alcohol is illegal. An extremely high tax named as sin tax will be applied. However, after 6.30 pm there will be certain fan zones where beer will be available and nowhere else. 3. If same sex couples are found hugging and kissing inside or outside stadium, they will be sent to prison for upto seven years. There should be no public display of affection. The same rule applies for straight couples as well. Those who violate the rule, would be jailed. 4. Anyone found to be proselytizing for other religions would be criminally prosecuted. Meanwhile, the Polish national football team was escorted by  fighter jets on their way to Qatar. The reason being the ongoing Ukraine-Russia war and Poland shares its border with both Ukraine and Russia. Also a missile strike most likely fired by Ukraine in defence against a Russian attack had killed two men in a Polish village. So, to be extra careful, the player's flight was escorted by the flighter jets.

Since England was the Home team they could wear their jersey and India had to change theirs. After much discussion, they decided on the color orange for the jerseys. They wore blue and orange jersey for the match. The BCCI teamed up with Nike to make these jerseys. This is only for one time and will not be worn again. Similarly there are countries as well who had to wear two different jerseys. In order to avoid a clash of colours countries such as Afghanistan, South Africa and Bangladesh had to change their jerseys. After they wore their jerseys, they were sold in an auction to the highest bidder. All the money will be collected and the ICC will gave it to the NGO called One Day 4 Children charity run by UNICEF. Many politicians have said that the colour orange was selected to show support to the BJP. People said that they were trying to politicise cricket by making players wear orange jerseys. In a heartwrenching tragedy, a flight from Nepal crashed near Pokhara killing everyone on board. You can go back and watch the entire video by I will now give you an update in this story. The pilot of this aircraft was a woman named Anju Khatiwada. Her life was very inspiring, sadly she passed away in the crash. Her husband Dipak Pokhrel had also been a pilot at Yeti Airlines. 16 years ago in June 2006, Dipak was in the cockpit of a Twin Otter prop plane which was flying to Jumla in Nepal. The flight crashed and all the 9 people on board passed away. Upon Dipak's death, Anju was alone with their young child. His dreams of become a successful pilot were left unfinished. Instead of giving up, Anju decided to fulfil his dreams. Using the insurance money she got after her husband’s death, Anju began training to become a pilot in the USA. She secured her pilot's license and returned to Nepal. What a strong woman! She worked hard and lived a proud life. She took it upon herself to finish her dreams. She piloted flights all by herself. At Yeti Airlines, she had flown close to 6,400 hours. A trailblazer, Anju was one of just six women employed by the airline as pilots. She was filled with positivity. Anju excelled in her career and loved her family as well. Anju later remarried and had a second child as she continued to build her career. Friends and family say she was filled with positivity, she was hardworker and was a delight to be around. Sadly she passed away in the crash. Another person Oshin Ale Magar, a flight attendant, was also present on the flight and her story is very tragic as well. Her family insisted on her staying home to celebrate Maghe Sankranti festival which was on 15th January 2023. However Oshin said she would complete her flight and then return for the celebrations. The flight crashed and Oshin's father was devastated as his daughter would never return home. How heartbreaking! She was a famous TikToker and had also posted a clip of her in the flight before it took off. Oshin passed away on the flight. Do you know that Nepal has a history of faulty aircrafts. There have been around 27 fatal plane crashes in Nepal over the past 30 years. Of these, more than 20 have taken place in the last decade. In 2013, the European Union banned all Nepal-based airlines from flying in its airspace, citing safety concerns. Only European flights would be allowed to come from Nepal otherwise all Nepal flight were banned in their airspace. In March 2022, Nepal government requested the EU to remove the ban but they refused. This was because of lax regulations, poor quality flights, etc. All of this led to the crash. This is why their flights have been banned by Europe.

A study published on 30th June 2020 in the US science journal PNAS by the scientists at Chinese universities and China's Center for Disease Control and Prevention. They published that they had discovered a new type of Swine Flu called G4. G4 has genetically descended from the Swine Flu and is capable of triggering a pandemic and infecting humans. Swine Flu had caused a pandemic in 2009. The Chinese scientists said that it possesses all the essential hallmarks of being able to infect humans. From 2011 to 2018, researchers took 30,000 nasal swabs from pigs. These pigs were taken from slaughterhouses in 10 Chinese provinces. They were tested in veterinary hospitals. The researchers then did experiments on many animals including on ferrets. They were used to study flu, because they experience similar symptoms to humans especially fever, coughing and sneezing. But G4 was the most infectious in ferrets. Usually, when humans get infected with seasonal flu, they recover and their immunity becomes stronger. But according to researchers, this immunity does not protect against G4. Blood tests found that 10.4% of swine workers had already been infected. As many as 4.4% of the general population also may have been exposed. That means that the virus has already passed from animals to humans but the scientists' main worry is that there is no proof still that it can be passed from human to human. If it spreads from human to human there is a possibility of it spreading across the world. The researchers have said that we need to urgently monitor people working with pigs.

In 2022, ordering food at home through apps like Zomato and Swiggy has become a regular practice for almost everyone. You are aware that the food you order comes packed in silver foil or a plastic container. Have you experienced snake skin stuck on the food wrapper? You would say it is not possible. But it actually happened in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. A woman named Priya had ordered parotta from a restaurant in the city on the 5th May. But when Priya started eating the food, she spotted something like a newspaper print. She stared at it for long and was shocked to see snake skin on it. Not a snake, but just the skin. It was a finger long piece. Thinking she had eaten the food with the skin, Priya immediately complained to the police. Police too were shocked and informed the food safety officials. The authorities reached the Thiruvananthapuram restuarant and after inspection shut it down. The restaurant’s licence was immediately cancelled. Arshitha Basheer, the food safety officer said that the restuarant worked in a unhygienic way, the kitchen was dimly lit and waste was dumped just outside the kitchen. There was no proper waste management and everything was unhygienic. While investigating about the snake skin it was found that snake skin was in the stack of paper used for packing the food. The paper was then used for packing. The restuarant was closed down, it's licence cancelled and a notice was issued to them.

The Supreme Court on 5th January gave the green signal to the Central Vista Project, which comprises of construction of the new parliament building and refurbishing old government buildings. It is one of the most ambitious projects of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's regime. Few petitions were filed against the project. However the government pushed the project saying redevelopment was the need of the hour. One of the petitioner, Rajeev Suri, challenged the notification issued by DDA on 21st December which pertained to land use changes. Another petitioner, Meena Gupta, a former Secretary of the Ministry of Environment and Forests, argued the project will be detrimental to the environment. Many other petitions were filed against the project. In November, a 3 judge bench AM Khanwilkar, Dinesh Maheshwari, and Sanjiv Khanna reserved the verdict on the project. However, last month, SC said contruction of the new parliament cannot begin but permitted the ground-breaking ceremony by PM Modi. The construction will be on hold till the petitions are heard. The Central Government's lawyer Tushar mehta defended the project fiercely in court. He drew the SC attention to the security issues and structural weaknesses of the existing building. The new parliament will ensure better security and will be strong as well. Since offices in the parliament were at full capacity, the government had to rent nearby offices. Rs 1,000 crore would be paid as rent. The new parliament will be able to occupy all the offices and the rent money can be saved. The Centre plans to conserve the existing Parliament building as an archaeological asset. While giving the approval to the project, the bench said that under the DDA's exercise of power was valid. The apex court added that the heritage conservation committee’s approval will be needed for Central Vista project to begin. They ordered that smog towers be set up as an integral part of the central vista project. Smog towers will help to purify the polluted air and it will be mandatory. These should be an integral part of the project and there must be no mistakes later. The court also agreed with clearances given by the Ministry of Environment. However, Justice Khanna disagreed with his colleagues for land use changes.

They also had a 26 year old son named Sai Ram. The parents were fedup of Sai Ram's alcoholism and unemployment. The parents were tired of him. Everyone agreed to the plan Kshatriya Ram had a car and the maternal uncle along with one of the other accused took Sai Ram in the car to a temple. Upon reaching they met the other accused. All had liquor, and after Sai Ram got drunk, he was strangled with a rope. They put his body in the car and then threw it away in the river. The accused then ran away with the car without leaving any clue. Later the police found Sai Ram's body floating in the river on 18th October 2022. When the body was identified, the parents were called to the mortuary to identify the son’s body They identified the body and took it home for rituals. Police were suspicious as the parents had not filed any missing complaint Police were doubtful and checked the CCTV footage. They found that the car was used by the parents when they came to identify the body. The same car was used to take Sai Ram to the temple. The parents were interoggated on 25th October 2022. That is when they confessed to their crime. They told the police that he was a drunkard and narrated the entire sequence of the crime. The number of COVID infections are on the rise in India. However a village named Chikhalar village in Madhya Pradesh has not recorded a single COVID infection till now. So how is it that there has not been a single COVID infection? It is not the local police or village panchayat who are responsible for this. But the women of the village are responsible. Women sealed the boundaries of the village by placing a bamboo barricade ensuring no outsider can enter the village and people remain in their homes. The women are all dressed in sarees and armed with sticks stand at the border of the village. So that the people are scared and do not come out of their houses. Instead of having villagers go outdoors to make important purchases, two youths have been assigned to get the work done for everyone. If the women see anyone walking around the village for no reason, they hit the people with their sticks. The women are doing this to safeguard the villager from the deadly virus. The women of the village are working hard to contain the spread of COVID-19. Chikhalar has set a wonderful example for everyone to follow.

He alerted emergency services remove road barriers in order to allow fire crew to access the scene. Many people tried to put the blaze out with fire extinguishers but were unable to control the rapidly spreading flames. The Ajman police said the blaze had been brought under control at about 9pm. Major Gen Sheikh Sultan bin Abdullah Al Nuaimi, commander-in-chief of Ajman Police said that investigations are going on. Due to the current COVID-19 outbreak in India, the government announced a lockdown. Due to this it is difficult for the poor to make ends meet. The government has distributed food to them through the Ration systems. Many NGOs have distributed food as well because feeding the poor is priority. In Hyderabad, Deaf individuals have also distributed food to the poor. The Association's name is DSD founded in 1987, they have been working for the last 32 years. Their aim is to advocate for jobs for Deaf individuals in the public and private sector, they also give Rs 1.25 lakh to Hearing individuals who have married Deaf individuals. The DSD also gives mobiles to poor Deaf persons and they even advocate with the government and help provide houses to poor Deaf couples. Like this the DSD is involved in many activities. The Founder & President of DSD is V.V.S.L.K.M Prasad -sign-name- He saw that due to the COVID-19 outbreak many poor are starving. He decided to cook and distribute wholesome food to 5 cities of Hyderabad. Food was distributed to 3,500 poor people. 12 packages of rice each weighing 25kg, was distributed in various poor Deaf households. They did this to support the poor and help eliminate COVID-19. We applaud their efforts. Have a look at the images and video clips.

Some say Ram Charan is opposed to having children because it would distract him from focusing on his career. Some say Upasana chose not to have children due to population control concerns. These misunderstandings have gone viral. Upasana responded saqying these claims are not true and there is no need to be shocked. There is no need to misunderstand speculate about this. You think that she hanged herself due to the stress of failing her B.Ed (HI) exam. Right? However, there is more to it. Anjali's fellow students alleged that Anjali was good in studies and was hardworking. She has been perpetually and purposefully failed and harrassed by the teachers. She was stressed and that is why committed suicide. Anjali got her BEd (HI) second semester results on 2nd September. Anjali saw that she had failed the exams so she decided to hang herself. On 3rd September at around 8pm when other hostel students were going to the mess for dinner, they spotted Anjali hanging. They were shocked! They broke open the hostel room and warden sent her to Lok Bandhu Hospital in Lucknow, where doctors declared her dead. After Anjali's death, her fellow students were angry and protested outside and blocked the gate. Students of Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University along with Students’ Federation of India of BBAU too joined the protests. Students of Lucknow University also took part in the protests which are going on since Anjali's death on 3rd September. The protesters claimed that Anjali was harassed by some teachers and purposely given less marks and failed. The students demanded the expulsion of University Registrar, examination proctor, Controller of The students demanded the formation of a Special Investigation Team (SIT) which includes a former Supreme Court judge. They further demanded compensation and government job for one of the members of Anjali’s family. One of the protesters said, “Out of 20 students in Anajli's B.Ed (HI) batch, the teacher had failed 15 of them. Only 5 had passed. 15 had failed. What does it mean? We demand an FIR to be lodged against the teacher who corrected the papers and deliberately gave less marks. The University has a lot of students with disabilities and there a lot of Deaf students as well. According to students, the University does not have an adequate number of interpreters and there is no proper accessibility. The students with disability do not have special classes arranged for them to meet their needs. The exams for B.Ed (HI) are fixed, it is the teacher's responsibility to complete the syllabus on time. However, the teachers teach irregularly initially and before the exams teach in haste. Also a lot of topics are missed. They do not understand and are stressed during the exams. The teachers do not plan well. This is according to the students. Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) of Kakori Ashutosh Kumar said, “The body was sent for postmortem. The girl’s family has not submitted any complaint. According to several sources Anjali’s brother Pradeep is also Deaf and works in the same University. University Registrar Amit Kumar Singh said, “The incident is very unfortunate that a good student hanged herself as teachers harrassed her. We have formed an internal committee to investigate the matter. Only a few students are protesting. We are in touch with them. Dawood Ibrahim is India’s most wanted Gangster. He was responsible for the 1993 blasts which killed 257 people and injured 700. He was mastermind of the 1993 blasts and other terrorist activities and was most wanted. For a long time, the Indian Government kept saying that Dawood is living in Pakistan. Even the United Nations confirmed India’s claim. But Pakistan never admitted to this. The FATF focusses on the ethical use of funds and makes sure it is not used for wrong means. Since Pakistan was involved in money laundering for terror financing. the FATF in 2018 put Pakistan on the 'Grey List'. FATF had told Pakistan that by the end of 2019, Pakistan needs to stop money laundering and terror financing in Pakistan. If Pakistan does not abide by the condition, the FATF would 'Black List' the country. This would mean strict financial sanctions would be imposed on Pakistan making international business very difficult for them. Inorder to avoid getting black listed, the Pakistan government on 22nd August has finally admitted that Dawood Ibrahim lives in Karachi. The Pakistan government has now released a list of 88 terror groups, which have now been banned. Leaders of terror outfits such as Hafiz Saeed, Masood Azhar and Dawood Ibrahim will have strict restrictions. Their properties will be seized and bank accounts will be frozen. The government imposed the ban to stop terror financing. Pakistan has also revealed the address of Dawood. According to Pakistan Dawood’s address is “White House, Near Saudi Mosque, Clifton” in Karachi.

There are many in India who decide not to have children after getting married. However their lives become difficult. When couples decide not to have children, they face extreme pressure from friends, relatives, family, etc. Even though couples decide not to have children, they face immense pressure to have children. Such a philosophy of not having children is known as 'Antinatalism' This is a philosophy that believes that after marriage it is not right to procreate because of the growing population in India. One couple said that they have been married for 13 years and are very happy. They are a family of 4 which includes their 2 dogs and are very happy. They said they have never wanted biological children and if they really feel like having children they will only adopt. For now they have decided not to have children. For the last 10 years, they have lived a happy life without a baby by adopting different ways of having fun. In India there are so many problems going on. Environmental problems, financial problems, infrastructure problems, etc. If a couple get married and have children, they have face severe illness due to the bad environment which lead to several expenses. This is why people decide not to have children. There is severe pollution in India which has affected the environment and is not at all good for the health of the growing population. Manav, a Health & Science Professor aged 39, said that when he was 18 years old, if he ever got married he would never have children. This is because his family had many health problems and did not want to pass it down to his children. This is why he decided to live his life with his wife. We will overtake China and become the most populated country by 2024. In the next two years Delhi & Bengaluru will run out of water. People in Delhi had damaged lungs due to air polution. The education quality in India is abysmal. Due to all these reasons, many of the younger generation of the country have decided to not have children.

The woman has three children who are all under the age of 18. During the investigation, officials suspected the woman's children were involved in her torture. “Deaf Festival” was organised by the DAI. It was held in New Delhi on 3rd March 2019. In India for the first time a Deaf Festival like this was organised. It was held on the campus of Multipurpose Training Centre for the Deaf (MPTCD) which was founded and run by, All India Federation of the Deaf (AIFD). This Deaf Festival was attended by more than 3,000 people. The event included activities such as Games, Food stalls, Exhibitions and Lucky Dips. It was completely organised by Deaf individuals. The atmosphere at the event was very Deaf-friendly everyone enjoyed socialising. Family members and interpreters were also present, who were well versed in Sign Language. The Founder and Director of DAI is Mr Balbir Singh. He said that the "Fun Fair" is organised by Hearing people. When Deaf people visit these fairs, they do not enjoy as much. They do not enjoy, because Sign Language and Deaf culture is always absent at such events. This is why Mr. Balbir Singh introduced ‘Deaf Festival’ for the first time in India. Which is completely organised by Deaf individuals. It was organised for the first time in New Delhi. From the neighboring states of New Delhi many people attended and made the event a success. The DAI was founded in May 2017. It was called ‘Deaf Awareness India’ It was an NGO to create awareness about Deaf issues and Deaf rights among Deaf youths and to support them. It has done a lot of awareness and action programmes for Deaf people. Very recently, on 28th February 2019, DAI finally registered their name officially. The DAI is also known as "Deaf Awareness and Impact". Earlier the DAI was known as "Deaf Awareness India". The use of the word ‘India’ was not permissible as per Government rules. Mr Balbir Singh then settled on the word "Impact". Which was a strong word. He settled on the word "Impact" as DAI is focused on creating maximum awareness and bringing positive impact for Deaf community. The is how the "Deaf Awarness and Impact" came into existence. Mr. Balbir Singh wants to inform all deaf organizations that DAI encourages other Deaf associations to organize ‘Deaf Festival’ in their locality. This will help Deaf people enjoy and give them a “Sense of Belonging”. Mr Balbir Singh also said that the phrase "Deaf Festival" should not be politicized as it is a generic theme. Any Deaf organization can use the phrase "Deaf Festival". They can use it to celebrate events such as "World Deaf Day"(WDD), "International Day of the Deaf" (IDD) or "International Week of the Deaf" IWD. Organisations can use the phrase as it is not owned by any individual it is for everyone. Deaf Festival" was organised by the DAI. If anyone wants help to organize ‘Deaf Festival’ like DAI, they can contact Mr. Balbir Singh.

People around the world love different sports like cricket, football etc. People love and always eagerly wait to watch the final match of any sporting event. Currently the FIFA Football World Cup is going on in Qatar. People from around the world and India too are excited to see the matches. However, there is a strange story In Kochi, Kerala 17 people bought a house. But what is the link between a football match and buying a house? These 17 people love football and are football fans. Whenever they watch the matches at their homes, they are disturbed by their families. Everyone faced the same issue. Or they wanted to see the matches together at one place but since they have their families at home, they couldn't freely do it as their families would keep disturbing them. They thought it was better to buy a house. They bought the house in Kochi, Kerala's Mundakkamugal village for Rs 23 Lakhs. The 17 friends divided the cost of the house amongst themselves. The aim is to see the match together on a big TV screen at one place with food and drinks without any disturbance. They are huge football fans and bought a house and a big TV to watch the matches! The interiors of the house are beautifully done. They painted the house with bright colours so that it is visible even from far. They have painted the house with colours of teams playing Sporting legend Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo's portraits too have been painted on the walls. The house looks beautiful and even flags have been put up. They enjoy and for the past 15-20 years, they have gathered to watch football matches together. They have all grown up together and never miss a match. Now, they bought a house to watch and enjoy the matches on a big TV screen. After them, the house would be used by their next generation to watch and enjoy sporting events together. This with keep them united. With this unique thought, they bought the house to enjoy the ongoing world cup. How unique! The news went viral and people were amused by the story. They may seem crazy to buy a house just to watch football matches. But the thought of being together is lovely.

In India's second wave of Covid-19, the number of cases are increasing. It has hit the families of the deceased with immense sadness, devastating lives everywhere. One such heart-wrenching story has emerged from Meerut in Uttar Pradesh. Joefred Gregory and Ralphred Gregory were identical twins. They were born on 23rd April 1997. The brothers, born three minutes apart They went to college together, completed their B.Tech in Coimbatore and had plans to go abroad. Both of them were 6 feet tall and were very handsome. On 23rd April 2021, they celebrated their 24th birthday. The twins developed fever soon after their birthday. The family got them tested and turned out they were Covid positive. For days, the family treated them at home, bought an oximeter and gave them medication. As their condition worsened, they were admitted to Anand hospital in Meerut on 1st May. On May 10, both tested negative for Covid and the family was overjoyed. However on 13th May Anand the hospital called the parents and informed about the death of Joefred Gregory. The hospital had called at around 11 in the night to give the sad news. They were shocked as Joefred was completely fine. Later it was found that he had complained of breathing issues which led to his death. Ralphred called his mother and asked about his twin brother. He was told that Joefred had to be moved to a hospital in Delhi. But Ralphred said, "I know you are lying. Something has happened to my brother. A few hours after Joefred's death on 13th May, on 14th May Ralphred too passed away. It was shocking that both the brothers died just hours apart. Joefred and Ralphred's father Gregory Raphael said, On May 10, both tested negative for Covid and the family was overjoyed. Three days later, on 13th and 14th May both my sons were gone and our world came crashing. My family is broken because of the sudden passing of my beautiful twin boys. When Joefred died, I knew Ralphred would not make it because they were inseparable. Covid took away my sons. Our family is heartbroken.”

This is 2022! You know that life styles have changed there is technology everywhere, you use flights, cars, there are rockets, etc. Technology has changed completely from 1800s and 1900s. You know that. Compared to what people talked about in earlier centuries, the talks in 2022 are completely different. Earlier, people were narrow-minded while now people in terms of equal rights, gender equality, disability equality etc. In 2022, we respect each individual and there is hardly any oppression. There is a lot of awareness about it. Earlier it was not the same. Nowadays most of us do not follow caste discrimination. However, there is a small percentage of people in remote villages who still follow caste discrimination. Many of us do not oppression people based on caste and creed. You all know that. A shocking and a heartbreaking incident has occurred in Karnataka's Chamarajanagar district People are still so narrow-minded! A lot of people had gathered in the village for a wedding celebration. There was food and a water tank kept for drinking water. A woman went to the water tank and drank water from it. People were shocked to see her drink water from the tank. They were shocked as they belonged to the upper caste while the woman was a Dalit. The Upper caste people believed that the water was spoilt as the Dalit woman had touched it. They purified the tank with cow urine & cow dung and prayed They emptied the whole tank and refilled it after another round of purification with cow urine. The woman was heartbroken. Just for drinking a glass of water, they purified the tank! She couldn't believe it. The news went viral on social media. The District Commissioner heard about the incident and visited the village on 19th November 2022. He enquired about the incident. However, he did not get the detailed information. He instructed the Social Welfare Department to investigate and report to him. The District Commissioner also condemned the incident. The officials of the Tehsildar Office were upset with the incident, and called 20 Dalit youth and made them drink water from a public tap. The Upper caste people couldn't object to it. The officials told them all the equal and there can be no discrimination They asked if they fell sick drinking water from the tank as the Dalits. There of nothing. Earlier the times were different. It is 2022 now and people need to change their mentality. The tehsildar also said that search is on to find the victim woman and when found, they’ll make her file a police complaint. Once an FIR is lodged, the officials will take strict action against the guilty. I fail to understand how people are still so narrow - minded in 2022! We must remember to respect each religion and caste equally.

Earlier in India people with disabilities like the Deaf, Blind, people with physical disabilities, intellectual disabilities, etc. were never hired and always uderestimated. All this while they had to face so many barriers. When Powai saw the launch of Mirchi and Mime in 2015, Mumbai got its first restaurant to be run by the Deaf. Tariq Hossain joined Mirchi and Mime his hospitality skills, friendly smile and positivity while taking orders, floored his superiors. They saw that he was a hardworking Deaf man. When Ishaara was setup in Mumbai's lower parel at a luxury mall Palladium, Tariq was hired over there. The eatery was founded by Prashant Issar and Anuj Shah, and Riyaaz Amlani. Tariq was made the assistant manager. He is responsible for recruiting and training Deaf individuals. He teaches them serving etiquettes, cutlery placement, greeting skills, anger management, he also teaches then to lightly place glasses on the table and other manners. The Deaf team has grown thanks to him. He was actually going to be made manager but he will happen soon. This is all because lockdown shut down businesses. He will be observed for a bit and then made manager soon. Tariq is really a hardworking person! Luxury restaurant Ishaara is set to launch two more outlets, one in Bengaluru and another in Pune. Hossain is just back from Bengaluru where he was helping the team recruit and trained them in serving, cutlery placement, punctuality, etc. He really is very hardworking. Tariq has a wife and a daughter. He manages everything on his owm and send's money to his parents as well. He does not depend on his family as well. He is proud to work and live an independant life. Another cafe in Delhi ‘Echoes Cafe’ is also run by the Deaf! It has a branch in Hyderabad and a total of 35 deaf people work there. Now time is changing. NGOs are training the Deaf in communication, behaviour skills, etc. and then offer placements. happy to see that now people are not reluctant to hire Deaf people and people with disabilities.

The BJP leader and former Finance Minister Arun Jaitley was a talented problem solver. His death is a big loss to the country. The Feroz Shah Kotla Stadium in Delhi is one of the oldest grounds in India. It was established in 1883. It’s being used for matches for more than 100 years. The DDCA which stands for the Delhi and District Cricket Association decided to rename the stadium as Arun Jaitley stadium. DDCA President Rajat Sharma decided to rename the stadium as Arun Jaitley stadium. He decided to do this as Arun Jaitley worked with the association and encouraged famous cricketers such as Virat Kohli, Ashish Nehra and many others. He supported and encouraged them to make India proud. This is why they are so successful. He was the President of the DDCA and the Vice-President of the BCCI. He was responsible for modernising the stadium. He increased the capacity of the stadium to accommodate large crowds. Arun Jaitley built locker rooms for cricketers and other cricketing facilities which were of international quality. Arun Jaitley was the President of DDCA for 14 years. Jaitley was a politician as well as an avid cricket follower. The Feroz Shah Kotla stadium will be renamed as Arun Jaitley stadium on 12th September. You must know that, stands in cricket stadiums are named after personalities like Sachin tendulkar, One of the stands will be named after Virat Kohli at the same function on 12th September. Long ago there was nothing at the Feroz Shah Kotla stadium. Close to the area there was the Kotla Fort. It was built by Sultan Feroz Shah hundred of years back during the Mughal Era. Years later when the stadium was constructed, it was named Feroz Shah Kotla after the Sultan. Many thought it was named after Feroz Khan and now renamed to Arun Jaitley. It wasn't named after the actor but an old King. Now it will be named after Arun Jaitely.

In a huge revelation, a person has revealed that rupees notes worth ₹88,032.5 crores are missing. Activist Manoranjan Roy filed an RTI application. It is mandatory for the government to disclose information asked in the RTI. You all know that RBI is the apex bank of India. Also India has three units where currency notes are printed. Our currency notes are printed only in these places under the orders of the RBI. Once the notes were printed they were then handed over to the RBI who then distribute it to all the banks. There are rules for all this. Now this is what happened. The total of the supplied notes from the three mints came to 8,810.65 million pieces. This is the number of notes and not their value. However, the RBI has received only 7260 million pieces of the ₹500 notes. These 500 rupees notes were worth ₹88,032.5 crores are missing. Roy recieved this response to this RTI application. These notes were supplied to the RBI when Raghuram Rajan was the governor. The governor's signature is on the notes. Roy then told the CEIB and the ED in order to investigate this discrepancy. Now the RBI announced that none of the notes are missing. The RBI said, "These reports are based on erroneous interpretations of information collected from the printing presses. Notes are not missing. All notes are accounted for. Members of the public are, therefore, requested to rely on the information published by RBI as we share accurate information."

At the 42nd AGM of Reliance Industries, Mukesh Ambani launched the Jio Fiber. This is a three in one service. The first is, lifetime free voice calls from landline phones. The second is high speed internet and the third is a television set-top-box. These are the three services. It will launch on 5th September 2019, which is the third anniversary of Reliance Jio. To avail this, customers will have to pay a refundable security deposit of Rs 1500 and Rs 1000 installation charges. This service will be free for the first two months for customers to test. If you are interested you can register on this website. Initially, the Jio Fiber connections will be available in selected cities only. The services starts from only Rs. 700 per month for 100 Mbps internet speed to 1 Gbps for Rs 10,000 a month. Compared to the prices of other services, these are extremely cheap. From all over India, they have already received 1.5 crore registrations. Their aim is to cover 2 crore residencies and 1.5 crore business establishments across 1,600 towns in India. The complete lists of plans and prices have not been announced yet. Details will be released on 5th September 2019. Mukesh Ambani announced that voice calls from home will be free forever. However international calls to the USA and Canada will cost Rs 500 per month. After this, you can enjoy 24-hour free calls. The Jio Forever Plans will give users free 4k LED television, HD and 4k set-top box. It is the customers choice. They have another plan called the 'Jio First Day First Show.' It will allow customers to watch movies in their living rooms on the same day they are released in theatres. It will be launched in 2020. Reliance aims to sell this service to 1 billion people.
